hemomancy.manipulation.axonal_transducti: An enabled passive draws you into any touching Synaptic Node for 150 mL. Hold forward to travel toward your view along connected nerves; backward travels away. Release to stop and aim to choose a fork. Sneak to bypass entry or travel slowly. Another node releases you. No travel upkeep or duration limit.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.memory_: Axonal Transduction. The Naeglerophaeon's ganglion carries it: a memory of entering the signal itself. At the sixth Degree, absorb it in the Iron Brazier. Then recall and enable it with your usual manipulation controls. It requires sixty-five Ductilis alignment.

Touch a Synaptic Node. Your body enters the nerves joined to it. Forward carries you on. Backward retraces the run. Look into a branch to take it. Another node reforms you. Sneak to pass a node untouched, or to slow your signal. Each entry costs 150 mL. Staying in the network costs nothing.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.naegler: It still conducts. Set it beside a blank Hematic Memory in the Somatic Loom. Prepare four Neurotic enzymes. Project 600 mL of blood. The weave yields Axonal Transduction, a memory of the sixth Degree.

Lay Nerve Fibers or Bundles in one unbroken run, with Synaptic Nodes at the entrances and exits. Sever the run and the signal stops. Leave room beside each node for the body to reform. A dormant Synaptic Step, if you still carry one, can be dismantled. It gives this organ back.

hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.microsc: Microscope in your main hand, one filled Blood Vial in your off hand. Hold use for two seconds. Keep holding while you study the cells, and when you let go, the instrument comes down.

Paired budding cells point to Animus. Crystal-edged discs point to Congeatio. Color won't tell them apart by itself, so watch the shape. Some samples carry several tendencies at once, and other biological properties besides.

An examination labels this one vial. Your next sample goes under the lens on its own. You can inject unknown blood anyway, and identifying it won't make it any stronger. What does the vial do, and what's the drawback? Read both before you decide to use it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_v: To examine a sample: Hematic Microscope in your main hand, filled vial in your off hand, hold use for two seconds. That identifies that vial and nothing else. Later samples stay unknown. They don't inherit the label.

bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.sun_alga.de: Gold-orange lichen that crusts the shoulders and fans out into fronds. It keeps a green alga alive in its tissue and lives on what that alga makes from sunlight, so a host under open sky barely needs to eat. The fronds ruffle like a sea slug's flaps for the same reason: more surface, more light. Under a roof it's a passenger. It'll feed a failing companion before it looks after its own host, and I haven't found the mechanism for that preference.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.sun_alga.so: Grown from wild polyps carrying the sun alga partner, found on open ground and in sunlit water. Incubate with Hematic Algal Crust, Sea Pickle and Rotten Flesh.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.sun_alga.co: Raised by the Giving Light, the house at the sunlit top of the Court. Its partner is a green alga that feeds it sunlight. The arbors around their lighthouse are hosts anchored among the fronds, and every one of them can still walk away.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.coralline_a: Knotted, root-like growth at the hands and feet that cements to stone the way a kelp holdfast does. It lives with an encrusting red alga that lays down its own cement, which accounts for the pink flecks. It doesn't plate the host or grow a shell. It grips. On stone or underwater the host is very hard to shift, and the strain braces hardest with someone sheltering behind it.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the coralline alga partner, found on stone and high rocky ground. Incubate with Chitinous Husk, Kelp and Rotten Flesh.

Raised by the Holding Stone, keepers of the rocky shallows and the tide-pool refuges. Its partner is a red alga that cements itself to stone. Their elders brace the refuge entrances in holdfast masses, anchored, not petrified: they can still let go.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.gut_bacteri: A fast, cobalt-backed strain that grows finlets, a sail along the spine and, late on, a crescent tail. The flank purses are a fungal trick, small cups that hold banked blood. A gut bacterium in the tissue digests that blood, so the strain can store a kill and spend it later on whoever's bleeding worst. Bats share blood with their roost-mates the same way. It feeds best at speed, and it's calmer with company in the water.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the gut bacteria partner, found in open water, rivers and swamps. Incubate with Raw Pelagic Herring, Cod and Rotten Flesh.

Raised by the Shared Wake, whose families live as a travelling school in open water. Its partner is a gut bacterium that digests blood. They raise the sail to herd prey and take turns striking, and the purse feeds whoever falls behind.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.light_bacte: Translucent violet-blue veins that branch, join and let go again, like a slime mould streaming between meals. It throws ribbon strands that catch on blocks and on allies, and links them into beaded chains. The pulse running down each strand is light, made by a partner bacterium. Either end can drop a strand, and the strain doesn't seem to care which. It's named for the seaweed, not for a dead man. I checked.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the light bacteria partner, found in water, in forests and in dark places underground. Incubate with Ganglion Cluster, Glow Ink Sac and Rotten Flesh.

Raised by the Woven Current, whose settlements hang on lines between canyon walls and come apart and rejoin as they need. Its partner is a bacterium that makes its light. They hold that a connection should be free to make and free to release.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.black_yeast: A shaggy pale cap that blackens from the rim and digests itself into ink, as ink cap mushrooms do. A melanised black yeast lives in the tissue, and the dark parts drink up nearly all the light that reaches them. The veil hangs from the cap and blurs the host's outline. Hostiles notice the host late, and when that fails the strain spends itself as ink and gets them out. It's escape tissue. It won't help you ambush anything.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the black yeast partner, found in swamps, dark forests, mushroom ground and dark places. Incubate with Ink Sac, Chromatophores and Rotten Flesh.

Raised by the Veiled Fold, who live in screened clefts beyond the sunlight. Its partner is a black yeast that darkens its tissue. A guest there is given one room, not the house, and nobody is owed anyone else's history.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.cold_bacter: A frost-grey mantle that folds around the host in layers and closes into a bell when things go badly. The tissue hardens like a sclerotium, the dormant fungal mass that waits out a winter, and a cold-loving bacterium keeps it working where most tissue would stall. It slows hunger and air loss, sheds poison and holds the host shut through a killing blow. Stillness is its preferred state. It seems to resent being worn at a run.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the cold bacteria partner, found in taiga, old growth and on stony heights. Incubate with Cleansing Hemolymph, Packed Ice and Rotten Flesh.

Raised by the Still Bell, who keep a sealed refuge in cold deep water from one generation to the next. Its partner is a bacterium that thrives in the cold. Their elders sleep folded in the bell and are woken only when their knowledge is needed.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.bone_bacter: Bone-white flesh beading bright red, with scarlet clubs that rise into feathery crowns like stalked sea lilies. A partner bacterium dissolves bone, so the strain feeds on remains, on bone blocks and on whatever a fight leaves behind. It roots into bone to feed and can pull free again, the way a sea lily lets go of its stalk and crawls off. Kills yield more with it. Nothing's wasted, which I appreciate in a specimen.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the bone bacteria partner, found in deserts, badlands, jungles, forests and buried soil and stone. Incubate with Bone Worm Colony, Bone and Rotten Flesh.

Raised by Last Marrow, who make their homes inside whale falls and the bones of great bodies. Its partner is a bacterium that dissolves bone. Their rooted elders live inside hollow bones by choice, and they can still uproot.
bestiary.hemomancy.morphling.vent_bacter: A pale polyp along the spine that buds at the nape and grows a mane of trailing tentacles, amber at the root and crimson at the tips. It reproduces by budding, like a yeast, and regrows lost tissue the way a freshwater hydra regrows its whole body. The tentacles sting, and late on a second head buds from the shoulder in a fight. A vent bacterium in the tissue lives on heat and sulfur. The mane looks like fire and doesn't burn. I tested that too.
Grown from wild polyps carrying the vent bacteria partner, found in deserts, badlands, jungles and deep stone. Incubate with Giant Tube Worm Colony, Magma Cream and Rotten Flesh.

Raised by the Kindling, who live among the hydrothermal vents and call them Hydra's heads. Its partner is a vent bacterium that lives on heat. They cultivate the strain for a lifetime, and the regrown tissue is meant to replace the human form in the end.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.barbed_urchi: A defensive reef organism whose spines keep up a blood-warm sting long after they are pulled out.
Grazes the Erythrocoral Reef bottom and other red aquatic growth. Capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.blood_lanter: A drifting bell of translucent flesh that pulses like a lamp behind closed eyes.
Mostly the Midnight Ocean. A few drift into reefs and neighboring depths. Capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chalybeate_s: An armored grazer that gathers among heated, iron-rich mineral aprons and withdraws beneath its shell.
Mineral chimneys in Hydrothermal Depths and other deep-ocean vent sites. Capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chitinite.de: A plated scavenger with shell memory dense enough to confuse simple blood-sense.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chitinite.so: Found near fungal growth and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
A wary herd animal. Infection shows in it as bright veins and a strange calm, and it does not turn aggressive.
Found in infected wilds and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.desiccant.de: A dry husk that drinks moisture from the air and leaves old blood brittle.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.desiccant.so: Found in arid infected pockets and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.fervent_chit: A heat-adapted form of chitinite. Its shell holds a feverish, iron-heavy pressure.
Found in hotter infected regions and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hematic_burr: A tunneling creature that chews in a steady rhythm, following the memory of buried vessels.
Found below infected terrain and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hemojelly.de: A surface-floating blood jelly in temperate and warm seas. Its long submerged tendrils gather small fish beneath the bell.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hemojelly.so: Temperate and warm ocean surfaces, including upper Pelagic waters. Player kills yield Enthralling Filament, and its enzyme is still useful.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hemolymphopo: A small many-legged feeder whose blood analogue stains its path through fungal matter.

bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.lantern_tick: A patient parasite whose dim glow brightens near warm blood.
Found near infected hosts and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.morphling_po: A wild bud of morphling tissue that hasn't settled into a strain. It carries up to three partner organisms picked up from where it grew.
Found as wild morphling growth and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.phlegethonti: A heat-fed beetle whose fused chemical glands turn its territorial warning into a directed stream of burning ichor.
Found in Phlegethontic Basins and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.prism_cuttle: A cuttle-form specimen whose chromatophores flash with broken blood-memory.
Mostly Twilight gullies, though it also lives in warm water. Capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.scarlet_serp: A red serpent whose ribs move like a suture being pulled through living cloth.
Found in infected wilds and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
A chattering colony of tooth-bodied pests whose bites turn bone and blood into shared appetite.
Found near Devil's Tooth growth and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.venom_rib_ce: A long predator whose ribbed venom glands flex as each segment moves.
Found in infected ground cover and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.venous_strid: A tall strider that walks over soft red ground as if reading veins beneath it.
Found in infected wetlands and capturable in a Specimen Jar.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.verdigris_mo: A powder-winged moth whose green oxidation dust settles over blood-wet surfaces.
Found near infected growth and capturable in a Specimen Jar.

block.hemomancy.consecrated_bloodwell.du: A fane may have only one Consecrated Bloodwell heart.
block.hemomancy.consecrated_bloodwell.em: Nothing to withdraw. The well is empty or you are full.
block.hemomancy.consecrated_bloodwell.in: Your blood is not yet awakened.
block.hemomancy.consecrated_bloodwell.no: Only members of the bloodline bound to this fane may feed the bloodwell.

block.hemomancy.covenant_throne.insuffic: The Covenant demands %s blood for the Trance. You cannot afford it.
block.hemomancy.covenant_throne.no_blood: Your blood is not yet awakened.
block.hemomancy.covenant_throne.not_prog: Only the Progenitor of a bloodline may commune with the Throne.
block.hemomancy.covenant_throne.respawn_: The Throne accepts your blood-oath. You will return here.
block.hemomancy.covenant_throne.trance_c: The blood has not yet settled. The Trance is available in %s seconds.
block.hemomancy.hematic_armature.corners: The Armature must be consecrated before it can accept the Cornerstone.
block.hemomancy.hematic_armature.insuffi: The Armature requires %s blood for the next graft.
block.hemomancy.hematic_armature.prepari: Preparing %s: %s mL from the Armature and one %s. No health payment. Hold %s to leave before it binds.
block.hemomancy.hematic_armature.upgrade: The Armature has already accepted that rite.
The Armature will not accept this rite before Degree %s.
The Armature accepts the rite and becomes: %s.
Present this item as a Cardinal rite offering to upgrade the Armature.

block.hemomancy.hematic_stake.invalid: The stake must connect to your fane and remain within your bloodline's anchor limit.
block.hemomancy.hematic_stake.manifested: The fane accepts a new Hematic Stake.
block.hemomancy.hematic_stake.not_owner: Only the Progenitor who consecrated this fane may break its stakes.
block.hemomancy.humoral_barometer.readou: The humors read %s; blood-moon pressure is %s.
block.hemomancy.heart_node.desc: A heart the Gardens agreed to keep. It remembers you here.
block.hemomancy.mycelial_synapse.desc: Iron taught to listen. It carries the node's reach to where the crystal pointed.
block.hemomancy.mycelial_synapse.raise_o: A synapse isn't set down. Raise it with a Sanguine Formation from hematic iron and a Sporite Crystal.
block.hemomancy.mycelial_synapse.raised: The synapse takes. Your sanctum reaches this far now.
block.hemomancy.mycelial_synapse.not_apo: Only an Apotheos can raise a synapse.
block.hemomancy.mycelial_synapse.not_in_: A synapse takes only in the Gardens.
block.hemomancy.mycelial_synapse.no_hear: There's no heart-node of yours here for a synapse to answer to.
block.hemomancy.mycelial_synapse.unconne: Too far. A synapse must reach your heart-node's ground or another of your synapses.
block.hemomancy.mycelial_synapse.budget: Your heart-node can't hold another synapse.
block.hemomancy.mycelial_synapse.foreign: This ground answers to someone else's heart-node. A synapse here would grow into it.
message.hemomancy.chapel.refused: The Chapel keeps its deed for the eighth degree.
message.hemomancy.chapel.complete: This deed has already been seen through.
message.hemomancy.chapel.failed: The memory closes. Try again when it settles.
message.hemomancy.chapel.completed: The deed is witnessed. A node on the ring door lights.
message.hemomancy.chapel.begin.beholding: Watch which witnesses the memory touches, then walk back to each in the same order.
message.hemomancy.chapel.begin.litany: Give here what the stone at the door named, in its order.
message.hemomancy.chapel.begin.downfall: The fall comes back as you walk it. Reach the focus alive.
message.hemomancy.chapel.begin.repose: Stand still inside the ring while the pylons fire. Moving starts it over.
message.hemomancy.chapel.downfall.gate: The fall is walked from the gate at the hall's far end.
message.hemomancy.chapel.unmarked: This Chapel's marks are gone. Its deed cannot be told here.
message.hemomancy.ring_door.refused: The rings do not answer you. A Silentium connects them; an Apotheos breaks them.
message.hemomancy.ring_door.nodes: %s of %s nodes are lit. Every Chapel must be seen through first.
message.hemomancy.ring_door.blood: The rings want %s blood, given while you hold the projection.
message.hemomancy.ring_door.touch: The rings don't turn for a hand. Project blood into them and hold it there.
message.hemomancy.ring_door.contested: The door is already answering someone else's way in.
message.hemomancy.hallowed_ground: The Saint's ground burns the hive out of you.
death.attack.hallowed_burn: %1$s was burned out by a Saint's consecrated ground
death.attack.hallowed_burn.player: %1$s was burned out by a Saint's consecrated ground while fighting %2$s
message.hemomancy.mausoleum.consecrated: The consecrated stone will not give.
message.hemomancy.mausoleum_ward.refused: The ward does not know you. Only the eighth degree goes further.
message.hemomancy.heart_node.planted: The node takes. The Gardens will grow you back here.
message.hemomancy.heart_node.refused: Only an Apotheos can plant a heart-node, and only on the Gardens' own ground.
message.hemomancy.heart_node.not_yours: This ground answers to someone else.
message.hemomancy.heart_node.crowded: Another heart-node beats too close. Its sanctum would grow over this one.
message.hemomancy.heart_node.no_sanctum: The node beats, but no sanctum answers to it.
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.title: Sanctum of %s
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.spread.toolt: The mycelium over the ground inside your sanctum.
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.edge.tooltip: The fronds along the sanctum's edge, where the growth stops.
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.threads.tool: The glowing threads that run over the ground from the heart to each synapse.
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.pulse.toolti: The heartbeat that rolls out through the spread.
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.motes.toolti: Spore motes drifting up from the spread.
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.show_strange: Off: other players see only the blocks. On: they see a dimmer spread with no threads.
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.edge_warning: A line above your hotbar when you step out of the sanctum, at most once every ten seconds.
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.intensity.to: How thick the spread grows, from a hint of strands to a full carpet.
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.reset.toolti: Back to how a new node shows. None of this changes what the sanctum does.
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.map.facing.u: Too far off to see which way it grows
screen.hemomancy.heart_node.map.cut_off: Cut off from the heart, but it still holds its lobe
message.hemomancy.fruiting_body_cache.no: The fruiting body closes. It keeps what it holds for someone else.
block.hemomancy.ossuary_clock.readout: The bone dial marks %s beneath a %s.
block.hemomancy.sanguine_vigil.full_or_e: Cannot deposit. The vigil is full or you have no blood. Vigil: %s / %s
block.hemomancy.sanguine_vigil.inactive: Your blood is not yet awakened.
block.hemomancy.witness_organ.cleared: The Witness Organ forgets its notes.
chat.hemomancy.chamber_of_will.block_out: You cannot place blocks beyond the chamber's current boundary
death.attack.living_flail_freeze: %1$s was shattered by a living glacier
message.hemomancy.possession.not_silenti: Only a Silentium can force their will onto the organism.
message.hemomancy.possession.mind_broken: Your mind is still broken. The organism would take it whole.
message.hemomancy.possession.already: Your will already walks the Gardens.
message.hemomancy.possession.not_bound: Your blood does not hold this surrogate. Bind it first; on a Qliphoth floor the binding holds until the rite is done.
message.hemomancy.possession.no_surrogat: No surrogate stands in the rite space: a bat, enderman, blaze, iron golem, horse, donkey, wolf, spider or armor stand.
message.hemomancy.possession.not_your_pe: That creature answers to another. The rite will not take it.
message.hemomancy.possession.elsewhere: Your mind is already elsewhere: a dream, a chamber or a projection.
message.hemomancy.possession.no_gardens: The Gardens cannot be reached from this world.
message.hemomancy.possession.begin: The surrogate stills. Your will goes on without you.
message.hemomancy.possession.returned: You come back to yourself, in the echo you left.
message.hemomancy.possession.broken: The organism throws you out. Something of your mind stays with it.
message.hemomancy.possession.drawing_hom: Your will draws home. Keep the body still.
message.hemomancy.possession.return_brok: The body moved. The way home slips away.
message.hemomancy.possession.cannot_cast: A borrowed body casts nothing of yours.
possession_action.hemomancy.return.desc: Draw your will home over two seconds. Moving breaks the hold.
possession_action.hemomancy.still.desc: Hold the body where it stands.
possession_action.hemomancy.echolocate.d: Cry out. Everything within 16 blocks glows for a moment.
possession_action.hemomancy.step.desc: Step to the block you are looking at, up to 24 blocks away.
possession_action.hemomancy.spit.desc: Spit a small fireball where you look.
possession_action.hemomancy.slam.desc: Strike the ground. Nearby creatures are hurt and thrown back.
possession_action.hemomancy.lunge.desc: Lunge low and fast where you look.
possession_action.hemomancy.climb.desc: Walk up walls. Sneak to let go.
possession_action.hemomancy.hover.desc: Take to the air, or land.
hemomancy:components/blood_binding.descr: Roots the target in place, preventing movement. Duration and magnitude scale with spell attributes.
hemomancy:components/blood_loss.descript: Applies the Blood Loss effect, slowing the target's movement. Composable with any MnA shape and modifier.
hemomancy:components/blood_rush.descript: Applies the Blood Rush effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, and minor healing. Composable with any MnA shape.
hemomancy:components/blood_to_mana.descr: Drains the target's blood volume and converts it into mana for the caster. The inverse of Sanguine Transmutation.
hemomancy:components/hemolysis.descripti: Applies Hemolysis, a damaging effect that destroys the target's blood over time. Composable with AoE shapes for area denial.
hemomancy:components/mana_to_blood.descr: Converts the caster's mana into blood volume for the target. Useful for refilling blood pools using arcane energy.
Increases breeding and growth of nearby animals with blood magic. Useful on farms and animal pens.
hemomancy:components/summon_sanguilith.d: Summons a Sanguilith at the target location. Requires Harbinger faction membership. Duration and damage scale with spell attributes.
