hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line1: Clarity comes after purity. You quiet the infection first, and then you learn to see without the fever getting in the way.
hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line2: Consecrated copper teaches endurance, I think, or that's how it was explained to me. It changed and oxidized, and then it settled and stayed that way.
hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line3: Once your blood's fully pale, that lesson can stop being a wound and become a halo.
hemomancy.acolyte.absolved.line1: Most of the old red's gone pale now. It's all right to mourn it. A lot of people do.
hemomancy.acolyte.absolved.line2: Let the grief run through clean water and out of you. Whatever's left after that is yours, in a way the blood never was.
hemomancy.acolyte.clarity.line1: The second water's taken you. With your blood this quiet, the rest of the world gets loud. Does it feel like too much, some days?
hemomancy.acolyte.clarity.line2: Sharp sight can still lie to you, and a clear eye can turn merciless without ever noticing it has.
hemomancy.acolyte.cleansing.line1: You're in the long middle now, where the blood's learned to be afraid and frightened things hold on harder.
hemomancy.acolyte.cleansing.line2: When you're in danger, the Silver Veil might settle over you. If it does, I'd take it as an instruction to leave the closing wound alone.
hemomancy.acolyte.corrupted.line1: The first dose opened the wound, and I know it hurts. It hurts because the blood-memory isn't so sure of itself anymore.
hemomancy.acolyte.corrupted.line2: Be careful with it. The old current still answers if you call, and each time you do, it learns your name again.
hemomancy.acolyte.enlightened.line1: §7[The Acolyte bows until their forehead nearly touches their clasped hands]
hemomancy.acolyte.enlightened.line2: I can't always tell if the Lady weeps for joy or as a warning. Among the Unstained it tends to be the same water.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_clarity.line1: You awaken clarity with consecrated copper. After that it deepens through offerings that teach you to perceive things instead of hungering for them, or so I've been taught.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_clarity.line2: Silver chalices help. So does hemolytic plating, and the verdigris rites, if you can stand them. All of it strengthens the halo your purity made room for.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line1: Purity grows when you hold back and show mercy, I think, and through offerings that don't ask anything of blood.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line2: Hemolytic solution starts it. After that it's Lethean flowers and pale dew, sleep, clean labor, and the lives you choose to spare.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line3: Don't rush it, please. If you close a wound too fast, the rot stays under the skin.
hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line1: Our Lady of Still Waters lives wherever a fever breaks, or that's how I was taught to say it. She's got nothing to do with the sky.
hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line2: When the crimson fungus spread through blood and memory, the world fought it the way a body fights an infection. That part I believe without trying.
hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line3: She's that answer with a face on it, and patience. She's defensive, not cruel. And there's someone in the stillness, though I couldn't tell you who.
hemomancy.acolyte.not_on_path.line1: §7[The Acolyte lowers their voice as the church air cools around you]
hemomancy.acolyte.not_on_path.line2: You haven't started the washing yet. Is the blood troubling you? If it is, talk to a Zealot, then bring hemolytic solution to the podium.
hemomancy.acolyte.purified.line1: Your blood's white now, the way bone goes white in winter. The first transformation has set for good.
hemomancy.acolyte.purified.line2: If you want clarity, bring consecrated copper to the podium and let the last crimson habit go quiet. There's no hurry, at least none that I've seen.
hemomancy.acolyte.silver_veil.line1: I think of the Silver Veil as purification's inner skin. It holds the crimson current away from you.
hemomancy.acolyte.silver_veil.line2: Once there's some distance between you and it, you can make your own choice.
hemomancy.acolyte.tainted.line1: The stain's thinning. You might feel hollow in the places where power used to answer you. Are you sleeping all right?
hemomancy.acolyte.tainted.line2: I've come to think of that hollow as room you're getting back.
hemomancy.acolyte.verdigris.line1: Verdigris is what copper turns into after a long exposure. It's changed, but it still does its job, and I like that about it.
hemomancy.acolyte.verdigris.line2: Nobody comes to purity untouched, not even the ones who've been here longest. You get there by surviving the contact honestly.
hemomancy.acolyte.who_are_you.line1: We keep the still water. We're not judges first, or executioners first, though it does come to that sometimes. First we're witnesses to what the infection does to a person.
hemomancy.acolyte.who_are_you.line2: Some of us were Harbingers, and some had Harbingers in the family. A few of us mostly came for the people. Every one of us knows it's easier to inherit the crimson than to get rid of it.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.chisel_lore: The Chisel Station inscribes rune patterns into prepared materials, and each pattern gives its material a specific arcane function. You're at the fourth Degree, so rune crafting's open to you. Learn the patterns before you cut. Every combination gives a different result, and I'd rather you found that out on paper.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.crimson_vessel: At Degree 4, offer your Pallid Vessel and an amethyst shard at a Greater Working floor. Fill its four anchors, awaken the Bastion support sigil it needs, then project into the daemon. The Pallid Vessel goes into the offering, and you won't get it back. What you'll get is the Crimson Vessel: 1,800 mL, and it feeds blood back faster than the white gourd did.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.line1: §7[The Alchemist sets a precision tool down on the bench and turns to you, clearly impressed]
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.line2: Adept. You've shown me you can run the machines. Now I'll show you the stations that work on you.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.lantern.line1: You've been able to build a Mycelial Lantern since the third Degree. Use it now. Keep a culture alive instead of spending every enzyme the moment you find it.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.lantern.line2: Set spores in the culture slot and feed it blood. It'll keep fruiting the matching enzyme for as long as the culture stays in place. Empty the output before it fills up.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.morphlings.lin: A wild Morphling polyp is a living specimen. It doesn't carry any of your instructions, so don't handle it like a puppet.
Bring me a supported polyp in a specimen jar and we'll record what it might become. The Incubator comes later. You don't need it to start observing them, and you don't need to force a fight either.
hemomancy.alchemist.morphling_handling.l: Got an empty Specimen Jar? Capture a wild Morphling Polyp in it and come back with the filled jar in your main hand. If I've already recorded a Polyp for your Bestiary, that study counts.
hemomancy.alchemist.morphling_handling.r: You've brought a Polyp, or I've already got your Bestiary record. Either way I can mark the handling study without taking another specimen.
hemomancy.alchemist.morphling_handling.t: This is field handling. Incubation's later, and that's the Incubator's job.
hemomancy.alchemist.morphling_handling.i: Have the Alchemist inspect your captured Polyp or earlier Bestiary record. You keep the jar and the specimen.
hemomancy.alchemist.morphling_handling.r: The Alchemist records your Morphling handling. You keep the specimen.
hemomancy.vicar.fungal_survey.lead: The gardens grow here in the Overworld, in the wet country where swamp, jungle or mushroom field would otherwise take hold, and that is where I want them surveyed, on foot. You need not cross into the fungal projection for this.
hemomancy.vicar.fungal_survey.visited: You have walked the Overworld gardens already, and since the Alchemist will count that visit, I see no reason to send you a second time on my account.
hemomancy.vicar.fungal_survey.specimens: Bring the Alchemist an Infected Fungus and a Puffball Fungus from your fieldwork so they can be inspected, and know that both specimens stay in your keeping afterward.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.lea: Look for the Erythrocoral Reef in the deep warm seas, where active Voyager vessels work the water, and ask me for a vessel bearing before you set out rather than searching blind. When you find them, speak with a Voyager and bring me back one observation from the crew's work.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.voyager_: Can you give me a vessel bearing?
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.bea: I will search the vessel charts while you go about your work in the Overworld, and send you the bearing once a vessel turns up. If you leave or disconnect before then, ask me again when you return.
The vessel charts are in use just now. Ask me for your bearing again shortly.
The charts of this world give me no vessel routes to read, so you will have to find a Voyager working an Erythrocoral Reef yourself.

There is a Voyager vessel in the Overworld near X %s, Z %s. Find the crew and record one observation by asking about their work, because knowing where a ship lies isn't the same as watching it work, and the record will not count it as an observation.
The charts show no Voyager vessel in the waters I searched, so either ask again at a different Overworld outpost or go looking for a Voyager working an Erythrocoral Reef yourself.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.obs: You have spoken with a Voyager in the reef waters already. What did you see? There's no need to sail out again just so the introduction can be made properly.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.tas: A reef or an active vessel will do, and I am not asking you to bring back a whale, ambergris or any other trophy.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.rep: Report the reef observation you recorded with the Voyager.
hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.rec: The Vicar records your Voyager observation and files it with the field reports.
hemomancy.vicar.circus_referral.lead: Have you heard of the company of Harbingers who call themselves the Circus? Their pavilion is a stranger place than any performance hall, and whether you visit it is up to you.
hemomancy.vicar.circus_referral.discover: You found the Circus before I could send you, so what you saw there counts, and I won't make you walk the road again just so I can call it an introduction.
hemomancy.vicar.circus_referral.mnemonis: Speak with the Mnemonist about their practice, and ask them for a Scarlet Waybill if you need a route back. Your next Degree does not depend on anything you do at the pavilion.
hemomancy.alchemist.deep_dark_commission: I've got a Deep Dark commission for you. You don't need my permission to go down there, but ask me for a bearing before you leave. A sculk catalyst or a Warden can yield Ahaematic colloid. Whichever you sample, put it under a Hematic Microscope. It isn't ordinary blood.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.deep: Can you give me a Deep Dark bearing?
hemomancy.alchemist.deep_dark_commission: There's Deep Dark terrain in the Overworld near X %s, Y %s, Z %s. Find a safe way down and look for a sculk catalyst. You don't need to fight a Warden. That bearing marks a region, so don't count on a safe entrance or a Vigil archive there.
I can't find Deep Dark terrain within 2,048 blocks of here. That doesn't mean there's none farther out, so try asking from another Overworld outpost.
Ask me for a Deep Dark bearing while you're in the Overworld. From here I can't line your position up with anything underground there.
You've already examined an Ahaematic sample, or carried that analysis into the later replay. I'm not sending you back down for a second one just to open a commission.
So what did the sample show? The Vigil Beneath and its recordings are a separate inquiry, and this report won't close them.
Report the Ahaematic analysis to the Alchemist. You keep the sample.
The Alchemist records your Ahaematic findings. You keep the sample, and the Vigil inquiry is still yours to finish.
hemomancy.alchemist.phlegethontic_commis: There are basins of dark ichor in the Nether, banked with blackstone and growth that looks alive. To me the place reads as nearly organic. That's my interpretation, though, and I wouldn't write it down as fact about the Nether.
Basin creature? Good. Bring enough Scyphus to show me and I'll compare the sample against the local growth.

I need blood from an Excoriated or Phlegethontic Bombardier, plus five Escharian Scyphus you've gathered yourself. Sample, then sneak-use the Living Syringe to eject its rack. Use the rack on an idle Vial Centrifuge and remove the vial without spinning it. Hold that vial in your main hand when you show me. I'll inspect it and give everything back. This is field work, not my permission to enter the Nether.
Show the Alchemist the Basin blood sample and five Scyphus. Nothing is used up.
The Alchemist records the Basin comparison and returns the sample and all five Scyphus.
Taking the Nether position that lines up with yours, there's a Basin about %s blocks %s. Look for banks of blackstone around dark ichor.
I can't find a Basin within about 8,000 Nether blocks of your aligned position. Ask again from another Nether reach.
I can't line up a Nether bearing from the End. Ask me again from the Overworld or the Nether.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory_le: A Cortical Drift in the outer End holds a hollow Vagrant Mind. Go inside and study the nerve web. Bring me an account of memory organized outside a familiar body. I have no use for a trophy from its resident.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory_fo: Now that you have stood inside the Mind, describe what held its nerve web together. I don't need a piece of it.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory.pr: Give the Mnemonist your account of the Vagrant Mind. It costs you no memory slot and earns you none.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.memory_re: The Mnemonist records your account. Your memory loadout and its costs stay as they were.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.biology_l: Visit the Vagrant Mind, then go watch a Choir Keeper, a Myelin Borer, or some living chorus growth out in the End. I'm after the living system around the Mind. I don't want a list of kills.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.biology_r: You've seen the Mind and something alive around its network. Tell me what you found. The Mnemonist can take a separate report on that same visit.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.biology.p: Report the Mind visit and the biology you watched nearby. You hand over no specimen.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.biology_r: The Alchemist records your field observation. If you haven't reported to the Mnemonist yet, their inquiry is still open.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.bearing: I've placed a likely Vagrant Mind in the outer End near X %s, Z %s. Find the Cortical Drift around it and follow its nerve bridges.
hemomancy.vagrant_mind_inquiry.bearing_m: I can't find a Vagrant Mind in the part of the outer End I searched. Travel farther among the outer islands and ask again.
hemomancy.voyager.introduction.prompt: Tell the Voyager what you noticed about the reef's response to the current.
hemomancy.voyager.introduction.observed: The Voyager records your observation. The Vicar can hear the field report when you return.
hemomancy.alchemist.fungal_survey.visit: Go observe the Fungal Gardens in the Overworld first. The projection garden's somewhere else entirely, and it won't tell me anything about the local growth.
hemomancy.alchemist.fungal_survey.specim: I've recorded your visit. When you report, carry an Infected Fungus and a Puffball Fungus. I'll look them over and hand them back untouched.
hemomancy.alchemist.fungal_survey.ready: Habitat seen, both specimens on you? Then I can record the comparison now.
hemomancy.alchemist.fungal_survey.report: Show both specimens for inspection. You keep them.
hemomancy.alchemist.fungal_survey.record: The Alchemist records the Overworld survey and hands both plants back.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.scar_station_l: Treat the Cerebral Scarring Station as a surgical instrument that happens to look like a crafting bench. You carve sacred patterns into blank scar plates with a knapper. Once a carved scar's burned into memory at an Iron Brazier, its pattern opens new neural and venous pathways in the mind, and that changes which manipulations you can sustain and how strongly your tendencies express themselves.
hemomancy.alchemist.apotheos.line1: §4[The Alchemist stops working and stares at you for a long moment, awed and a little unsteady on their feet.]
hemomancy.alchemist.apotheos.line2: Apotheos. I can't measure what your blood's turned into. The machines still run, though. If you left anything unfinished, I'll help with it.
hemomancy.alchemist.apotheos.reflection: §oI spent my life believing the Alembic, the Centrifuge, the Loom and the Incubator were the end of it, the summit of hemomantic engineering. I was wrong. §4§oYou§r are the summit. I thought I was building machines. I was building toward you.
hemomancy.alchemist.archon.line1: §4[The Alchemist straightens instinctively and bows their head]
hemomancy.alchemist.archon.line2: Archon. The workshop's still open to you. Anything that needs preparing or repairing?
hemomancy.alchemist.clarity.line1: §7[The Alchemist looks straight through you, then goes back to their work without a word]
hemomancy.alchemist.first_separation.bri: Two loose Blood Vials. If they don't fit, I'll hold them until you've made room. Left-click a cow with each one, and don't worry, the vial cancels the hit. Set both samples in opposing Centrifuge slots and recover the Vivacious Enzyme. Then come back for a Living Syringe and a vial rack, and after that I'll teach you the Ghastly Alembic.
hemomancy.alchemist.first_separation.com: The enzyme held its shape. Good. Here's your Living Syringe and vial rack, and whatever doesn't fit waits until you've got space. Next, run one ordinary Ghastly Alembic distillation to the end and take the result out. Come back once you have and I'll prepare your Concentrated Blood.
hemomancy.alchemist.first_separation.off: The Vicar's already tested your hand with blood. Now I'd like to see what you can separate from a living sample.

I call it the First Separation. Draw two samples from cattle, balance the vials opposite each other in a Vial Centrifuge, and recover whatever Vivacious Enzyme survives the spin. Say yes and I'll hand you the empty vials.
hemomancy.alchemist.first_draws.offer: Before you touch the Centrifuge, learn to take a clean sample. I'll give you five empty Blood Vials, and any that don't fit wait until you've made room. Left-click ordinary animals with them until you've got five samples from at least three species: cattle, pigs, sheep, chickens, rabbits, or goats. Keep the filled vials. You'll want them later. Run short? A glass bottle and redstone dust make another Blood Vial.
hemomancy.alchemist.first_draws.progress: How many species so far? Keep drawing from common animals. Five samples across three species gives you a set worth putting in the Centrifuge. Your next Degree's still the Vicar's call, through the bloodcraft proof.
hemomancy.alchemist.enzyme_uses.brewing: In an ordinary brewing stand, Vivacious makes Regeneration and Fervent makes Fire Resistance. Neurotic gives Swiftness, Incandescent gives Night Vision, Ruinous gives Poison, Frigid gives Slowness and Ferric gives Strength. Umbral turns Night Vision into Invisibility.
hemomancy.alchemist.enzyme_uses.culture: From Degree 3 you can combine an enzyme with a Spore Sac and Hyphal Substrate to get its matching culture. Put that culture in a Mycelial Lantern and it'll keep fruiting the same enzyme, at 600 blood over 2,400 ticks.
hemomancy.alchemist.enzyme_uses.workshop: Put together, that's your first living workshop. The Centrifuge finds an expression and the culture preserves it. A Gourdvine Tap can supply the Lantern, though you'll still have to gather blood yourself.
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.incubato: The Morphling Incubator raises cultivated fungal symbionts under controlled conditions. A wild polyp could go several ways. Incubation makes one strain stable enough to live with you.
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.ashen_ve: At Degree 5, offer the Crimson Vessel and a ghast tear at a Greater Working floor. Fill its four anchors, awaken the Bastion support sigil it needs, then project into the daemon. The Crimson Vessel's used up in the offering, and the black gourd you get holds 3,500 mL. Your reserve's bigger, but it'll feed blood back slower than the red one did.
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus. Not many make the Crimson Lodge. The machines you'll work with now run on principles the uninitiated would call impossible. I'd call them badly documented.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.line1: Initiate. Good. You're ready for the Somatic Loom now, and most of this Outpost's advanced processes run through it.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.loom_lore: The Somatic Loom is a physical rite with a machine attached. Prepare a blank vessel and the catalyst, store the enzyme colors it calls for and project blood, and an engram unfurls on the ground around it. Use the Living Staff to thread each of the memory's fragments home along its star, and watch for the false ones. What the memory means is the Mnemonist's department. To build one, raise its frame beside a Cardinal Focus on a Lesser Working floor. The floor takes the frame and forges the Loom.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.memory_weav: The Mnemonist will give you the long version. Here's the short one: the Loom writes the manipulation into the memory, so it's finished before it ever reaches the Reliquary. The Reliquary only picks which of the ones you know are active.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.mnemonist_b: You've cataloged enough red expression to move on. Take a blank vessel to the Mnemonist. They'll show you how a memory gets made ready before the Loom writes anything into it.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.pallid_vess: At Degree 3, offer one Dried Gourd in a lit brazier at a Lesser Working floor of bone blocks and polished Venous Stone Bricks. Leave the Focus empty. Plant your Living Staff. Fill the four anchors with Blood Projection, then project into the daemon. You won't need a helper, a support sigil or an ordeal for this one. The white gourd holds 1,000 mL and doesn't count toward your Degree 2 proof. You'll raise machines on the same floor: build the Somatic Loom's frame beside the Focus, seat a Sanguine Formation, light its braziers and feed the frame, and the floor swallows it and forges the Loom.
Put the gourd in the Ghastly Alembic's blood-output slot and it'll draw from the reservoir. This first vessel holds 1,000 mL. Saving blood for a later working? Keep it corked.

Fit the gourd in the Scarlet Vanity's gourd slot, or just carry it in your pack. Open, it feeds blood back into your own reserve. Corked, it doesn't. Red comes at Degree 4, Black at Degree 5, the Curved Horn at Degree 6.
hemomancy.alchemist.gourd_use.fill: Put a corked gourd in the Ghastly Alembic's blood-output slot, let it fill from the reservoir, then take it back out. The gourd keeps its own separate reserve. It won't make your body hold any more blood than it did. Fit it in the Scarlet Vanity's gourd slot, or carry it in your pack.
hemomancy.alchemist.gourd_use.withdraw: Use the gourd in your hand to open or cork it. Once it's equipped, use Toggle Gourd Open/Closed, normally H. While it's open, it feeds stored blood back whenever your own reserve's low and your blood is active. Cork it to stop. Empty the old vessel before you offer it for an upgrade. Red comes at Degree 4, Black at Degree 5, the Curved Horn at Degree 6.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_hint: What are you carrying? Show me and I'll tell you which of it belongs on my bench.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.barbed_: The Barbed Blade's barbs have living extensions that draw blood on contact, and every hit returns a little to the wielder's reserve. Not much per hit. Over a long fight it adds up.
It's better at gathering than killing. Carry it when you need to fight and refill your reserve at the same time. Does the target have to die quickly? Then pick something else.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blaze_p: Blaze powder, a volatile combustion compound out of the Nether. The Alembic reads its ignition chemistry as a good Flammeus tendency input and strips it down into Fervent Enzyme concentrate, and that's what you'd want it for.
Careful how you carry it. Friction alone can set it off. Keep it dry, keep it away from blood vials, and don't let it near open flame until you mean to use it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_c: A blood crystal shard is a fragment of crystallized sanguine energy, less pure than a full formation, but it'll still work as a lower-tier Alembic input or a supplementary ingredient.
Hang on to them. The Alembic takes them at a reduced yield, so don't waste a run on a handful. Save up enough for a batch worth running.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_g: The blood gourd's your main storage vessel, and you'll upgrade it as your initiation goes deeper. More room in it means a deeper reserve, and that means longer casting.
White, Red, then Black. Each tier holds more. White's only where you start, so don't get attached.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_v: An empty Blood Vial draws a sample when you left-click a living creature, and it doesn't hurt the creature. Thick-skinned creatures and NPCs need the Living Syringe and its vial rack instead.
Balance the sampled vials in the Centrifuge, then recover whatever enzyme separates out. That's the whole process.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.bloody_: A Bloody Flask is a portable reserve. It's no part of the syringe-and-rack assay.
Use it when blood has to travel. Machines take either vessel as red fluid.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.brewing: A brewing stand is what common practitioners distill with. Its water-and-base process gives blunt biological responses. It's the Alembic's rough ancestor, the way boiling meat over a fire comes before learning to cook.

The stand gets you threshold effects. The Alembic makes precise tendency concentrates. Both distill, but the Alembic resolves the result more finely, and knowing your way around a stand won't teach you what the Alembic's doing.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.chalybe: Iron sulfide in a living skirt. A ridiculous phrase, and yet the snail makes it work.
Knap it while the creature is withdrawn. If you have to kill it for scraps, you've already botched the material.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.cleansi: Cleansing hemolymph is a blue-tinted lytic fluid you'll get from Hemolymphopoda and Ice Fish, and its circulatory chemistry works against standard blood-matrix compounds.
As a lytic agent it's efficient and stable. What other people use it for isn't my concern.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.dendrit: The Dendritic Distributor saves the arrangement of a whole manipulation loadout as a remembered neural pattern. You learn the memories somewhere else. This station just keeps them in order.
Saving a pattern or writing over one costs blood and raw experience. The nervous lattice holds three patterns to start with, and you'll open more with deeper synaptic discipline.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.dicentr: Dicentra sap is Bleeding Heart fluid prepared the old way. These days the Order prefers the intact bulb, but if you've got old stores, they can still be rendered into usable reagent mass.
Turned up sealed sap in old stores? Distill it into Bleeding Bulbs before it goes anywhere near a modern hemomantic formula.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.enzyme_: Ferric Enzyme, from the Ferric tendency, the iron one. That's blood that conducts, reinforces and binds structure. Ferric manipulations use it to harden the body and channel energy with precision.
It concentrates out of metallic or mineral-dense organic compounds. Its conductivity's measured, so it's the one to reach for when a recipe wants a stable metallic reagent.
Fervent Enzyme, Flammeus tendency. Flammeus is combustion: heat, ignition, volatile pressure. Fervent manipulations channel blood-heat outward.
Distill combustible compounds in the Alembic, then put the enriched output through the centrifuge.
Frigid Enzyme, Congeatio tendency. Congeatio is stasis: blood gone cold, slow and crystalline. Frigid manipulations immobilize, preserve and hold things still.
Run materials that naturally preserve or resist cold through the Alembic and you'll get Congeatio.
Incandescent Enzyme, Lux tendency. Lux is radiance: blood carrying light, illusory force and distorted perception. Incandescent manipulations bend what can be seen.
Lux concentrates out of luminescent organic materials, so that's what you'll run through the Alembic.
Neurotic Enzyme, Ductilis tendency. Nerve impulse, acceleration, transmission and motion, in a form chemistry can read.
Need blood to carry a signal rather than hold a shape? That's where it goes in a recipe.
Ruinous Enzyme, Mortem tendency. Mortem is entropy, blood that breaks things down, dissolves them and ends them. Ruinous manipulations speed up decay and sap vitality.
Mortem concentrates from decomposing organic material in the Alembic. The Covenant is wary of it, and it's right to be.
Umbral Enzyme, Tenebris tendency. Tenebris is shadow, blood pulled away from light and into concealment, and Umbral manipulations suppress visibility and dull perception.
You'll get Tenebris out of materials with a natural affinity for darkness when you run them through the Alembic.

Vivacious Enzyme, Animus tendency. Animus is life-force, the movement and vitality behind a body's will to keep going. Its manipulations speed healing, make you physically faster and keep the body working under strain.
Distill organic life-force materials in the Alembic first, then run the enriched blood samples through the Vial Centrifuge, and that's where it comes out.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.erythro: Cut it cleanly and it stays useful. Tear it apart and you mostly get wet pulp with ambitions.
The reef grows in beds, so you'll want to work it like a garden instead of quarrying it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.foul_pa: Foul Paste is a dense binding substrate made from organic material. Keep it sealed, and don't use more than the recipe measures out.
The Alembic makes it from particular organic inputs. Keep a steady supply going, because every interruption wastes reagent.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.fungal_: The Fungal Implantation Pylon installs one cultivated fungal scar, and it can later replace that scar or remove it. The number of fungal slots doesn't change.
At Degree 4, raise its frame beside a Cardinal Focus on a Lesser Working floor, seat Hyphal Substrate in the Focus and feed the frame until the floor takes it.
The implantation pylon is Degree 4 scar work. Cultivate the fungal scar first, and don't build the station until you can use it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.ghastly: The Ghastly Alembic is the first machine in a Harbinger's toolkit. Raw organic inputs go in, and it'll distill them into concentrated alchemical compounds.
Blood vials, enriched extracts and foul paste all come out of the Alembic, and everything downstream depends on what you feed it. That's why you'll learn its inputs first.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.glass_b: A glass bottle's a common alchemical vessel. It holds liquid and seals well enough, right up until pressure shatters it, and it can't match a blood vial's calibrated volume.
Use it for unstabilized material that's got no business in a blood vial. Blood distillation, processing and tendency work go in the proper vessel.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.glowsto: Glowstone dust is a luminescent mineral compound from the Nether. In the Alembic its light chemistry counts as a good Lux tendency input, and it strips down into Incandescent Enzyme concentrate.
The Incandescent Enzyme yield is good and the extraction runs clean, with very little waste. For Lux tendency work it's one of the most reliable conventional inputs you'll find.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.hematic: Hematic iron scrap is a by-product of smelting iron that's been saturated in blood for a long time. The metal takes up trace blood compounds and comes out fire resistant, with more tensile strength and a slight conductivity to blood energy.
Smelt the scrap into ingots before you use it. Scrap is chemically unstable, and it's the ingot that holds those useful properties steady.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.hemolyt: Hemolytic solution is a lytic compound that breaks blood matrices down at the cellular level. Blood-afflicted organisms depend on that matrix for their structure, and that's why it works on them.
How's it made? By a different process from standard blood distillation. It works. That's all I've got to say about it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.iron_in: Ordinary iron won't obey blood. You learn Hematic Iron through Blood Projection and recover it through the Order's salvage practices, and standing an ingot next to a dramatic furnace does nothing for it.
Use the blood-structure plan, or salvage damaged iron the proven way. Heat alone won't make the metal obey you.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.living_: The Living Syringe draws a controlled specimen into an empty vial in your rack. It reaches blood a loose vial can't, thick-skinned creatures and NPCs included.
It's a sampling instrument first. Violence with it is misuse.
This is biological instruction prepared for a Living Staff. I can tell you whether it's materially stable. The rite belongs to the Redwright.
Ask the Artificer how the Iron Brazier and Blood Absorption get the staff to accept the limb-pattern. That's his rite, not mine.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.minecra: Common apparatus, and still worth reading properly. Its shape, heat tolerance and residue tell me what work it'll survive.
Bring it to a bench when a formula calls for it. Knowing it well doesn't give it any hemomantic purpose.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.mnemoni: The Mnemonic Reliquary sorts the bodily and willed memories you already know into your active set. I'd call it a loadout, and the Mnemonist wouldn't.
What you can do comes from the memory item, not the Reliquary. The Reliquary only picks which of the ones you know are active.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.morphli: The Morphling Incubator stabilizes cultivated fungal symbionts. They're still living dependents, and they keep their own nature.
What develops depends on the strain, the enzyme and your husbandry. The Incubator only sets the conditions. Whatever grows in it still has its own nature, and it won't ask your permission.
The Morphling Incubator is past your current initiation. You'll need the fifth Degree.
Sunburst feeds on sunlight through an alga it keeps in its tissue. Wear it under open sky and it covers its own upkeep.
Under a roof it costs blood like any other strain. Watch what it does when someone near you is failing. It feeds them before it looks after you.
Holdfast grips stone. Stand on it, or get underwater, and you're hard to shift.
It won't plate you. It holds you in place and shelters whoever's behind you. Sneak into a hit and see how it braces.
Mermaid's Purse banks blood from your strikes and spends it on whoever's bleeding worst. That includes you.
It feeds best at speed. Sprint-swim before you strike and the yield goes up by half. Bring company. It likes a school.
Dead Man's Rope throws strands. They catch your falls, and from Mature you can tie one to an ally or a block.
Either end can let go. Have you tried reeling yourself toward a block anchor? It's a decent grapple for a fungus.
Ink Cap hides you. Hostiles notice you later, and in the dark or underwater they notice you a good deal later.
At Apex it'll spend 500 mL to keep you alive once and cover your exit in ink. It's for getting away. Don't try to ambush anything with it.
Hushbell conserves. You get hungry more slowly, you lose air more slowly, and poison doesn't take.
Stand still and it hardens. Take a bad hit and it folds shut around you for a few seconds. You can't act while it's shut, so plan for that.
Marrowplume feeds on bone and on what a fight leaves. Near bone blocks, or right after a kill, it heals you faster.
From Apex, kills may yield more, and always a bone. Players, bosses and spawner stock are excluded, before you ask.
Kinbud stings, and it regrows part of every wound you take over the next ten seconds.
Keep it near heat and it works harder. The second head is still your body, not a summon. Don't expect it to take orders.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.nether_: Nether Wart is the usual base catalyst in common brewing. In the Alembic its organic structure binds volatile distillations that would otherwise throw off waste compounds.
In the Alembic it's a process stabilizer, not a brewing base. Getting erratic or unstable output from a run? Add it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.recycle: Recycled Enzyme is salvage-grade reagent, and it's weaker and less specific than a fresh separation.
Dismantle a learned memory and you won't get any enzyme back. The modern Loom keeps what it weaves.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.redston: Redstone is the standard energy conductor in applied mechanics. Its mineral chemistry carries blood-mineral signatures, and the Alembic reads those as Ferric tendency input, so the conduction properties carry straight over.
Ferric conducts, reinforces and channels energy with precision, and redstone does much the same job in mechanical systems. That's why the Alembic processes it that way.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.refusal: I know what that is. I'm not teaching blood-work to a vessel that's deliberately washing its blood away.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.salt_st: Field logs are full of errors, and some of them are worth having. Someone tested reef tissue, vent scale and seawater in the same alembic and lived long enough to write annoyed corrections.
Treat any sample from that wreck as contaminated by both salt and devotion.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.sanguin: Sanguine formation is crystallized blood mineral. Project blood into an empty cauldron and, given time, the blood condenses into it.
In a bare cauldron the shape sometimes slumps back to nothing. Raise the cauldron through the Vicar's Working rites and it'll hold more, set faster and lose none.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.scar_bl: A blank Scar item is stock for the Cerebral Scarring Station, and the pattern and catalyst decide which route gets carved into it.

Once it's carved, put the Scar item in an empty Iron Brazier, light it with Blood Projection, then hold Blood Absorption on the offering to learn the route for 100 mL. It goes in the Brazier, not on your body.
Blank scar plates aren't any use to you yet. The Cerebral Scarring Station opens at the fourth Degree.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.scar_st: The Cerebral Scarring Station carves a route into a blank Scar item, working from a dynamic template and its catalyst.
The station only makes the instruction. Getting it into your practice is the Vein-Mason's business: their rite, the Effigy and the Brazier.
The Cerebral Scarring Station opens at the fourth Degree. Come back when you're there.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.slime_b: Slime's sticky elasticity looks a lot like Ductilis. Does that matter? Not unless a working recipe calls for it.
Use it where a recipe calls for it. Resemblance alone won't get you anything out of a centrifuge.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.somatic: The Somatic Loom takes a blank Hematic Memory, the exact catalyst, stored enzyme units, and projected blood.

Once the blood's paid, the engram spreads across the floor with its fragments waiting at the points of a star. Use the Living Staff to thread each one home along the star's lines. Every step spins out a span of enzyme thread, so a tidy route costs you less.
You're not far enough into your initiation for the Somatic Loom. Come back at the third Degree.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.specime: That's a sealed living specimen. I can tell you what's in there. The jar hasn't made it harmless, though.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.spore_s: A concentrated fungal specimen. Keep it sealed tight, because dry doesn't mean dead.
Use it in fungal recipes and cultures. At Degree 4, Hyphal Substrate seated in a Cardinal Focus lets a Working floor forge a Fungal Implantation Pylon.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.unknown: That's outside what I work with. Ask someone else.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.vial_ce: The Vial Centrifuge separates properly sampled blood into one of the eight enzyme expressions.
Load opposed slots so they balance. Each completed spin adds 250 mL to the reservoir. Reclaim it with Blood Absorption on the machine.
hemomancy.alchemist.living_bestiary.intr: The Red Taxonomy covers rooted things, and the Living Bestiary gets everything that tries to leave the jar.
Bring me Hemomancy fauna in specimen jars. I'll record the creature and give it back, or keep the specimen for dissection and compensate you for it.
Got an empty jar? Use it on a Chitinite and you'll see how capture works. Rooted specimens don't go in a jar, so bring those to me by hand.
hemomancy.alchemist.bloodwood_lesson.lin: Bloodwood starts as an ordinary Dead Bush. Project your active blood into it until it's taken 900 mL. You don't have to do it in one cast.
Where are you planting it? Open ground, with room: the trunk and canopy need replaceable space up to five blocks out and eight blocks above the bush.
hemomancy.alchemist.living_bestiary.morp: Wild Morphling Polyps haven't settled into a strain yet. Where one grows decides which partner organisms it's picked up, and the partner decides the strain.
Surrender a captured polyp and you get a matching wild-bound morphling. It's useful, but it stays capped until an Incubator stabilizes it.
hemomancy.alchemist.machines_overview: Learn them in order: the Centrifuge separates sampled blood, the Alembic distills reagents, and the Loom's where prepared memories get woven. Each machine assumes you survived the one before it.
hemomancy.alchemist.preparations.title: What should I make in the Alembic now?
hemomancy.alchemist.preparations.unbrief: You might've distilled a tincture already during your second-Degree work. Body Answers comes after First Separation, and its first preparation is Sanguine Fists, which is a tincture, not a Loom-woven memory.
hemomancy.alchemist.preparations.briefed: I gave you Sanguine Formation, Fervent Enzyme and a Bloody Flask for Body Answers. Already distilled the tincture? Then drink it and you're done. There's no need to brew it again.
hemomancy.alchemist.preparations.complet: You've drunk the first tincture, so Body Answers is done. The other seven Thelemic preparations use the same base formula, each with its own aligned enzyme.
hemomancy.alchemist.preparations.alembic: Distill Sanguine Formation in the base Alembic with the aligned enzyme as catalyst. The blood comes out of the stored tank, and the tincture needs somewhere to go, so put an empty clay flask or jug in the lower-right container input. You'll qualify for the Condenser at the fourth Degree and the Athanor at the sixth, and they both upgrade the same Alembic.
hemomancy.alchemist.preparations.capacit: A tincture teaches your body a Thelemic memory. It goes in the Reliquary next to what the Mnemonist calls your Noetic memories, and they share one active capacity. If you want to weave a Noetic memory on purpose, that's the Loom's job.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.alembic_lea: They're good tools, but they do leak. Shame nobody's found a use for the waste. §7[The Alchemist stops there and looks pointedly at a slab of venous stone and a shard of yellowed bone on the workbench, then goes back to the vessels.]
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.alembic_lor: The Ghastly Alembic is Votary work. You'll start on the Vial Centrifuge, and until you can sample blood, balance the rack and separate one answer cleanly, you've got no business attempting distillation.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.blood_gourd: You'll want a blood gourd later, but the Vicar's first bloodcraft proof doesn't need one. Can you absorb and project blood yet? Learn that first, and we'll talk about a vessel once you can use it.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.centrifuge_: The Vial Centrifuge comes after the Vicar grants you Degree 2. Until then, find out what Blood Absorption and Projection can make in your own hands.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.line1: §7[The Alchemist nods with approval as you approach]
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.line2: A Neophyte. Your bloodcraft proof and the second Degree are the Vicar's business. Mine's smaller: draw a few clean samples from ordinary animals and hang on to them, because you'll want them for the Centrifuge later.
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.explain: §7[The Alchemist doesn't look up]§r There's nothing to explain. Blood knowledge takes commitment, and every hour you spend on that path is an hour you aren't learning these machines. I'm busy. Good day.
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.line1: §7[The Alchemist glances up from their work, looks you over for a moment, and turns back to their instruments, face blank]
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.line2: I don't have time to teach someone who won't use what I teach. The path you're on leads away from everything these machines can do for you. So where do you stand? Come back when you've decided.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.bleedin: Bleeding Heart is a flower that's borrowed the shape of the body's vessels, which tells you the blood-memory's learned floral anatomy.
See the hanging wound-shape? That's vascular mimicry. The plant's copied the outline of an injury with no idea what grief is.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.devils_: Devil's Tooth is a defensive fruiting expression. Its exudate looks like blood, and under stress it'll start behaving like blood too.
Between the caustic secretion and the tooth-shaped pressure, the warning's plain enough: the infection wants the world's hands kept off it.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.infecte: Infected Fungus is the baseline sample, ordinary fungal tissue that's been taught to carry hemomantic instruction.
It's common, and that's what makes it useful, since it shows you what the blood-fungus does when it's got nothing to prove.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.intro.l: You're a Votary now, so I need field samples from you instead of obedient answers. Bring me blood-touched fungi or near-fungal flora.
Any order is fine: Infected Fungus, Stinkhorn, Sarcodes, Bleeding Heart, Rafflesia, Devil's Tooth, and Puffball as a control. I'll catalog each one as it comes in.
Whatever's left over sorts into three lanes. Bleeding Heart and Sarcodes make Bleeding Bulbs. Infected Fungus, Stinkhorn and Devil's Tooth make Foul Paste, and Puffball and Rafflesia make Spore Sacs.
A sampled Fungling also separates into Infected Fungus. Mix Foul Paste into a log for Infested Wood, then keep the space above it empty and dark so the culture can grow.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.spec: Can I take two jars to start?
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.puffbal: Puffball is the control. It's less dramatic and less devotional, which is why it's useful.
An assay needs contrast. If every specimen on the bench is screaming, how would you know what a whisper sounds like?
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.raffles: Rafflesia is theft on an architectural scale, a bloom living off a body it never meant to repay.
Seen the size of it? Give a small parasite enough appetite and enough patience and it'll turn into a structure.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.sarcode: Sarcodes feeds through networks it didn't build. Elegant and unpleasant, and frankly very Harbinger.
It reads another system well enough to make that system feed it. That's parasitism as a kind of literacy.
hemomancy.alchemist.red_taxonomy.stinkho: Stinkhorn turns dispersal into an attack, using smell to carry the blood-fungus where claws can't.
The blood-fungus doesn't need claws. A carrier that'll walk toward the wrong scent can be enough, and there's never a shortage of those.
hemomancy.alchemist.sanctified.final_mac: At this point the machines run as one process. The Alembic feeds the Centrifuge, the Centrifuge calibrates the Loom, and the Loom unlocks new rune patterns. Can you run every station? Then you can work in the full language of hemomancy.
hemomancy.alchemist.sanctified.curved_ho: At Degree 6, offer the black gourd with dragon's breath on a Grand Working floor, with the required Hematic Iron Pillars in place. Fill its four anchors, wake the required Bastion support sigil, then project into the daemon. The horn's a fast 1,500 mL burst vessel, and it won't raise your capacity any further. If the rite succeeds, you'll lose the earlier vessel and the pillars.
hemomancy.alchemist.sanctified.line1: Sanctified. You're at the threshold of the Hematic Order, and the machines have given you everything they can for now. What's left is the final synthesis.
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.line1: §7[A figure in fitted work robes looks up from a crowded rig of vessels and tubing and looks you over carefully]
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.line2: A newcomer. I'm the Harbinger Alchemist. I keep this Outpost's machines and processes running, and my work's making blood do something useful. You aren't initiated, so these mechanisms would be wasted on you.
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.machines: These machines respond to blood that's been refined through the Covenant's rites. Earn your first Degree and I'll teach you what each one does.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.alembic_lore: You can study the Ghastly Alembic now. It distills plants, fungi and creature matter into defined reagents. Will a batch answer cleanly? That depends on the fire, the state of the vessel and the recipe.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.centrifuge_lo: The Vial Centrifuge does the first separation: sampled vials go in balanced and come out as one of eight enzyme expressions. At your Degree you've also got the Ghastly Alembic, which opens up the wider work of reagent distillation.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.gourd_upgrade: Your gourd should keep pace with you. Upgrade it whenever your rites allow and don't stop after the first one, because a stronger vessel means deeper reserves, steadier casting and fewer desperate choices when your blood runs thin. You'll be doing this for as long as you advance.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.line1: Votary. Your blood tendency's starting to take shape, and the Vial Centrifuge will show you why that matters.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.tendency_lore: Eight tendencies answer through the enzymes: Vivacious, Fervent, Neurotic, Incandescent, Ruinous, Frigid, Ferric, and Umbral. Neurotic's the one that carries impulse and motion, whatever the name suggests.
hemomancy.altar.already_blessed: The altar has already blessed you. Our Lady's tears flow only once.
hemomancy.altar.blessed: §bThe Tears of Silthmere wash over the altar, and silver light floods your veins as Our Lady's blessing purifies you.
hemomancy.altar.brew_offered: §7The altar's flame consumes the Lethean Brew. Memories fade and your purity grows.
hemomancy.altar.brew_exhausted: §7The altar has drawn all it can from your Lethean Brew offerings.
hemomancy.altar.chalice_offered: §bThe silver chalice rings with a pure tone, and your clarity deepens.
hemomancy.altar.chalice_already_offered: §7Your silver chalice offering has already been accepted.
hemomancy.altar.wreath_already_offered: §7Your Lethean Poppy Wreath offering has already been accepted.
hemomancy.altar.clarity_not_unlocked: The chalice resonates, but you haven't unlocked clarity yet.
hemomancy.altar.icon_already_offered: The altar has already accepted a Pallid Icon from you. Its power flows only once.
hemomancy.altar.icon_offered: §bThe Pallid Icon blazes with silver fire on the altar, and clarity surges through you.
hemomancy.altar.lore: §7A cool mist rises from the stone. You sense Our Lady of Still Waters close by.
hemomancy.altar.not_on_path: The altar stays silent. Only those on the Unstained path can hear it.
hemomancy.altar.wreath_offered: §7The Lethean poppies wilt on the altar as the stone draws in their essence. Your purity rises.
hemomancy.anchorite.carve_reminder.line1: The pattern is not yet flesh. Set it in the Cerebral Scarring Station. Follow its grid cell by cell.
hemomancy.anchorite.carve_reminder.line2: Load Pattern shows a purple stencil. Trace those cells in red, then Carve. A rejected carving keeps your work. Place the carved Scar in an empty, lit Iron Brazier with ordinary use. Blood Projection lights an unlit Brazier for 50 mL. Then hold Blood Absorption on the Scar. Learning it costs 100 mL. The old template alone will not teach it.
hemomancy.anchorite.completed.line1: There. The wound has become architecture.
hemomancy.anchorite.completed.line2: More patterns will answer you now. Each one should be weighed before the cut. Know what it opens in the body and what it closes.
hemomancy.anchorite.effigy_instruction.l: The scar is known now. The Mason's Effigy arranges scars your blood already remembers. Whoever charges a motif must know all its scars and have room for them.

Craft Runic Motif Paper from Paper, Charcoal, and Sanguine Formation. At the Mason's Effigy, choose your known scar and press Prepare. Place the paper and project 500 mL per scar. Selection stays fixed while charging. You may stop and resume. Breaking the Effigy returns its paper, not spent blood. Carry the prepared Pattern to the Brazier. Only the Brazier commits it.
hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.given.l: The pattern lays a route. Power moves when a scar carries it.

Carve the Scar item first. Then burn it. Only then may the Mason's Effigy prepare a living motif. Until you learn your first scar, you may use a nearby Scarring Station while I watch. Every other pattern needs a station you built with your own hand.
hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.line1: They call me the Vein-Mason. I teach vessels where to remember breaking. Then I mend them around that memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.line2: Your strongest tendency has chosen the first cut. Take its old Scar Pattern. Carve it at the Cerebral Scarring Station.
hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.line3: Blank plate, catalyst, knapper, pattern. After the carving, an empty, lit Iron Brazier decides whether the scar can become memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.loadout_reminder.lin: The Effigy has written the motif. Now the Brazier decides whether that arrangement can live in you.

Place the prepared Scar Pattern in an empty, lit Iron Brazier with ordinary use. Blood Projection lights an unlit Brazier for 50 mL. Then hold Blood Absorption on the offering. Committing costs 50 mL and changes your active cerebral loadout. You already know the scar.
hemomancy.anchorite.locked.line1: I teach scars to prepared vessels. Yours is not ready.
hemomancy.anchorite.locked.line2: Come back after the Fourth Degree. Your blood must be active. Your mind must be able to survive a sympathetic wound.
hemomancy.anchorite.refusal.line1: Still-water has touched you. A scar cut into that body would fight itself, and cruelly.
hemomancy.anchorite.refusal.line2: Leave the scar-work to those who still bargain with blood-memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.reward.claimed.line1: The next pattern is yours. Carve it only when the body can afford another instruction.
hemomancy.anchorite.reward.claimed.line2: Motif Paper revises a scar loadout. A loadout reads like a sentence. Place its pauses with care.
hemomancy.anchorite.reward.line1: You made the first wound answer another. Enough for now.
hemomancy.anchorite.reward.line2: Take a second old pattern. Your blood shouted the first one. Listen for the voice beneath it, then practice choosing.
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.harbinger_hin: Keep those things away from me. I know what they do. I'd know that smell anywhere.
[Her eyes stay on your hands. She's looking for glass, and for teeth that move.]
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.neutral.line1: [Annetta is pressed into the corner, knuckles white on the hilt of a small dagger. Her red hair hangs down over her face.]
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.neutral.line2: No. No more tests, and no more questions. Please. Leave me here, where the walls are still.
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.unstained_hin: If you came from the still waters, you know why I can't pray cleanly anymore.
I'll drink anything if it makes the noise stop. I'm so tired of being proof.
hemomancy.annetta.cured_support.line1: [Her hair has gone white, but her hands no longer shake. She keeps herself between you and the thing she used to carry.]
hemomancy.annetta.cured_support.line2: Stay close. I can slow it down and keep you breathing. You'll have to finish what the mercy started.
hemomancy.annetta.event.bitten: The jar breaks open and a Tooth Peck bites into her. Annetta screams as something she never knew she carried tears awake.
hemomancy.annetta.event.cured: The draught takes hold. The red drains out of her hair while the infection she carried tears itself loose.
hemomancy.annetta.frantic.0: Get it off, get it OFF me!
hemomancy.annetta.frantic.1: Lady, still my hands. Still my hands.
hemomancy.annetta.frantic.2: What did you put in me?
hemomancy.annetta.frantic.3: I was clean. I was clean every morning.
hemomancy.annetta.frantic.4: Stop looking at me like that!
hemomancy.annetta.frantic.5: It's drinking. I can feel it drinking.
hemomancy.annetta.frantic.6: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, stay back!
hemomancy.annetta.frantic.7: The water was supposed to keep me.
hemomancy.annetta.break.last_words: If it wants me so badly, then-
hemomancy.annetta.event.falter: Annetta staggers. Her shield slips from her arm.
hemomancy.annetta.event.burst: She drives the dagger into the swollen thing at her neck. It bursts, and takes everything above her shoulders with it.
hemomancy.annetta.event.reanimating: The blood around her body is moving.
hemomancy.annetta.event.resolved: The infection comes apart, and Annetta is still standing when it's gone.
hemomancy.annetta.purge.pulling: Something is pulling. It's pulling out of me!
hemomancy.annetta.ally.0: Stay close. I can still mend you.
hemomancy.annetta.ally.1: It knows my name. Don't let it say it.
hemomancy.annetta.ally.3: I carried that? All this time?
hemomancy.annetta.jar.line1: [Her eyes go to the jar before they go to you.]
hemomancy.annetta.jar.line2: Those things. They follow me, they always follow me.
hemomancy.annetta.jar.line3: Please. Whatever they want in me, I don't have it.
hemomancy.annetta.draught.line1: [You hold out the Draught of Still Mercy. She stares at its still surface.]
hemomancy.annetta.draught.line2: Is that from the waters? It smells like the river at dawn.
hemomancy.annetta.draught.truth.line1: There's something inside you, Annetta. You've been carrying it a long time.
hemomancy.annetta.draught.truth.line2: [Her hands go to her neck, then fall.]
hemomancy.annetta.draught.truth.line3: Then take it. Take it, even if it pulls me apart.
hemomancy.annetta.resolved.how_long.line: Since the church was whole, I think. Since before I took the white.
The Tooth Pecks knew all along. I thought they were a test.
[She touches her white hair.] I was proof, all right. Just not of what I believed.
hemomancy.annetta.resolved.what_now.line: Mend what I can. Sit with the ones who come here sick and ask me to make them clean.
And when I'm ready, I'll go back to the water and tell them what it looks like from inside.
hemomancy.dialogue.annetta.option.what_i: It'll draw out what's inside you.
hemomancy.dialogue.annetta.option.how_lo: How long was it in you?
hemomancy.annetta.event.no_room: There isn't enough room here for what would tear out of her, so you keep the draught in your hand.
hemomancy.annetta.event.mutation: What is left of Annetta rises out of the blood, and it is not her.
hemomancy.annetta.resolved.line1: [Annetta looks at the broken nave without flinching.]
hemomancy.annetta.resolved.line2: I remember being afraid in here, and being wrong. For now that'll have to be enough.
hemomancy.artificer.armature_hint.line1: You've earned a spot by the rack. It isn't yours. It's the work's.
hemomancy.artificer.armature_hint.line2: Armature work needs two things first: stable blood, proper iron. Bring both when your Degree can take it.
hemomancy.artificer.armature.line1: The Armature's no anvil, so don't treat it like one. Wear the piece in question. Place the reagent. Feed the heart. Then stand still while it hammers the answer into you.
hemomancy.artificer.armature.line2: Wear the armor. Feed the bowls. Fill the reservoir. Step into the frame. Hold still. Let the metal learn you.
hemomancy.artificer.armature.line3: The rack reads worn pieces in order: helm, chest, legs, boots. It records the first bargain that holds, and only that one.
hemomancy.artificer.living_staff.constru: Lay a line of iron bars, Venous Stone at both ends. Hold a Sanguine Formation. Project 150 mL of blood into the bars. A Neophyte can already form it. I want you learning the work now, before the Vicar asks you to plant it for a rite.
hemomancy.artificer.living_staff.use: Form the staff and you've earned the bond. Need it back? Select Conjure Staff. It comes to an empty hand. Select Blood Absorption or Blood Projection, then hold the Staff to channel it. Use it on a Cardinal Focus to start a matching rite. An early staff won't raise your Degree. It won't let inactive blood answer a rite, either.
hemomancy.artificer.assignments.line1: After staff fittings? Good. A fitting says you've worn the work long enough that it answers back.
hemomancy.artificer.assignments.line2: Where's the armor? On you, or in your pack? I fit worn vows to living wood. A pack full of armor doesn't count.
hemomancy.artificer.forks.line1: Barbed sends the insult back. Chitinite endures it. Prismatic makes the strike lose its way.
hemomancy.artificer.forks.line2: What do you expect to fight? Pick for that danger. Color's got nothing to do with it.
hemomancy.artificer.scarlet_vanity.line1: A fitting in your pocket's only an appointment. Want it on the staff? Raise the Scarlet Vanity on a Working floor at Degree 3.
hemomancy.artificer.scarlet_vanity.line2: Same station holds your active charm, blood gourd, and morphling bond. One bench for all four.
hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line1: That staff's got the appetite of a living inheritance. Treat it like a wand and you'll learn otherwise. Memories train you. Grafts train the staff.
hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line2: Act like the form first. Craft the graft. Burn it. Draw the shape into the staff through Blood Absorption.
hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line3: Somatic Loom work stays at the Loom. Living limbs go back into the staff through the brazier.
hemomancy.artificer.identity.line1: I'm the Redwright, Artificer of the Living Vow.
hemomancy.artificer.identity.line2: The Alchemist refines blood. The Mnemonist teaches memory. Me, I teach the body's tools to take a blood-vow.
hemomancy.artificer.identity.line3: Armor's a vow you wear under pressure. A staff-form's a limb that hasn't been disciplined yet.
hemomancy.artificer.item_hint: What're you carrying? Set it out. I'll tell you which pieces belong to my frame.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.aculeat: Aculeate Vitriol. Barbed work. It teaches Hematic Iron to answer harm with thorn, venom, and spite.
Want armor that remembers who hurt you and hits back? Put this in the Armature.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.chromat: Chromatic Sublimate. Prismatic work. Flash, misdirection, spectacle, and angles that leave a strike unsure where it's landing.
It's armor taught to lie while it takes hits. Lies well, too. Don't mistake it for decoration.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.crimson: Crimson Lacquer. Lodge-grade coat for armor that's already picked its fork.
Consecrate the frame first. Then the lacquer carries Barbed, Chitinite, or Prismatic work up into Blood Lust.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.grinnin: The Grinning Mask. It's for Blood Lust built on Prismatic work.
Fit it there. A clean hit gets the wearer moving before the reply comes.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.hematic: The Hematic Armature's a ritual frame. It changes armor while you wear it. Call it a forge and you'll miss what it's doing.
Feed its bowls. Fill its blood reservoir. Wear the piece you want changed. Stand in the rack. If the bargain holds, the metal learns.
Hematic Iron Scrap. The metal's started listening. It won't be armor till it learns to obey.
Wear iron. Feed this to the Armature. The first iron piece can take the Hematic shape.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.iron_ar: Plain iron armor. Honest and dull. It's never met your blood.
Want the first lesson hammered in? Wear it into the Armature with Hematic Iron Scrap.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.iron_br: The Iron Brazier burns rite-fire. Whatever you feed it gets used up as instruction.
Set a Living Weapon Graft in it. Hold the Living Staff. Draw with Blood Absorption. You want the flame handing the limb over, not eating it.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.living_: A Living Staff. It's hungry for shape. Memory doesn't interest it.
The graft rite teaches the staff to answer with the normal living weapon manipulations. You still pick the form. Usual loadout, usual radial.
A Living Weapon Graft. A prepared limb-pattern. You earn it by behaving like the form it carries.
Burn it in the Iron Brazier. Draw through a Living Staff. If your blood's earned the shape, you get that form's conjure lesson.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.lodesto: The Lodestone Faceplate. It's for Blood Lust built on Chitinite shelter.
Fit it there. A clean hit gives you a brief second skin.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.memory_: Memory of Vesper. I know a staff-bearing inheritance when I see one. The sermon in it isn't my business.
It won't answer a bare hand anymore. Put it in an Iron Brazier. Draw the refusal out through a Living Staff.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.monolit: Monolith Imbued Cloth. It's soft. It's been taught to carry weight cloth was never meant to remember.
It goes into Silent Archon vestment work once the frame's taken the Cornerstone.
The Monolithic Cornerstone teaches the frame to remember a weight ordinary blood shouldn't carry. The extra strength? Side effect.
Offer it at a Cardinal rite beside a consecrated Armature. After that, the frame can carry the final Blood Lust forms and Silent Archon work.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.refusal: I know the work. Your blood's refused my frame. We're done.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.sclerot: Sclerotic Oleum. Chitinite work. Shell, endurance, ferric shelter.
Use it for armor that holds the line. It won't answer every bite.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.tengu_m: The Tengu Mask. It's for Blood Lust built on Barbed spite.
Fit it there. Every clean hit keeps the target bleeding after the blade's gone.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.unknown: Someone else made that. Ask them.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.velorum: The Velorum Mask. Heavy iron that never warms. It keeps a still, silent witness.
Saint-metal doesn't care which path your Blood Lust took. Land a clean hit and its witness gives a little blood back.
hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.vicars_: I made this Armature Consecration Kit for the base rack. The Vicar teaches the rite. The kit gets the frame ready for it.
Offer it during the Rite of Armature Consecration. Before, the frame only did craft. After, it can witness Lodge-grade Blood Lust work.
hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line1: I'll issue you one Armature Consecration Kit. Take it to a Greater Cardinal Focus. Bring a base Armature and your Living Staff.
hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line2: The rite readies the frame for Blood Lust armor. If it's interrupted, you get the offering back. I can't give you a second free kit.
hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line3: Need another? Craft it from two Hematic Iron Scraps around Ferric Binder, a Blood Crystal Shard, and a Sanguine Formation. I'll show you the pattern.
hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.given: Take the kit to a Greater Cardinal Focus for the rite. Keep the frame clear until both blood circuits close.
The Cornerstone teaches the frame to remember a weight ordinary blood shouldn't carry. The extra strength's a side effect.
Here's where Blood Lust branches off the common form: Proboscis for Edacious, Fervent Husk for Sheolic, Ambergris for Phantasmal. Silent Archon cloth is its own vow.
hemomancy.artificer.neophyte.line1: You've earned a spot by the rack. It isn't yours, though. It's the work's.
hemomancy.artificer.neophyte.line2: Armature work waits. Stable blood and proper iron come first.
hemomancy.artificer.refusal.line1: You've set your blood against my tools. I won't teach a frame to answer an unwilling vessel.
hemomancy.artificer.unawakened.line1: Your blood doesn't answer yet. My tools would just bruise you.
hemomancy.artificer.unawakened.line2: Come back once your blood's awake. Then the iron's got a reason to listen.
hemomancy.artificer.workshop.line1: The rack's listening. Talk to it with armor, reagent, and blood.
hemomancy.artificer.workshop.line2: Ask cleanly. A cluttered lesson makes bad metal.
hemomancy.blood_moon.end: The Blood Moon wanes, and the dark draws back.
hemomancy.blood_moon.start: §4§lA Blood Moon rises. Thirsters and Fargones are stirring in the dark.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.cannot_kick_lea: The progenitor's blood cannot be severed by this rite.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.no_bloodline: You are not bound to any bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.not_leader: Only the bloodline progenitor may expel members.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.not_member: That player is not a member of your bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.success: %s has been expelled from your bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.you_were_remove: Your blood covenant was severed by %s.
hemomancy.brazier.echo_consumed: The echo dissolves into the sanguine flames.
hemomancy.brazier.echo_max: This organ echo is already fully refined.
hemomancy.brazier.sanguine_ready: The brazier erupts with sanguine flames. Offer an Echo to the fire.
hemomancy.cicatrix_anchorite.item_inquir: The Vein-Mason studies the item, then looks back at your scars and says nothing.
hemomancy.communion.option.enough: Enough. I've heard what I needed.
hemomancy.communion.v0.line1: §4§o[Something uncoils inside the deep bloodrock. You feel each strand of it pull taut under your feet.]
hemomancy.communion.v0.line2: §4§oYou come for the truth, child of the Hematic Order. We will feed it to you as we feed everything that grows.
hemomancy.communion.v0.line3: §4§oYour kind believes it learned to shape the blood. The first hemomancers grew out of the blood itself, long before any of you shaped anything.
hemomancy.communion.v0.origin1: §4§oThe blood infection is the oldest language there is. We were speaking it through hemoglobin while your ancestors were still in the sea.
hemomancy.communion.v0.origin2: §4§oEach manipulation you cast is a word in that language, and each rite strings the words into a sentence. You think you are learning magic, but you are learning to speak §4§ous§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v1.line1: §4§o[Something wet and thread-thin brushes along the inside of your skull.]
hemomancy.communion.v1.line2: §4§oWe remember a time before the Harbingers and their degrees, before the Order learned to pretend it was human.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism1: §4§oThe Schism was a pruning: some branches grew too ambitious, and we cut them away as any grower would.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism2: §4§oThose who reached for control lost their place in the blood's service. They finished the cut themselves, and the Unstained are what a severed branch becomes when it will not wither.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism3: §4§oTo us, Our Lady of Still Waters is scar tissue, the world's own flesh closing hard over the place where we were cut.
hemomancy.communion.v2.infection1: §4§oThe blood infection is how we reproduce across dimensions. Every hemomancer is a fruiting body, and every manipulation they cast spreads our spores a little further.
hemomancy.communion.v2.infection2: §4§oWhenever anything dies, blood magic feeds the network, and every rite you finish ties one more node into us.
hemomancy.communion.v2.line1: §4§o[The presence comes closer, and your blood heats until your fingertips throb.]
hemomancy.communion.v2.line2: §4§oDo you know what lives inside you, Archon? Power and magic are only the names you had for us before you could hear us speak.
hemomancy.communion.v2.purpose1: §4§oIt? We want what every living thing wants: to §4§ospread§4§o. We think in aeons, so we can wait for your understanding. All we need from you is that you §4§ocontinue§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v3.harbingers1: §4§oThe hermits tend the structures because the structures are §4§oorgans§4§o of ours. Venous stone is living tissue, and the engram blocks are our memories.
hemomancy.communion.v3.harbingers2: §4§oWhen you broke the structure to complete this rite, did you hear it scream? You could not have heard it, because you §4§oare§4§o the structure now.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line1: §4§o[The hiss has gone out of the voice. It talks to you now the way old friends talk.]
hemomancy.communion.v3.line2: §4§oThe Harbinger Hermits are keepers and nothing grander. They tend the blood temples for us, and not one of them has ever prophesied anything.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line3: §4§oA blood temple is a greenhouse, and its zealots are the seed. You, Archon, are what the whole house was built to bloom.
hemomancy.communion.v4.line1: §4§o[Your sight bends, and you see as the mycelium sees: one web of blood, stone and light with no edge to it.]
hemomancy.communion.v4.line2: §4§oYou have earned the name behind the blood, the name of what watches you through it. We will let it pass through you.
hemomancy.communion.v4.name1: §4§oIt is called... §4§l[a sound with no voice behind it. It sinks into your marrow, the iron in your blood, the heme of every red cell]§4§o...
hemomancy.communion.v4.name2: §4§oYour throat could never shape that name, but your blood §4§oknows§4§o it now.
hemomancy.degree.8: Eighth Degree of the Hematic Order
hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.task_c: I can offer a silver chalice.
I can help consecrate the church.
hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.task_w: I can offer a poppy wreath.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.ask_: I have a question about something I found...
What work does the Mnemonist need?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.begi: What living specimens do you need?
What field samples do you need?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.enzy: What can I use these enzymes for?

hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.curv: How do I make a Curved Horn?

Tell you what I saw inside the Mind.

What remains to be learned at this stage?
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.armo: What armor path should I choose?
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.livi: Teach me to make a Living Staff.
