hemomancy.dialogue.category.inquiries.su: Choose an item from your inventory to ask about.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.accept_church: The Zealot nods. 'Follow the silver bells. They'll lead you to the church.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.accept_purifica: The Zealot's eyes brighten. 'Bring hemolytic solution to the podium and begin.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.unstained_start: The Zealot supplies whatever your entry kit was missing: two Hemolytic Solutions and the Liber Immaculatus. Use one solution at the Podium and the other to make Cleansed Stone.
The Zealot already gave you your own entry supplies. Anything in the church chest is shared with other visitors.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.alchemist_besti: The Alchemist taps the jar. 'Already recorded.' Living Bestiary progress: %2$s/%3$s.
The Alchemist studies the polyp. 'That layer's not in this specimen.'
The Alchemist gestures to the bench. 'Filled specimen jar, please. I can't study an empty one.'
The Alchemist studies %s and shakes their head. 'Useful glasswork, maybe. It doesn't belong in this bestiary.'
The Alchemist dissects the polyp and seals the active layer into %s. It's still wild-bound, so incubate it if you want it fully mature.
The Alchemist records %s and returns the jar. Living Bestiary progress: %2$s/%3$s.
The Alchemist lowers their voice while the Tooth Pecks scrape at the glass. 'Dental swarm, social bite. They're useful if you treat every tooth as a witness.' Living Bestiary progress: %2$s/%3$s.
The Alchemist accepts %s for study and returns %s.
The Alchemist accepts the Tooth Pecks and slides %2$s across the bench. 'Save your sympathy for my bench. It'll be covered in tooth marks by morning.'
The Alchemist keeps the ledger shut. 'Living specimens come once you've learned the Votary's discipline. Not before.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.alchemist_red_t: The Alchemist waves the %s away. 'I've already cataloged that one. Bring me a different expression.'
The Alchemist looks at your empty hands. 'The sample, Votary. I can't test an idea.'
The Red Taxonomy reward has not been decided yet.
The Alchemist seals the %s in a specimen vessel. Red Taxonomy progress: %s/4.
That fourth diagnosis finishes your field assay. The Alchemist hands you jars and empty blood vials so you can keep sampling.
Your first useful specimen earns you one empty Blood Vial from the Alchemist for field sampling.
The Alchemist shuts the specimen case. 'Not yet. Learn the Votary's discipline first.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.archon_choice_e: §4§oYou surface from the dreaming root with your veins pulling in a new direction, toward the Rite of Apotheos, which has been calling you all along.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.archon_choice_s: §8§oYou have chosen refusal, but it is not yet won. Strike the base of your own spent Bloom with a base Living Weapon to shape a temporary Living Sickle. A second strike with the sickle opens the wound, and you enter through it. Defeat both faces of Vesper, then burn his memory in a lit Iron Brazier and draw it in with the Living Staff. Only then do you stand at the eighth Degree as a Silentium.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_assum: The Artificer hands you a blank Hematic Memory. 'You learned the limb. Keep the next wound somewhere clean.'
The Artificer taps the ledger. 'Already paid you for that graft lesson.'
The Artificer studies your staff-hand. 'Finish a living graft. Then ask.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_blood: The Artificer gives you the Crimson Vestment Fitting. It adds no edge to your staff. It shows the work was witnessed.
The Artificer glances at the fitting. 'The Lodge already saw that vestment.'
The Artificer replaces your Crimson Vestment Fitting. 'Here. Don't lose the appointment again.'
The Artificer refuses the fitting. 'Full Blood Lust set, all of it worn at once. No substitutes.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_crims: The Artificer gives you Crimson Lacquer. 'One appetite made. Mean it? Finish the vestment.'
The Artificer closes his palm. 'You already took that lacquer.'
The Artificer shakes his head. 'Consecrate the frame. Make Blood Lust armor. Then come back.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_d7_fi: The Artificer gives you the Monolithic Frame Fitting. It adds no strength. It records the weight you took on.
The Artificer nods once. 'I've already fitted you for that weight.'
The Artificer replaces your Monolithic Frame Fitting. 'Here. You'd think something that heavy would be harder to lose.'
The Artificer looks over your armor. 'Wear a complete matching Archon-grade set. Mixed pieces aren't a vow.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_fork_: The Artificer gives you the fitting for your chosen shell (thorn, shell or prism). Your answer has a witness now.
The Artificer leaves the drawer closed. 'You've already got the fitting for that shell.'
The Artificer replaces your chosen-shell fitting. 'Try not to lose the answer twice.'
The Artificer refuses the fitting. 'Bring one complete forked set. Mixing them tells me you haven't decided.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_hemat: The Artificer gives you the Worn Vow Fitting. Your armor gains nothing from it. Your staff gains a new face.
The Artificer taps the fitting. 'I've already witnessed your first vow.'
The Artificer replaces your Worn Vow Fitting. 'Losing the fitting doesn't cancel the appointment.'
The Artificer looks at the gaps. 'Full Hematic Iron set, on your body. Then I'll fit it.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_livin: The Artificer gives you the Assumed Limb Fitting. It records all seven assumed limbs as proof of the work. It gives no fang and no hidden strength.
The Artificer gives you a hard smile. 'Your arsenal's already fitted.'
The Artificer replaces your Assumed Limb Fitting. 'Your staff still carries the record. You only lost the fitting.'
The Artificer listens to your staff. 'Some of the seven forms are still missing.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_three: The Alchemist gives you the reagent for your recorded armor family. 'Catalog its living examples and I might be able to refine another measure.'
The Artificer gestures to the bowls. 'You already claimed that reagent.'
The Artificer waits. 'Make one forked armor piece first. Then we'll talk about answers.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_worn_: The Artificer gives you Hematic Iron Scrap. 'One piece done. Now teach the rest of the set.'
The Artificer shuts the little drawer. 'You already took the scrap for that lesson.'
The Artificer shakes his head. 'One Hematic Iron armor upgrade. Finish it first.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.gives_stained_c: [A stained route is set down where you can take it. You recognize the marked church before you have ever seen it.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_accept_g: Take the waybill to the outpost. If you still wish to join the Order, tell its Vicar. He will receive you.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_archon_w: The Hermit bows low. 'Everything I know is in your blood already, Archon.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_farewell: §7[The Hermit clutches the hollow in his chest where his heart used to beat. The Mortal Display has been claimed. Crimson light spills from the wound as his body starts to unravel.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_heart_of: You have my permission. Touch the Mortal Display and take my heart. Then come back to me before you go.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_passing: §o'Heart was never mine to keep, only to give... Wake it in the threshold beneath us. When the rite takes you, go to the others at their outpost. They will teach what I was never meant to. Walk the crimson path, young Harbinger. I will go now where blood returns to silence.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.lady_clarity_ri: §bThe words sink into your mind like a stone into still water, and with them the Rite of Clarity Ascension. You know how to perform it now.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.lady_enlightene: §bHer words settle on you, cold and clear as snow. You are done with the life that brought you here, and you find you don't mind.
§bShe is still here. She was here the whole time. The world has gone quieter around you.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_start: The Mnemonist smiles faintly. Your blood already knows that motion.
The Mnemonist releases a crude memory shard to you. Its echo waits for your blood.
The Mnemonist closes their hand around the echo. This lesson is not yours to claim now.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_woven: The Mnemonist indexes the blank vessel. At the Loom, choose Blood Shot: one bulb, 50 blood, one vivacious enzyme. Keep a Living Staff in hand. When the engram unfurls around the Loom, rest your eyes on the fragment until you hear it. Then hold the staff on it and sweep its thread along the star's lines into the Loom.
The Mnemonist closes the archive. 'This vessel is already indexed. Go. Use what it taught you.'
The Mnemonist waits beside an empty desk. 'A book, ink, and three sheets of paper. Memory without an index is only hunger.'
The Mnemonist extends an empty hand. 'The blank memory first. A lesson needs a vessel.'
The Mnemonist listens to your pulse and shakes their head. 'Not yet. Finish the red catalog. Return as an Initiate.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.monolith_corner: §4The Lodestone presses a Monolithic Cornerstone into your hand. It is small and cold, and far heavier than it should be.
The Lodestone has already given you its cornerstone. It will not give another.
The Lodestone stays silent. It answers only Archons who have worked a consecrated Armature.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.qliphoth_commun: §4§oSomething vast and patient knows you now. You feel the silence of the ninth shell settle into your bones.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.reject_help: The Zealot watches you turn away, silver eyes dimming.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.scout_gives_not: §7[The Scout presses a small, water-stained journal into your hands. Her grip loosens almost immediately.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_firs: The Vein-Mason gives you a Scar Pattern and the materials to carve it.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_know: The Vein-Mason has already given you your first pattern.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_rewa: The Vein-Mason gives you a second pattern, a blank scar, its catalyst, and fresh Motif Paper.
The Vein-Mason has already given you the continuation kit.
The Vein-Mason waits for you to commit your first loadout.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_unre: The Vein-Mason will not teach you yet.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_assignmen: The Vicar entrusts you with the Assignment Ledger, where your formal work begins. If you lose it, ask for another copy.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_blood_sho: §4Your eyes ache as the blood-script begins arranging itself into meaning.
§8The blood-script is already open to you.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_conse: The Artificer gives you an Armature Consecration Kit.
The Artificer has already issued your kit. A canceled rite returns its offerings, and you now know how to craft another.
The Artificer holds the kit back until you have worked the Armature yourself and reached the fifth Degree with your blood awake.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_first_blo: The promotion could not be completed. Ask the Vicar again.
The Vicar raises you to the Second Degree and gives you the Order's first bloodcraft kit, unless you already have it.
The Order has already recognized your First Bloodcraft service.
The Vicar is waiting for all four first bloodcraft proofs: absorption, formation, Venous Stone, and one structure craft.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_gives_scr: §7[The Vicar takes a small, weathered scrap of parchment from his vestments and presses it into your hands.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_hermit_ro: The Vicar taps the ledger once. 'You already carry the proper record. Use it.'
The Vicar gives you a Harbinger Assignment Ledger.
The Vicar records the wild remnant as a side road and gives you ash for the journey.
The Vicar waits for proof from a wild remnant, not a familiar stone.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_masons_re: The route to Masons Respite is already yours.
The Vicar gives you a scar-scribed route to Masons Respite.
The Vicar will not speak of the Vein-Mason before the Fourth Degree.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.whisper_truth_a: §4A fungal awareness settles into your bones. What was said stays with you.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.ask_a: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.task_: I will ring the Pale Watch.
I will plate the quiet watch.
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.accept_: I understand. Show me the way.
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.how_do_: How do I begin the path of hemomancy?
How do scars reshape the mind?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.what_he: What is this heart you speak of?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.who_are: Who are you? Why are you here?

Tell me about the Somatic Loom.
How should I choose which memories to keep ready?
How do I save a memory loadout?

How do active manipulation slots work?

hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.turn: I brought the blank vessel and archive materials.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.wove: How do I prepare a blank memory?
hemomancy.dialogue.monolith.option.ancho: What does the Armature still lack?
hemomancy.dialogue.option.ask_about_item: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.alchemist.acc: All right. My expertise is bound to your pool now, so spend it carefully. Every drop I put in has the Order's craft behind it.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.alchemist.con: You want my blood pledged to yours? That's an unusual request. The Lodge does teach that shared knowledge flows best through shared veins, I'll give it that.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.already_membe: This Harbinger has already pledged their blood to your cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.expel.success: %s has been released from your bloodline covenant.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.mnemonist.acc: Call it covenant, then. One lesson, carried in more than one body.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.mnemonist.con: A bloodline is also a memory. Bind me into yours, and my pulse will answer when your reserve runs thin.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.no_bloodline: Found a bloodline with the Degree 5 Bloodline Founding rite before you try to recruit others.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.not_leader: Only the bloodline progenitor may dismiss pledged members.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.not_member: This Harbinger is not bound to your bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.confir: You are accepted into the bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.pledge: Pledge your blood to my cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.releas: Our pact is ended. Withdraw from my bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.outpost_alrea: This outpost has already given your bloodline one voice. Leave the rest of us free to carry the cause outward.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.success: %s has pledged their blood to your bloodline, adding their vitality to the shared pool. If they die, the pool loses it and their recruitment slot opens again.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.type_already_: A Harbinger of this calling has already pledged to your bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.vicar.accept: Very well. My blood is yours, and we are stronger, all of us, when those who serve the Covenant answer to a single will.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.vicar.conside: You would have me bind my blood to yours? An Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge commands respect, and, I confess, obedience as well.
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.go_in_pe: §7[You take the notes and step away.]
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.take_not: I'll take them. They'll be used.
I'll take them. Your work won't go to waste.
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.what_did: What did you notice about them?
hemomancy.dialogue.ui.no_topics: No topics are available right now.
hemomancy.dialogue.unstained.observances: Service shows whether the stillness has turned into habit yet. Pick work you're ready to finish.
hemomancy.dialogue.unstained.option.obse: Do you have an observance for me?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.about_th: Have you heard of any path beyond the seven degrees?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.ask_abou: Teach me how to shape blood into things.
I want to ask about something I found.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.claim_fi: I have completed the first bloodcraft lessons.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.consecra: Who prepares the Armature for consecration?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.first_bl: What followed my First Bloodcraft assignment?
How do I finish my first bloodcraft lessons?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.open_blo: Open my eyes to the blood-script.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.purifyin: I know what I am doing.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.seek_vei: Who teaches the old scarring rites?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.tell_me_: Tell me about the Sanguine Brotherhood.
Tell me about the Hematic Covenant.
Tell me about the Crimson Lodge.
Tell me about the Incarnadine Fane.
Tell me about the Founding Fane.
Tell me about the Hematic Order.
What do you know of the Saints?
Is there something the Order has never said aloud?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_deg: What does the next degree require of me?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_do_: What do you make of what I have become?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_is_: What is the purpose of this Outpost?
hemomancy.dialogue.votary_wayfarer.optio: Are you afraid of the sea?
hemomancy.dialogue.voyager.option.ask_ab: What are you studying out here?
hemomancy.dialogue.voyager.option.record: I noticed how the reef answered the current.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.about_a: Tell me about the Altar of Cleansing.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.about_c: What is the Rite of Clarity?
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.accept_: I wish to join your church.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.ask_abo: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.how_cra: How do I make hemolytic solution?
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.not_int: I have no interest in your cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.task_pa: I will bear a Pallid Icon.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.task_st: I will gather the Still Waters.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.tell_me: Tell me more about the Unstained path.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.take_vo: I wish to take the vows.
hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.vow_ge: I have completed the Gentle Separation.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.vow_sti: I have gathered the Still Waters.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.vow_cle: I have completed the clean labor.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.vow_s: I sheltered another from the stain.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.repla: I need a replacement Absolution Dagger.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.reject_respons: Then walk your road. Every rite you perform drives the stain deeper. What do you think you're buying with it?
hemomancy.drudge.memory_unsupported: This memory cannot be installed in a Drudge.
hemomancy.guardian.ambient.line1: §7[The Guardian holds still and meets your eyes for a moment.]§r Stand your ground. Keep your hands clean.
hemomancy.guardian.item_hint: Pick it from your pack. I'll say if it belongs in the field.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.absoluti: Absolution Dagger. Issued to every pledged Unstained at Clarity Ascension. Last resort. Mercy. Self-defense.
Hemolytic treatment is built in. Don't waste a temporary coating on it.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.bow.line: Bow. Keeps the blood at a distance. Good for that alone.
Shoot what you have. Pale-silver arrows help once they're made. Not before.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.crossbow: Crossbow. Hits hard at distance. Slow reload. That's the price.
Pick your shot before the line closes.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.golden_a: Golden apple. Concentrated restorative. Not one of ours. It works. I've eaten one when the standard field medicine ran out.
Carry proper Unstained field medicine for treatment and for blood-corruption exposure. The apple buys time when you're badly hurt and out of options.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.hemolyti: Hemolytic plating. Sheet treated with solution. Cured stable. Disrupts blood-magic on contact. We line gear with it for work in afflicted areas.
Raw solution breaks down on fabric or ordinary metal. Plating holds the lytic compound indefinitely. That's why advanced Guardian equipment needs it.
Hemolytic solution. Breaks down blood-matrix corruption. Carry it for treatment. And for any gear whose recipe takes it.
The Absolution Dagger doesn't need it. Its treatment is permanent.
Hemolytic solution. Use it as the Church instructs. Not varnish for every weapon in the rack.
Know the equipment. Then spend the dose.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.iron_che: Plain iron. Stops ordinary blows. Does nothing against infection.
Keep it maintained. Until proper Unstained armor is ready.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.iron_swo: A blade works. Arm's length is dangerous near infectious blood.
Keep distance. Keep discipline. If the weapon takes a sanctioned treatment, apply it.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.lethean_: Lethean brew. Distilled from lethean dew. Stronger than the raw dew. Used in the deeper Altar rites. In the field, it hits blood exposure harder.
Careful with it. Hits blood matrices harder than dew. Measure the dose for exposure. Carry it on a long watch.
Lethean Dew. Made with the Church's condenser and Ghost Pipe work. Not collected because the dawn looked holy.
Carry it sealed. First rule of field medicine. Don't contaminate the medicine.
Lethean Poppies. They grow where purification has taken hold. Water gone still. Blood-taint receded. Find them, and Our Lady has already touched the place.
Expect fewer blood-afflicted encounters there. Mark them. Zealots upstream need to know where cleansed ground is spreading.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.minecraf: Serviceable. Keep it clean. Keep your reach. Open blood only with cause.
Against active infection, distance and restraint count. Not decoration.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pale_dis: Pale distillate. Refined from Lethean Poppies. Zealots use it in advanced Altar work. In the field, the strongest lytic material we have. Use it sparingly.
You'll rarely need it in a fight. If you support Zealot operations, learn how they make it upstream. Carry it when asked. Otherwise, leave it for ritual work.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pale_sil: Pale Silver Bell. We ring it for warning, retreat and cleared ground.
Ring it once, and mean it. Panic tells the line nothing.
Pale Silver. Refined from Consecrated Copper. No ore to mine. Iron won't stand in for it.
Guard it. Every ingot is somebody's finished ritual work.
Field tool. Pale silver breaks blood-hardened stone. No secondary affliction. Useful in reclamation work.
Not built as a weapon. Serves as one in an emergency. Pale silver disrupts blood-affliction on contact. Any shape.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pallid_i: A consecrated copy of the river Icon. Gives the line a direction when fear makes every road look alike.
Carry it as witness. You still keep watch.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.shield.l: Shield. Stops force. Nothing special against blood.
Keep it between the wound and your face.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.silthmer: Silthmere Glaive. Sanctioned for the reach. The edge matters less. Keep infectious blood away from your hands.
Hold the line. Give the wound room.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.sporitic: Harbinger work. Fungal support smoke, paid for in blood.
Keep it off a clean line. The fumes serve the fungus. Not us.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.liber_im: The Liber records the path. Every Guardian swears to understand it. Many of us walked it.
Read its First Steps. Then approach the Podium.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.unknown: Not my work. Ask someone else.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.unstaine: Unstained armor. Fieldwear for anyone who stands close to active corruption.
Keep every seal sound. Color doesn't make gear clean. You do.
Unstained guardwork. Built for a clean defensive line.
Use the protection it gives. Let it do its job.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.warhamme: Hammer. Hits hard. Keeps the wound closed. That's why we reach for it first.
Strike to stop. Save what you came to contain.
hemomancy.hematic_salvage.first_drop: The torn iron comes away red, as if it remembered a deeper ore.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.hint: Your manipulation slots grow with each Degree. Mastering the skill tree opens more. The Rite of the Crimson Lodge calls you next. Before it, carve a scar at the Cerebral Scarring Station. The Vein-Mason teaches the Brazier lesson that follows. Scars shape what lies within.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.line1: §7[The Hermit studies you. Recognition crosses his gaunt face]
hemomancy.hermit.adept.line2: Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. Most who come this deep lose themselves on the way. You did not. Your mind is still sharp enough to carve new pathways.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_crafting: Go to the Cerebral Scarring Station. Take a knapper in hand. Set a blank scar before you and carve the sacred pattern. Each scar asks for materials of the tendency it carries. The knapper cuts the walls in your mind as it cuts stone. Then take the scar to the Vein-Mason's Brazier lesson. There the new pathways open.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_intro: You have earned the right to hear of Scars. A scar looks like marks scratched in stone. Each one lays new venous and nervous pathways across your mind.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_lore: To inscribe a scar is to open yourself. You cut new channels for blood and thought. Its lines become veins, its curves nerves. The pattern rebuilds you from within. Ideas and tendencies that were sealed away can surface and take root.
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.final_words: §oThe vigil remains, as it always has. It means something else now. I kept this threshold so that one day someone might go far enough to make my duty small. §4You went that far. I am grateful.
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.line1: §4[For a while the Hermit says nothing. He presses both hands over the hollow where his heart used to be, and bows so low it is almost a fall.]
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.line2: §oNo keeper of this threshold was told to expect anyone this far. My instructions stopped at the seventh Degree. I have empty hands and a full heart to offer you, Apotheos. §4Go well.
hemomancy.hermit.archon.line1: §4[The Hermit drops to one knee, one hand on the hollow in his chest]
hemomancy.hermit.archon.line2: Archon of the Hematic Order. You are the blood made flesh. I keep dust and memory, and little else. Command me and I will serve.
hemomancy.hermit.illuminatus.hint: The Bloodline Covenant comes next. Find allies who share your blood. A bound bloodline draws from shared pools. Its members heal one another. When you are ready, perform the Rite of the Bloodline Covenant.
hemomancy.hermit.illuminatus.line1: You have looked behind the veil, Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. What the old keepers knew is yours to command.
hemomancy.hermit.initiate.hint: Learn the Somatic Loom. On it, memories of blood are woven into new manipulations. The Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood will prove you an Adept.
hemomancy.hermit.initiate.line1: I can hear the blood singing louder around you. You have gone deeper in, Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane.
hemomancy.hermit.manip_lore: A manipulation is a shape you teach your blood to take. Learn them. Then equip them at a Mnemonic Reliquary, so your blood can speak through them.
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.hint: Go back to the Vicar. He will ask this of you. Absorb 500 mL of blood. Fill a cauldron with projected blood, and take out the Sanguine Formation it condenses. Project Venous Stone from ordinary stone. Then use a blood formation to craft a Liber Sanguinium or a Hematic Iron Block.
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.line2: Neophyte. One step through the Crimson Veil, and already the blood knows you.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.duty.line1: The Archons of old set me here to keep vigil until someone worthy came. Every Harbinger Hermit before me swore the same oath: guard the heart, and guide whoever comes.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.duty.line2: Accept my blessing, and this temple's heart will answer you alone. Choose the path first. Claim it after, and I will show you how to wake it. §oMourn if you must. The blood needs a new vessel. Old keepers have to end.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.heart_lore: My living heart rests on the Mortal Display. Touch it with my permission. It will fasten the Charm of Vascularium to you and wake your blood. Then go to the Vicar. Until your formal initiation, the charm can still come off.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line1: §7[A hooded figure shifts in the shadows. His crimson eyes find you and stay on you, unhurried]
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line2: At last, another wanderer in these halls. I am the Harbinger Hermit, last keeper of this threshold. My one duty in life has been to welcome those who walk the path of blood.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line3: The heart on §cthe Mortal Display§r is mine. I can bless you to claim it. Neither the blessing nor the touch will initiate you. You choose when to wake the temple's Cardinal Focus.
hemomancy.hermit.sanctified.hint: One rite remains: the Rite of the Hematic Order. An Archon becomes the blood itself. Prepare well. The final trial spares no one.
hemomancy.hermit.sanctified.line1: Few in our Order stand higher than you now, Sanctified one. The Bloodline Covenant has blessed you.
hemomancy.hermit.temple_lore: The first Archons raised these temples, long before the Order fractured. The small threshold in this floor is a mercy. It is a first rite, laid out already for one who cannot yet project blood or command a Living Staff.
hemomancy.hermit.tendency_lore: Every manipulation carries a primary tendency. Many carry a second current beneath it. Master them, and your blood will lean toward the path you chose. It will lean toward the echoes braided through that path too. Let it. Hemomancy has always worked so.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.farewell.li: §7[The Hermit's form flickers. His body grows translucent as crimson light bleeds from his chest]
It is done. My heart is yours. My duty is finished. Go without fear. The Covenant will take you past what I was meant to teach. §4Farewell.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.guidance: My heart is in the charm now. Follow the waybill to a Harbinger outpost, and speak with its Vicar. You carry the blood. Joining the Order is still your choice.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line1: §7[The Hermit's eyes widen. A trembling smile crosses his gaunt face]
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line2: You have claimed my heart. Its pulse beats in you now, through the Charm of Vascularium.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line3: My vigil is almost over. Before I go, hear where the road leads.
hemomancy.hermit.votary.hint: Go to the Alchemist. They must see your first separation and your first ordinary Alembic distillation. After both, ask them for Concentrated Blood. Inject it, and rest.
hemomancy.hermit.votary.line1: §7[The Hermit straightens, then bows his hooded head]
hemomancy.hermit.votary.line2: The blood runs deeper in you now, Votary of the Hematic Covenant. You have proven yourself devoted.

hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.fragments.t: Each enzyme is one engram fragment the weaver must thread home.

hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.stage.1.des: Needs a Ganglionic Loom: a harness set at the Rite of the Ganglionic Weave.
hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.stage.2.des: Needs a Cortical Loom: a crown set at the Rite of the Cortical Weave.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.follow: §b§oAbsolution ends the first descent. The current runs on below it, into clarity. Clarity is a second gift, if you would have it.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.line1: §b§oYou are clearer now, like water once the silt settles. The old stain fades faster than it grew.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.line2: §b§oI have watched others come this far. Most falter here. With the blood quiet, its absence feels almost pleasant. A quiet pool can still hold a current.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v1.line1: §b§oThe blood-saints will call you a traitor. Let them. You betrayed corruption. It was the first honest thing you have done.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v1.line2: §b§oYour hands are almost clean. Finish the work.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is as cold as ever, but it no longer sounds far away. It could be standing at your shoulder.]
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.reveal1: §b§oI was old when the first blood-temple was raised. I will be here when the last one crumbles. The blood-cult forgot to bury me.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.reveal2: §b§oDo not try to understand me yet. Purify yourself completely. Then we will speak properly.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.line1: §b§oYou are doing well, child. I feel the corruption thinning.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.line2: §b§oThe blood lets go slowly. So does ice on a riverbank. But it lets go. Continue.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.reveal: §b§oI am what remains when a river has washed a stone clean. I have had many names. The Unstained call me Our Lady.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v1.line1: §b§oThe blood seduces quietly. It feels harmless. Still water feels harmless too. Give it time and it drowns you.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v1.line2: §b§oA clean body begins with clean intent. When you hold back, let the choice be yours.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v2.follow: §b§oEvery Unstained before you asked why they were chosen. I did not choose you. You chose yourself when you turned from the red tide.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v2.line1: §b§o[A voice moves through the stillness without hurry, the way water finds its level.]
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.follow: §b§oUse the Verdigris Aura against blood-touched enemies. Clarity can cut as well as see.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.line1: §b§oThere. You can see the shape beneath the surface now.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.line2: §b§oClear sight will not make the world kinder. It lets you name its cruelty precisely.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v1.line1: §b§oYou have begun to sense blood-work in others. That will serve you. Few things are more dangerous than a hemomancer unaware of being watched.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.line1: §b§o[Something settles over your shoulders like a cold, wet shawl, and it is oddly comforting.]
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.line2: §b§oGo on as you have. Each time you hold back, the clarity deepens. Honest deeds widen the sight.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.reveal: §b§oI am older than the hemomancy you left behind. I was here when the first blood was spilled. I have watched ever since, without hurry.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.line2: §b§oAll of it. The blood-cult, the fungus under it, and the world under both.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.truth1: §b§oI am the stillness of a lake left untouched for centuries. Do not mistake it for death. It is water nothing has disturbed.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.truth2: §b§oYou waded through blood and fungus to the far side. This is the last shore. Stand here and know it. You have nothing left to fear from either.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v1.line1: §b§oThe Harbingers call it betrayal. The fungal network calls it pruning. Both are right, in their way.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v1.line2: §b§oYou stepped outside the story written for you. Almost no one, in any world, does. I am glad you did.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.line1: §b§o[She does not move. Cold comes off her like the air over a winter lake, and she seems entirely satisfied.]
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.truth1: §b§oYou have earned the last truth. I am not here to save you, and I never was. I could not. What lives in the fungus is larger than I am.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.truth2: §b§oI am here because this is where water rests after a flood. You came to me when you had finished drowning.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.line2: §b§oThe crimson tide is gone from you entirely. You stand on the far shore of the blood-sea. It cannot reach you here.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.rite1: §b§oThere is a deeper sight, if you want it. The Unstained call it Clarity.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.rite2: §b§oYour purity is complete. Close the final vein first. Let your body return to its mortal baseline. Only then prepare the pledge.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v1.line1: §b§oYou are fully purified, child. I find that I am pleased. It has been a long while since I watched anyone finish this road.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v1.line2: §b§oRest, if you need it. Then perform Closed Vein. Then offer Consecrated Copper at the Podium. Come to Clarity Ascension as a pledge.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice has risen above a whisper. It seems to come from the walls, the floor and the air in your lungs, and it sounds like someone who has waited a very long time.]
hemomancy.lady.purified.v2.rite1: §b§oFirst close the old current with Closed Vein. Then offer Consecrated Copper at the Podium. Then arrange the Rite of Clarity Ascension. It is the Church's pledge.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.follow1: §b§oI will not lie to you. The final clarity changes things. Some who reached it called me something other than a patron.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.follow2: §b§oContinue anyway. I would rather you stand in cold truth than float in a warm lie.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.line1: §b§oThree-quarters of this road is behind you. Most turn back here, and not because they falter.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.line2: §b§oThey see the end of the path. It asks more than they hoped to give.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v1.line1: §b§oYou have become very hard to deceive. The Harbingers would pay a great deal for that.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v1.line2: §b§oThe blood-cult keeps away from clarity. Let one Archon see the Order as it is. The Order would not survive the sight.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is still and precise as a knife on glass.]
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.reveal1: §b§oSoon you will ask what I am. I will answer truthfully. The Unstained believe things about me that are not so.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.reveal2: §b§oI am no goddess and no patron. I am the oldest fact this world has. The blood-cult has spent millennia trying to bury me.
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v0.follow: §b§o[The sensation passes as quickly as it came. Only the cold remains, along with the faint smell of still water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v0.line1: §b§o[A chill settles over you, still as a frozen lake. Somewhere, very far away, you hear running water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v1.line1: §b§o[The air around you goes quiet, and for a moment the blood in your veins weighs less.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v2.follow: §b§o[The feeling draws back like a tide going out and leaves you unsure whether you were comforted or unsettled.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v2.line1: §b§o[Your skin prickles. Something is watching you the way deep water watches, without malice and without hurry.]
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.follow1: §b§oFight them or flee them. That choice is yours. I will not make it for you.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.follow2: §b§oThis much I will tell you. You are harder to hurt than you were. Silver Ward protects you. It also tells anyone watching that you have chosen a side.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.line1: §b§oHalf of the clarity path lies behind you. You have begun to see through walls. Your eyes still stop at the stone. The rest of you does not.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.line2: §b§oSooner or later the Harbingers will come to reclaim you. They always do. You will know them before they speak.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v1.line1: §b§oThe blood-cult sees only the blood. It would have you believe the world is that simple. You have begun to see what the blood was meant to hide.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v1.line2: §b§oBeneath all of this lies what came before hemomancy. I think you have begun to suspect it.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v2.follow: §b§oClarity is a lens. You carry it and never set it down. Even at the path's end, you will see more through it.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v2.line1: §b§o[The cold presence feels almost warm now, the way the first autumn frost makes you glad the fire is lit inside.]

hemomancy.lethean_tide.end: §b§lThe Lethean Tide sweeps the sky clean. The Blood Moon is gone.
hemomancy.living_staff.bond_unlocked: A Living Staff answers your blood.
hemomancy.machine_access.locked: Craft a %s yourself to use it.
hemomancy.machine_access.no_loot: The %s comes apart without yielding its workings.
hemomancy.manipulation.activation_potent: Charges a radial electrical discharge. Charge strengthens damage; confirmed hits interrupt actions for 10 ticks without slowing movement. Water, iron and copper carry current.
hemomancy.manipulation.black_veil_covena: Raises a black veil of synthetic darkness for thirty seconds, Obscuring those caught inside as it falls. While you stand within your own veil you gain Resistance and fire protection at the cost of weakness. Cannot be recast while the veil stands.
Readies the staff to draw blood from valid targets.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_aneurysm.de: Ruptures the nearest visible hostile vessel: a monster, a mob hunting you, or a player you may harm. Consumes Sanguine Pressure for up to 2 additional damage per level, scaled by charge. Fails without cost if no hostile is in reach.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_lattice.des: Spreads an aimed binding lattice through a packed group of nearby creatures.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_cloud.desc: Hurls a blood cloud that settles over the ground and wounds creatures beneath it. Its first touch on each creature builds Sanguine Pressure; later touches only wound.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_eclipse_man: Retired compatibility entry; its defensive tradeoff now belongs to Black Veil Covenant.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_eclipse.des: Obscures enemy perception beyond four blocks. Close defense remains possible; Illumination pierces school concealment.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_lamp.desc: Places a small blood-made light in dark spaces.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_needle.desc: Hardens blood into iron barbs and looses them in a rapid volley.
Scatters a broad fan of blood needles across a wider area.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_needle_lanc: Fully charge to forge the volley into three barbed iron needles that pierce several bodies and briefly pin what they strike.
Readies the staff to feed blood into structures and machines.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_rush.desc: Floods your body with quickening blood for eight seconds, increasing speed and attack speed and healing half a health point each second.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_shot.desc: Fires a condensed blood projectile at the target.
hemomancy.manipulation.canopy_mortis.des: Carries Lignum Mortis between trees through touching leaves without harvesting leaves. Release or complete the selection to harvest.
hemomancy.manipulation.chain_blood_bindi: Chains a shorter binding from the first victim into nearby creatures.
hemomancy.manipulation.bloom_of_rot.desc: Erupts Putriciel's bloom through every body you may harm within eight blocks, dealing 3 damage and Necrosis. It also poisons you.
hemomancy.manipulation.cauterizing_rebuk: Burns Poison, Wither, Necrosis and Blood Loss out of your body at one health apiece, then flares at enemies within four blocks with fire damage and Searing, without setting them alight.
hemomancy.manipulation.conductive_mark.d: Marks a preferred discharge target for twelve seconds. Later allied Ductilis, Lux or Ferric hits arc into nearby enemies. The mark itself does not electrify terrain.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_axe.desc: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Axe.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_blade.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Blade.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_claws.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into living claws.
Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Crossbow.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_flail.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Flail.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_sickle.de: Calls Vesper's disciplined refusal into the shape of a Living Sickle.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_spear.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Spear.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_staff.des: Conjures a Living Staff into your hand.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_torch.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Torch.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_flame_con: Places crimson flame where the blood points.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_harvest.d: Coaxes crops and living growth with a crimson surge.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_sight.des: Grants night vision and marks nearby creatures through darkness.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_tithe.des: Borrows 500 blood into the shared reserve for thirty seconds. Spent reserve incurs double blood repayment and six health damage; unused blood is reclaimed.
hemomancy.manipulation.cryogenic_pulse.d: Releases a cold pulse that deals freeze damage to nearby enemies and builds Rime in their blood.
hemomancy.manipulation.deadly_gaze.desc: Lifts what you look at; a full charge interrupts and slams the target.
hemomancy.manipulation.endless_hour.desc: Defers lethal damage at one health point for ten seconds. The unpaid damage returns as one hit when the hour ends or you leave the world. Armor, effects and absorption do not soften it, but a Totem of Undying or Phoenix Debt can still answer it.
hemomancy.manipulation.expansive_blood_c: Hurls a larger blood cloud, four blocks in radius, that briefly blankets a wider area.
hemomancy.manipulation.expulsive_updraft: Launches you only a little way but bursts outward, scorching nearby enemies with fire and Searing and throwing them aside. Needs footing.
hemomancy.manipulation.exsanguinate.desc: Executes a visible, badly wounded blood-bearing enemy and restores 250 blood only on a kill. Bosses cannot be executed outright: the drain against them is capped at twelve health points, scaled by Crimson Mastery.
Retired compatibility entry; its alloy buff now belongs to Ferric Transmutation.
hemomancy.manipulation.ferric_transmutat: Hardens blood into ferric force, empowering strikes and siphon effects.
hemomancy.manipulation.glacial_bastion.d: Retired compatibility entry; crouch-cast Glacial Rampart for its ice shell.
hemomancy.manipulation.glacial_circulati: Chills your blood to resist fire while slowing movement.
hemomancy.manipulation.glacial_grasp.des: Freezes source water along an aimed path and adds two Rime levels to targets wet from water or rain. Dry targets in the path take light freeze damage and one Rime level. Rime slows movement, not attacks or casting.
hemomancy.manipulation.glacial_rampart.d: Raises an aimed ice wall for twelve seconds, or a surrounding ice shell while crouching.
hemomancy.manipulation.grave_debt.desc: Marks a target with a debt that bursts at low health and refunds blood if death claims it.
hemomancy.manipulation.blackhearted.desc: While enabled with active blood and sufficient Mortem alignment, converts most Wither harm into recovery until necrotic saturation ruptures.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_beacon.de: Creates an aimed rally zone that mends allies a little and steadies them with brief Resistance each second, while Illuminating any creature or player inside that you may harm.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_impressme: Interrupts one blood-bearing creature and leashes its nerves to yours, impressing it into defending you and your allies for a time.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_rebuke.de: Jolts a command down a blood-bearing creature's nerves: it stops what it was doing, drops its target and flees for eight seconds.
hemomancy.manipulation.cruor_javelin.des: Hurls a shaft of frozen cruor at the creature you aim at, dealing freeze damage and driving two Rime levels into it, or three if it is wet from water or rain.
hemomancy.manipulation.fruiting_contagio: Every nearby enemy already carrying Necrosis is wracked and withered, and its rot spreads Necrosis to other enemies close by. Fails if no rot has taken root.
hemomancy.manipulation.searing_lash.desc: Cracks a whip of boiling blood against the creature you aim at, scalding and igniting it and laying a long Searing that primes Vitric Combustion for its full detonation bonus.
hemomancy.manipulation.umbral_rend.desc: Tears open every Obscured enemy before you at once. The shadow already clinging to them is spent for extra damage and leaves them bleeding. Fails if nothing ahead is Obscured.
Rakes the creature before you with a short slash of shadow and leaves it bleeding. It bites deeper while you are unseen or standing in darkness; Illumination strips that edge.
hemomancy.manipulation.radiant_wake.desc: While held, radiance holds you aloft: falling turns into a glide along your gaze. Each pulse mends you and nearby allies, bites enemies already Illuminated, and leaves nearby enemies Illuminated.
hemomancy.manipulation.lodestone_collaps: Charge to magnetize a point ahead. Every enemy in reach with a clear line to the point is dragged into it and crushed; walls shield. Lodestone and deep Rime in their blood collapse for extra damage, and a full charge pins them.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_riposte.d: A clawed blood-arm erupts from your back and slaps across your front. Hits from ahead within the swing are turned aside: melee attackers are stunned, projectiles are swatted away, and a successful parry cuts the cooldown short.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_mortar.de: Fully charge to lob one heavy blood shot in an arc before it bursts across a small area.
hemomancy.manipulation.hemolymphal_pulse: Sends a sensory impulse through nearby blood-bearing bodies you could harm, revealing them and marking wounded targets. You, your allies and your pets are not revealed. Does not electrify terrain.
hemomancy.manipulation.hemorrhage.desc: Inflicts twelve seconds of Blood Loss on the nearest visible enemy and seeds Necrosis in the wound for Mortem follow-ups.
hemomancy.manipulation.hemosynthesis.des: Turns blood into restorative living energy.
hemomancy.manipulation.insatiable_hunger: Bites a target for 2 damage that seeds Necrosis, then curses its recovery, reducing healing and turning food into gnawing hunger.
hemomancy.manipulation.lignum_mortis.des: Threads blood through connected wood and fungus. Release to harvest marked blocks; a completed selection automatically harvests and ends the channel.
hemomancy.manipulation.lingering_blood_b: Forms a longer-lived binding around one creature.
hemomancy.manipulation.iron_retort.desc: Raises a brief iron guard that cuts incoming melee damage and lashes back at the attacker.
hemomancy.manipulation.ironhearted.desc: Fully charge to store up to two Iron Hearts (4 health) for ten minutes. Stored hearts take damage first; active Thorn, Anvil, and Crucible scars expand capacity.
message.hemomancy.ironhearted.charge: Hold the manipulation until the iron heart finishes forming.
message.hemomancy.ironhearted.full: Your iron casing cannot hold another heart.
message.hemomancy.blackhearted.passive: Blackhearted is a passive; toggle it with the manipulation key.
hemomancy.manipulation.lumen_suture.desc: Sutures the nearest wounded ally with light: heals one heart, grants brief absorption, and clears Blindness, Wither, Necrosis and Obscured. Falls back to yourself.
hemomancy.manipulation.osseous_bloom.des: Crystallizes the blood of every enemy within six blocks, dealing a quarter of its current health as freeze damage and building Rime. Best as an opener, not a finisher. Boss damage is capped at twelve health points. Fails without cost if no enemy is in reach.
hemomancy.manipulation.prismatic_reproof: Projects a cone of Lux for 4 damage, or 8 against a previously Illuminated target. Consumes Illumination without reapplying it.
hemomancy.manipulation.pyretic_forge.des: Smelts held items with fevered blood.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_excavati: Breaks a compact cluster of blocks along your line of sight.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_ignition: Scorches every body within five blocks with superheated blood and sets it alight for two seconds. Wet, rimed, fire-immune or fire-resistant bodies are not set alight.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_magnetis: Raises an anchored iron pillar for six seconds, pulling enemies inward and pinning nearby bodies. When it falls, it slams every enemy it pulled within three blocks for 4 Ferric damage, or 6 if Lodestoned. Ductilis can energize the pillar to relay shocks into nearby enemies.
Cheaply repairs the damaged gear held in your hand.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_ward.des: Channels a reactive electrical sheath. Incoming damage consumes its protection pool and jolts any direct attacker; later paid pulses slowly replenish it. A ward recast within five seconds of lapsing resumes its depleted pool; after longer it starts fresh.
Superheats the air beneath your feet, launching you upward and scorching nearby foes. Needs footing: ground, water or a ladder.
hemomancy.manipulation.guided_blood_shot: Steers a blood shot toward the creature nearest your aim.
hemomancy.manipulation.pursuing_blood_cl: Creates a compact blood cloud that slowly follows nearby enemies.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_halo.des: Suspends five blood shots around you to seek nearby hostiles one at a time. Passive animals, pets and villagers are ignored.
Seeds a broad, stationary storm cloud whose blood lightning strikes the nearest creature beneath it each second, without igniting the world.
hemomancy.manipulation.soaring_updraft.d: Launches you faster and higher, carrying some of your forward momentum. Needs footing.
hemomancy.manipulation.suspended_updraft: Launches you into a brief levitating pause before slow falling takes hold. Needs footing.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar.des: Manifests the Blood Avatar around your own body while you sustain it, turning aside a quarter of incoming harm. The void, /kill and starvation pass through it.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar_arm: Manifests the avatar's arms, strengthening your blows while it shelters you.
Manifests an armored torso with greater protection and the avatar's striking arms.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar_leg: Manifests the avatar through its legs, increasing movement and step height.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar_com: Manifests the complete Blood Avatar at its greatest protection, strength, and speed.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_thrall.des: Raises a blood thrall from a suitable source block.
hemomancy.manipulation.synaptic_jolt.des: Shocks a nearby target and interrupts actions for 10 ticks without slowing movement. Can energize water, iron, copper or an owned Ferric construct.
hemomancy.manipulation.umbral_reversal.d: Reverses backward into a nearby dark space and Obscures enemies left behind.
hemomancy.manipulation.umbral_step.desc: Steps to a safe, supported shadow beside or above the targeted block.
hemomancy.manipulation.unclosing_eye.des: Persistently strips nearby concealment with Seraphae's unforgiving sight.
Scans nearby ore veins and reports their count plus the nearest ore and its coordinates.
hemomancy.manipulation.venous_travel.des: Travel along prepared venous paths between linked blood structures.
hemomancy.manipulation.vital_effusion.de: Spends blood to stir living growth in nearby plants.
hemomancy.manipulation.vital_reservoir.d: Drains life from a wounded target and returns blood to you.
hemomancy.manipulation.vitric_combustion: Detonates superheated blood. Consumes remaining Searing heat for up to 4 additional damage.
hemomancy.manipulation.worked_lignum.des: Extends Lignum Mortis into tagged worked materials such as wooden planks. Release or complete the selection to harvest.
hemomancy.manipulation.void_shroud.desc: Veils you in shadow for five seconds with speed and night vision. Attacking breaks the Veil, and Illumination exposes it.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.already_awake: Vesper's refusal is already disciplined within your staff-bond.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.awakened: Vesper's memory settles into your Living Staff bond.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.inactive: Your blood is inactive. The memory has no living current to discipline.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.no_bond: The memory refuses you. It needs a Living Staff bond.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.rite_guidance: Place this in an Iron Brazier, then channel Blood Absorption through a Living Staff.
hemomancy.milestone.adept_ascension.desc: Ascend to Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. The blood has taken root.
hemomancy.milestone.altar_blessing.desc: Receive the one-time blessing of Our Lady at an Altar of Cleansing
hemomancy.milestone.apotheos_ascension.d: Ascend to Apotheos of the Hematic Order. The final hush opens.
hemomancy.milestone.archon_ascension.des: Ascend to Archon of the Hematic Order
hemomancy.milestone.first_manipulation.d: Use a blood manipulation for the first time
hemomancy.milestone.first_morphling_bond: Equip a morphling companion for the first time
hemomancy.milestone.first_rite.desc: Complete a cardinal rite for the first time
hemomancy.milestone.illuminatus_ascensio: Ascend to Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge
hemomancy.milestone.initiate_ascension.d: Ascend to Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane
hemomancy.milestone.our_lady_of_still_wa: Obtain the Icon of Our Lady
hemomancy.milestone.sanctified_ascension: Ascend to Sanctified of the Bloodline Covenant. The network grows.
Accept formal initiation from the Vicar
hemomancy.milestone.votary_ascension.des: Ascend to Votary of the Hematic Covenant
hemomancy.mnemonist.clarity.line1: The silence around you is bright. Painfully bright.
hemomancy.mnemonist.clarity.line2: Ask, if you must. The path you left is still on file. I will not hand its living lessons back to you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.crude_memories.line1: Crude memories are rough early echoes. Use one. Pay its blood cost. The manipulation joins the lessons you know.
hemomancy.mnemonist.crude_memories.line2: An empty active slot, and the new lesson files itself there. Every slot full, and it waits in your library until you learn the arranging yourself.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_hint: Show me what you carry. I will sort it: what holds a memory, and what only pretends to.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.crude_m: Filed under Lux. Blood Lamp lights the dark so you can see in it.
A humble echo, and a good one. Many Harbingers learn light before any other mercy.
The body's memory of panic, put to use as speed. Blood Rush.
An early lesson in movement. Mind the cost. Fast blood is still blood spent.
Pressure, release, a line of blood drawn through the air. Blood Shot. As simple as lessons get.
Not before initiation. After it, an empty active slot takes this lesson by itself.
Crimson Harvest. Ductilis at work: draw, gather, take what the vein can use.
A field lesson. It teaches the blood that utility can be as sacred as violence.
Intent, sent through the eyes before the hand moves. Deadly Gaze. An ugly little lesson, and a useful one.
Crude is not harmless. Be careful what you teach your blood to hate.
Glacial Grasp. Congeatio slows the world until a mistake can be studied.
Cold. It means you no harm. The stillness it buys can save your life.
A small opening, then insistence. Hemorrhage. Mortem knows how endings begin.
Use it with restraint. Blood learns cruel habits easily, and keeps them.
Fever, a spark, the red thought just before flame. Filed under Flammeus: Sanguine Ignition.
An eager lesson. Do not mistake eagerness for mastery.
Sanguine Mending repairs you. Ferric memory is fond of repair. It takes payment first.
The wound gives. Your reserve answers for it.
Tenebris work. Void Shroud pulls the dark close, and you breathe quietly under it.
It hides you from enemies. Mind that it does not begin hiding you from yourself.
Hematic Flare. Lux stretches the blood thin and white, and whatever hides from you stands lit.
Do not call it mercy. It lets nothing go unseen, you included.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.hematic: A blank Hematic Memory. Nothing written in it yet. A cup waiting for a voice.
The Loom can weave a chosen lesson into it. First your Degree and your materials must be ready.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.living_: A limb-pattern. Do not file it as an arsenal ledger. The staff still answers only through manipulations you know.
Do the matching deed. Craft the graft. Burn it in the Brazier while your staff drinks the memory.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.memory_: Tenebris you can see. Black Veil Covenant raises a chapel of dark blood and branching veins.
Inside its sphere the shadow is literal. Walk carefully.
Blood Absorption. A utility lesson. I will not hear it called weak.
It teaches you to draw in what spilled power is left. Learn it early, while every reserve counts.
A defensive eclipse, held close enough to bruise the ribs. Blood Eclipse Mantle.
It protects you. The price is your strength, which kneels while the shadow hardens.
Blood Projection. The same first doctrine, pointed outward.
Absorbing is intake. Projecting is offering. Most Harbingers know both before they learn any pride.
A refined Blood Rush, with fewer burrs than the crude shard. It spends its lesson more cleanly.
Keep the crude version on file, though. It taught your body how to begin.
The same first line of force as the scraped shard. Cleaner. A refined Blood Shot.
Full memories keep their rank gates. The crystal can be ready before you are.
Blood Binding. Simple restraint, if another body is only blood taught to stay.
The tendrils start at your feet. Keep your footing. They hold the target just as still.
Flammeus as medicine, if you can stand the smell of burning. Cauterizing Rebuke.
It burns venom and rot out of the caster. Then nearby enemies get the same treatment.
Conductive Mark leaves a patient sign, bright enough for allied blood-work to find.
Ductilis, Lux and Ferric blows can catch the mark. From it they leap outward into nearby enemies.
A refined Deadly Gaze, shaped on purpose. The crude one was scraped out of old panic.
Refining steadies a memory. The lesson stays as ugly as it was.
A full memory crystal. Stable, made on purpose, fit for proper loadout work.
Carry one because you mean to use it. Refined memories hold their shape longer than crude shards.
Glacial Rampart. Congeatio cold, stood upright on a spine of blood.
A short-lived wall between you and harm. It buys time.
Gloam Laceration. A Tenebris knife, kept where the light forgets to look.
It bites deepest from a shroud or true darkness. What it opens keeps bleeding after.
Grave Debt. A Mortem ledger written against a living balance.
When the vessel falls low, it bursts. Death may return a measure of blood to the creditor.
Filed under Mortem. Blackhearted teaches your heart to feed on the death meant for it.
There is a limit. Once the vessel saturates, the debt breaks inward and the lesson goes silent.
Hematic Beacon. A signal fire, carried under the skin.
Allies under it hold steadier. Hostiles become easier for the covenant to name.
Borrowed loyalty, written straight into another pulse. Hematic Impressment.
One vessel only can bear your command. Stronger blood sheds it sooner.
Hematic Rebuke. A command sent down another body's nerves. That body feels fear before any blade is drawn.
It cannot command bloodless bodies, or greater wills.
Cruor Javelin. Congeatio does not wait for the river. It brings its own cold, and throws it.
What it strikes stiffens. Iron finishes what the frost started.
Mortem never stops at one wound. Fruiting Contagion makes rot that has taken hold bear fruit.
It cannot start rot, only hurry it. Something must be dying already.
Searing Lash. Flammeus heat, run along something you can swing. Heat travels best that way.
What it strikes is marked for a greater burning. Do not lash anything you are not willing to finish.
Umbral Rend. The hand closes on what is already held. Tenebris must lay the dark on first.
No shadow on them yet, nothing to tear. So you wait.
Lux stretched thin enough to bear your weight. Radiant Wake will not lift you. It will not let you fall, either.
Whoever stands near you stays mended. Everything hostile stays exposed. You pay for the sky by being seen.
Lodestone Collapse. Ferric fixed iron into their blood long before. This calls it home.
Everything it pulls comes in together. Watch where you stand when the iron answers.
A limb your body never grew. Hematic Riposte raises it, and it answers faster than the hand you own.
It guards only what you face, and only for a heartbeat. Mistime it and the blood is spent on air.
Hematic Flare. Lux that strikes without waiting for the dark to confess.
It brands hidden things and burns what it catches. Concealment becomes a wound.
Mortem work. Insatiable Hunger turns appetite against its own remedy.
Healing thins under it. Food deepens the ache where it should comfort.
Iron Retort. Ferric patience, folded into one answer.
The guard takes the first bite and dulls it. Then it answers through the attacker's own opening.
Ironhearted. Ferric blood builds a second pulse and puts it in a silver cage.
Hold the memory steady until the metal closes. The borrowed heart is spent before yours.
Lumen Suture. Lux can light a room, or it can set a needle of light exactly where you need one.
A pale thread closes the pain. Blindness is cut from the wound.
Prismatic Reproof judges a threat. It splits it into every color it tried to hide.
It hits harder on prey already exposed by Illumination. The judgment uses up that light.
Sanguine Magnetism. Ferric blood knows where iron wants to gather.
A pillar rises. Hostile bodies are dragged close enough to hold still.
Hot air rising under a storm-black roof, kept in the blood. Scalding Updraft.
Stand on the fire's breath. It throws you where your legs cannot.
Synaptic Jolt. Ductilis can stop the nerve as readily as it moves the body.
A short bolt. It interrupts and staggers the struck vessel. For a moment, it cannot answer cleanly.
Umbral Reversal. When the chase grows too certain, it answers from behind.
It needs darkness to catch you, or a Veil willing to pretend the world has none.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.minecra: Ordinary pages. Every archive starts with them. A mundane store of knowledge, and still useful.
Bring me enough of these and I can index blood-memory instead of guessing at it.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.mnemoni: A blank blueprint. It waits for spatial memory. Manipulation lessons do not go on it.
A rite, pressed into the page: its distances, its order, how the parts relate. It maps the rite. It carries none of the rite's authority.
A blood structure, fixed into something you can carry. It will guide your hand. The understanding must be yours.
The Mnemonic Reliquary. It arranges Thelemic and Noetic Memories within one active loadout.
The Reliquary chooses which known lessons sit nearest the pulse. New ones come from the memory item.
The Reliquary is a third-Degree weave. Until then, let your first bodily lessons settle into the open slots nearest your pulse.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.orb_of_: A fixed eye for a room built from memory. Its skies come only from places its owner reached. Nothing in it is invented.
Throw it off the Chamber floor. The fall changes the remembered perspective. The Orb returns to whoever owns the cell.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.puppete: Enthralling Filament. A restraint fiber. Peacock Spiders, surface Hemojellies and Blood Drunk Puppeteers supply it. The Somatic Loom weaves it into memory. The Spindle stores its tension for a Crossbar.
Keep it. At the second Degree you may study the fiber. Your first true string waits until I have taught you how memory is prepared.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.salt_st: Salt ruins paper faster than blood ruins memory. Hold it still while I read. There. Current marks, specimen counts, a prayer before the descent.
The last line asks the reader to use what they learned, if they fail to surface. 'That is what remains of us.'
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.scar_pa: A scar pattern schema. Instruction for flesh, tendency, and threshold.
A pattern has no power of its own. It hands the blood a grammar. Whether the blood can speak the sentence is up to the blood.
An unwritten motif. The Effigy has not yet persuaded blood to leave a route on it.

Several known routes, one motif. Put it in an empty Iron Brazier. Light it with Blood Projection. Then hold Blood Absorption on the offering. The commit costs 50 mL. It replaces your active cerebral loadout.
One scar route, written out. A carving lesson for the Cerebral Scarring Station.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.somatic: The Somatic Loom. Tendency inputs, blood and a pattern go in. A blood memory comes out, woven on purpose.
A crude shard is an echo you happened to find. The Loom makes a crystal to order.
The Somatic Loom will not open to you before the third Degree. Scraped echoes must carry you a little longer.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.unknown: I can't hear a lesson in that, unless it's smart enough to keep quiet.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line1: The Somatic Loom. Here scraped shards give way to memories woven on purpose.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line2: Pay its blood. An engram opens around the Loom: an eight-pointed star, the memory's fragments waiting at its points. Each is a piece of what an earlier Harbinger knew. Thread every fragment home along the star's lines with your staff. Never let two colors cross.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line3: Some fragments are false. The blood files its failures as carefully as its lessons. Rest your eyes on a fragment and it shows you its memory. A false one shows you someone else's. It beats against the loom, not with it.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.role: The Loom weaves memories to learn. The Scriptorium inscribes equipment. An optional workshop. The Woven Vessel does not need it.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.material: Build the base station around an Enchanting Table, with Sanguine Glass and Hematic Iron Blocks. Hold a Ferric Binder. Offer an Enzyme Primer, a Blood Crystal Shard, a Lapis Block and 500 mL of blood.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.eightfol: At the fifth Degree, the Rite of the Eightfold Script rules its lines in red. One inscription can then be singled out and raised above the rest.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.palimpse: At the seventh Degree, the Rite of the Palimpsest scrapes the page back to what the blood remembers. The chosen inscription can then be cut deeper than ink allows.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.rubricat: Ask for the quill that marks one line in red.
First write something at a Scriptorium. Keep your blood awake. At the fifth Degree I will lend you the quill the old rubricators used.
You have written at a Scriptorium. I have it on file. Take the quill. Set it with five more offerings at the Rite of the Eightfold Script.
The quill is yours already. If you need another, you know now how it is cut.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.palimpse: Ask for the burin that writes over what was written.

First learn ordinary inscription. Then single out an inscription at an Eightfold Scriptorium yourself. At the seventh Degree, with your blood awake, the burin cuts where the quill only marked. You need not have taken my quill.
You chose a line and made it stay. Take the burin and five more offerings to the Rite of the Palimpsest. Cut it deeper.
The burin is already yours. I do not issue the same edge twice. You know now how to shape another.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.prom: Ask for the harness that lets the loom hear its own engram.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.requ: First weave one memory home at a Somatic Loom, every fragment threaded. Keep your blood awake. At the fifth Degree I will give you a harness of nerve. With it the loom can hold memories a Magister made.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.read: You threaded a memory home and kept it. Take the harness. Set it with five more offerings at the Rite of the Ganglionic Weave.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.clai: The harness is yours already. A loom that has learned to feel does not forget. If you need another, you know how the nerve is bound.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.title: The Clotting Lattice
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.prompt: Ask for the lattice that teaches a cauldron to hold more.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.requir: Show me that you have drawn a formation out of a cauldron with your own hands, and keep your blood active. Once you reach the third Degree, the lattice is yours.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.ready: You fed a cauldron and took out what it set, which is the proof I asked for, so the lattice is yours. Seat it at the Rite of the First Clotting with five more offerings.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.claime: You already have our lattice, and if you need another, you can bind one yourself from scrap and ash.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.title: The Druse Heart
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.prompt: Ask for the heart that lines a Condenser in crystal.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.requirem: Draw a formation from a Latticed Condenser with your own hand and reach the fifth Degree, and the crystal heart is yours. After that, nothing you set in it will slump away.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.ready: Good. Your lattice has done its work, so take the heart to the Rite of Druse Crystallization and close three circuits there.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.claimed: You already carry our heart, and if you need a second, you will have to grow one from glass, amethyst and blood crystal.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.title: The Cortical Crown
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.prompt: Ask for the crown that lets the loom think the whole memory.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.requir: First weave a Magister's memory on a Ganglionic Loom yourself. At the sixth Degree, with your blood awake, the crown lets the loom carry a Perfectus memory at full stature. You need not have taken my harness.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.ready: That memory stood taller for you than for most. Take the crown and five more offerings to the Rite of the Cortical Weave. Let the loom see the whole of what it recalls.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.claime: The crown is already yours. A loom can wear only so much mind. You know now how another is folded.
hemomancy.loom.tier_required.1: This memory is too refined for this loom. It needs a Ganglionic Loom.
hemomancy.loom.tier_required.2: This memory is too refined for this loom. It needs a Cortical Loom.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_practice.line: Choose the exact Loom recipe before you pay blood. The blank vessel and the catalyst shape the weave. Stored enzymes alone do not choose the result.
The Reliquary arranges the Noetic and Thelemic memories you know, inside one active capacity. Swapping the active set erases nothing you have learned.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line1: The Dendritic Distributor saves named arrangements of the Noetic and Thelemic memories you know. It teaches none. Blood Absorption and Blood Projection are fixed. They stay out of custom patterns.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line2: Saving or overwriting a pattern costs 100 mL of blood and 25 raw XP. Renaming and applying are free. Three pattern slots, until Synaptic Memory adds more.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line3: Applying a pattern checks your current capacity and known memories. It replaces your active arrangement. Any running Thelemic memory the pattern leaves out is switched off.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line4: To build one, strike Infested Venous Stone with a Sanguine Formation. Frame the central stone with four Iron Bars. Then supply 500 mL of blood.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_lore.line1: Hematic Memory is repeatable instruction, preserved in blood. No whole life sits on my shelves. Only what someone could do again.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_lore.line2: Some lessons are understood as patterns and projected through manipulation. Others are prepared in the body. It enacts them when its vessels answer.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.ask_: You said memory has three movements?
hemomancy.mnemonist.mnemonic_doctrine.li: Mneme keeps. Nous knows. Thelēma acts.
Memory keeps the trace. Intellect sees its pattern. Will enacts it. Noetic and Thelemic practice: two methods on one substrate.
Working labels. We keep them because their predictions earn their keep.
hemomancy.mnemonist.neophyte.line1: Neophyte. There you are. I can hear the first crude echoes gathering around you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.neophyte.line2: The crude memories in old places still work. Use one. Learn what it does. At the second Degree, bring me that experience and choose one on purpose.
hemomancy.mnemonist.purifying.line1: §7[The Mnemonist's eyes soften, but their hands fold closed.]
hemomancy.mnemonist.purifying.line2: You are working the lessons loose from your blood. I will answer questions. I will not press another memory into a wound you are trying to clean.
hemomancy.mnemonist.reliquary.line1: The Mnemonic Reliquary keeps lessons you have already survived. Keep it as an orderly shelf. The learning still comes from the memories themselves.
hemomancy.mnemonist.reliquary.line2: It arranges your Noetic and Thelemic Memories into one active loadout. That changes what sits near the surface. The deeper library stays in you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.slots.line1: Your active mnemonic slots. They hold the Noetic and Thelemic lessons your blood keeps near the surface. Your whole memory reaches past them.
hemomancy.mnemonist.slots.line2: Early on, crude lessons may fill empty slots by themselves. Later the Reliquary lets you choose which lessons sleep close to the pulse.
hemomancy.mnemonist.starter_choice.line1: Choose one crude memory for the field. One you have already learned stays with you. Choosing erases nothing. I can put only one shard in your hand.
hemomancy.mnemonist.starter_choice.line2: Choose by instinct: reach, motion, or gaze.
hemomancy.mnemonist.uninitiated.line1: §7[A robed Harbinger presses two fingers to their own wrist, listening to a pulse you cannot hear.]
hemomancy.mnemonist.uninitiated.line2: Not yet. Blood holds many lessons, but it keeps its mouth closed for an uncut heir. Return after initiation. I will teach you to listen without drowning.
hemomancy.mnemonist.votary.line1: Votary. Choose a crude memory for reach, motion, or gaze. Use it in the field. The Reliquary comes later. It will let you arrange the lessons you know.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven_vessel.archive: Bring the blank vessel, with a book, ink and paper. I will index the first lesson. The weaving still happens at the Loom.
Make one blank Hematic Memory from four Sanguine Formations, four Blood Stained Stones, and one Neurotic Enzyme.

Find Blood Stained Stone in a Hermitage Remnant, or make each one from Venous Stone, a Sanguine Formation and redstone. Four crafted stones bring the blank to eight formations in all. Chicken blood can yield Neurotic Enzyme, though some spins yield Vivacious instead.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven.line1: Your blood knows enough words now. Crude shards will no longer do.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven.line2: The Loom weaves a chosen lesson, thread by thread. The finished crystal teaches it without a word.
hemomancy.monolith.archon.press_again: §7[The stone is fever-hot now. Holding your palm against it hurts.]§r Press here again. Not many more times remain.
The cube separates from the Lodestone without breaking it. For a moment the hollow it leaves gives off a low, warm hum.
The rack has been taught to hold blood. The Vicar taught it ceremony. No one has taught it silence.
