Take this small weight from me. Offer it at a lit brazier during the Rite of the Monolithic Armature. The consecrated frame will remember the shape of armor that no voice should wear.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.adept: Adept. The Brotherhood recognizes your blood. In the Sainted Mausoleums the preserved corpus still holds the enzymes of Saints. Draw from it. The next rite needs them.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.adept.line1: §7[The stone is cold under your palm. A faint hum rises through it, too even for rock and too uneven for any machine you know.]
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.adept.line2: Adept. The Brotherhood recognizes your blood. In the Sainted Mausoleums the preserved corpus still holds the Saints' enzymes. Draw from it. What you need next is that weight.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon: Archon. Under your power the monolith has begun to crack. Press further and it may shatter into black shards.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon.line1: I have been waiting for you. Someone like you would not do. It had to be §oyou§r.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon.line2: §7[The stone is hot under your palm. Deep inside it, something shifts its weight in a space too small for it. You hear it more than feel it.]
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.illuminatus: Illuminatus. The Crimson Lodge has opened its gates. Go down into the crimson fungal depths and commune with the Dendritic Distributors. There the mycelial network whispers of dormant power.
§7[The stone is faintly warm where you touch it. That is new.]
Illuminatus. The Lodge's gates stand open. Under your feet the mycelial network whispers of dormant power. The stone believes you are beginning to hear it.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.sanctified: Sanctified of the Covenant. Few have walked this far. Enter the Chamber of Will by your own rite and prepare for the judgment that makes an Archon.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.sanctified.l: §7[Under your palm the stone is warm and gives a little, like skin over muscle.]
Sanctified of the Covenant. The Loom taught you to make memory on purpose. Now I would have you learn the inward room, where memory, scar and will become architecture.
hemomancy.monolith.item_hint: Hold what you carry against the stone. It answers only what touches the threshold.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.fragment: This is still warm with the pressure it remembers. It is quiet. Memory moves through it all the same.
Use it carefully. It teaches nothing alone. It resonates.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.minecraf: Yes. The old world keeps artifacts that still resonate with thresholds, anchors, and return paths.
A familiar relic can still belong to an uncommon rite. Treat it as unknown until you learn its place.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.qliphoth: Qliphoth reagents open a path where doctrine thins. They draw you forward along it.
Proceed if you intend to finish the conversation.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.rite_sit: This structure belongs to the high covenant sequence: foundation, offering, witness, and consequence.
You are no longer assembling tools. You are assembling conditions.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.saint.li: Saint matter and saint echoes suit the oldest rites. They have already survived one collapse.
What you carry proves continuity, not victory.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.unknown: Nothing of that touches the threshold.
hemomancy.monolith.unworthy: The monolith is silent. Its surface is cold and unyielding under your hand. You have not yet proven yourself worthy.
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.adept: A lodestone of the Order, built by the Crimson Lodge in the Second Age. It remembers every Harbinger who has stood before it. Every degree. Every name.
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.archon: You are close enough now that I can speak plainly. What is inside me knows what is inside you. We are, in some sense, the same thing. Do you feel it ripening?
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.illumina: The Lodge believed this stone was built to measure. The truth is slightly different.
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.sanctifi: I contain something. I always have. The Lodge sealed it here because they did not know what else to do with it.
hemomancy.mortal_display.already_invited: The invitation has already marked you.
hemomancy.mortal_display.charm_equipped: A living adornment latches around your neck. It marks you for the Harbinger's path.
hemomancy.occulus.task.adept: Master advanced blood manipulations, then perform the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood.
hemomancy.occulus.task.archon: Perform the Rite of the Hematic Order to become an Archon, the highest Degree the blood-tide grants.
hemomancy.occulus.task.illuminatus: Perform the Rite of the Crimson Lodge to rise to Illuminatus. It demands more devotion and a firmer command of blood.
hemomancy.occulus.task.initiate: Complete the Alchemist's First Separation and an Alembic distillation, then inject Concentrated Blood and sleep.
hemomancy.occulus.task.neophyte: Meet the Vicar and ask for formal initiation into the Harbingers.
hemomancy.occulus.task.sanctified: Perform the Rite of the Bloodline Covenant to rise to Sanctified.
hemomancy.occulus.task.votary: Complete the Vicar's first bloodcraft lessons and return for Degree 2.
hemomancy.rite.antiseptic_ground.desc: Lays virid salis and cleansed stone as a warded floor. Blood cannot be gathered on it, and hostile bodies that cross it are seared.
hemomancy.rite.antiseptic_ground.name: Rite of Antiseptic Ground
hemomancy.rite.archon_rite.name: Rite of the Hematic Order
hemomancy.rite.ashen_vessel_rite.name: Rite of the Ashen Vessel
hemomancy.rite.bloom_of_qliphoth.desc: A dark rite that grows a blooming Qliphoth tree, its roots drawing on the blood in the earth. A Qliphoth Seed must be seated in the Cardinal Focus as its medium. In the tree's shadow, all blood manipulations are empowered and the body heals itself.
hemomancy.rite.bloom_of_qliphoth.name: Bloom of the Qliphoth
hemomancy.rite.closed_vein.desc: Teaches the purified vessel to close around old wounds. Blood loss is prevented, hostile bodies are slowed, and the first Still Arts take a deeper hold.
hemomancy.rite.closed_vein.name: Rite of the Closed Vein
hemomancy.rite.crimson_vessel_rite.name: Rite of the Crimson Vessel
hemomancy.rite.founding_fane.desc: A grand consecration open only to the Illuminatus. The caster seats a Sanguine Quintessence in the Cardinal Focus as the medium, and the rite establishes a Harbinger Founding Fane with its boundary, its recall anchor and its bloodline-tied ground.
hemomancy.rite.glass_lungs.desc: White glass, pale water and copper steady the breath. The rite rinses poison and wither from the chest, so the supplicant can breathe where corruption would choke them.
hemomancy.rite.glass_lungs.name: Rite of Glass Lungs
hemomancy.rite.illuminatus_rite.desc: The fifth rite of the Hematic Order, by which an adept is admitted as Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. This is a rite of ascension, not the consecration of a Fane.
hemomancy.rite.illuminatus_rite.name: Rite of the Crimson Lodge
hemomancy.rite.initiate_rite.blob_grante: A sanguine orb coalesces in your hand, bound to your command.
hemomancy.rite.initiate_rite.name: Rite of the Incarnadine Fane
hemomancy.rite.lethean_tide.desc: An Unstained greater rite. It calls up the purifying waters of Lethe to end a Blood Moon, clearing the sky and granting the caster a surge of purity. Requires at least 50 purity.
hemomancy.rite.moon_washed_copper.desc: Oxidized copper is washed in moon-cold clarity until its verdigris forms a halo that can diagnose. The highest Still Arts open to the supplicant.
hemomancy.rite.moon_washed_copper.name: Rite of Moon-Washed Copper
hemomancy.rite.pallid_vessel_rite.name: Rite of the Pallid Vessel
hemomancy.rite.sanctified_rite.name: Rite of the Bloodline Covenant
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_eclipse.desc: A forbidden rite that forces a Blood Moon to rise. It empowers all Harbingers and weakens the uninitiated.
hemomancy.scout.farewell.line1: §o...Good.§r §7[She exhales slowly and closes her eyes. The hand holding the journal goes still.]
hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line1: They act like they do outside. Hunting food, pushing at the walls, circling each other. But they never took me for anything. §oNot a threat. Not prey. Nothing.§r
hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line2: At the church, the Tooth Pecks wouldn't leave Annetta be. They seek active infection. So every ward failed. They were hunting something she never knew she carried.
hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line3: §oThink what that means for her.§r All of it is in the notes. Use it if you can.
hemomancy.scout.root.line1: §7[An Unstained woman is slumped against the bone-speckled wall of the geode, her robes filthy with stone dust. She looks up at you, glassy-eyed but focused.]
hemomancy.scout.root.line2: Oh. §o...Someone found me.§r I don't have long. Cold and hunger are doing what the creatures never could. Please. I have notes. Observations. They can't be wasted. Take them while I can still hand them over.
hemomancy.scout.root.line3: §oDon't let the work go to waste.§r
hemomancy.scout.what_happened.line1: I came in after the creatures. The Church sends scouts to learn what they are, what they eat, whether they can be reasoned with. I spent a day in here taking notes. Then the exit collapsed. §oI never found it again.§r
hemomancy.scout.what_happened.line2: But the bugs. They never touched me. Not once. Three days alone with them, and they look right through me. I wrote it all down. I don't know what it means. I know it §omatters§r.
hemomancy.silver_bells.already_pure: The bells toll softly. Your purification is already complete.
hemomancy.silver_bells.already_rung: The pale silver bells are quiet now. Their blessing has already been spent.
hemomancy.silver_bells.chimed: §bThe pale silver bells ring across the sky. A great wave of purity floods your blood.
hemomancy.silver_bells.not_on_path: The pale silver bells do not answer you.
hemomancy.still_art.gifted: A Still Art settles into you: %s
hemomancy.still_art.pale_intercession.re: Our Lady's manifestation returns to your side.
hemomancy.still_art.pale_intercession.fa: There is no safe place for her attention to take shape.
hemomancy.still_art.select.invalid: That Still Art cannot be selected.
hemomancy.still_art.select.locked: Your clarity isn't high enough for that Still Art yet.
hemomancy.still_art.select.unknown: The Lady has not given you this Still Art.
hemomancy.summon.bind.success: The crossbar attunes itself to you.
hemomancy.summon.cap.reached: Your skein can only hold %s active summons.
hemomancy.summon.cap.shaped: You can hold %s shaped bodies. Bonus slots from claimed Wills can't take a learned shape.
hemomancy.summon.cap.unravel: %s unravels as the older tethers fill your active limit.
hemomancy.summon.command.guard: The skein knots itself to this ground.
hemomancy.summon.command.hunt: The skein loosens for the hunt.
hemomancy.summon.crossbar.foreign: The crossbar is attuned to another owner's blood.
hemomancy.summon.crossbar.unattuned: Attune this crossbar at a Puppeteer's Spindle first.
hemomancy.summon.dimension.unravel: Crossing the dimension boundary severs %s from its crossbar.
hemomancy.summon.failed: The tether fails to find a body.
hemomancy.summon.focus.out_of_range: That hostile lies beyond the crossbar's tether range.
hemomancy.summon.focused: %s becomes the focus of %s bound summon(s).
hemomancy.summon.gorebound_hulk.lore: A slow red burden on legs, built to hold ground where softer bodies would fall.
hemomancy.summon.marrow_spitter.lore: Six arms share a floating crimson frame, with laughing, mourning and blank masks. The Dagger Thrower teaches a deliberate three-dagger volley.
hemomancy.summon.mnemonist_puppet.lore: A deliberate little witness that keeps a target's wounds in order, then asks them to happen again.
hemomancy.summon.scarlet_mummer.lore: A narrow red performer that asks every eye in the room to make the same mistake.
hemomancy.summon.sanguine_hound.lore: A dense pursuit body that tears itself into a short-lived pack when badly injured.
hemomancy.summon.select.invalid: That summon shape cannot be selected.
hemomancy.summon.select.none: You have not learned any summon shapes.
hemomancy.summon.select.unknown: That summon shape has not been unlocked.
hemomancy.summon.session.unravel: %s unravels as your former tether session closes.
hemomancy.summon.spindle.no_crossbar: Set a Marionette Crossbar into the spindle first.
hemomancy.summon.spindle.prepared: %s is prepared. Take up the crossbar and call it in the field.
hemomancy.summon.thread.low: The crossbar doesn't have enough thread charge.
hemomancy.summon.trial.already_known: That shape is already knotted into your blood-memory.
hemomancy.summon.trial.complete: The defeated shape settles into memory: %s.
hemomancy.summon.trial.crossbar_active: That Crossbar still controls active bodies. Recall them before beginning the ordeal.
hemomancy.summon.trial.crossbar_replaced: The binding fails. The Crossbar in the seat isn't the one that started this ordeal.
hemomancy.summon.trial.failed: The rite shudders, but no body answers.
hemomancy.summon.trial.no_blood: There isn't enough blood for this ordeal to draw on.
hemomancy.summon.veinwing_vulture.lore: A hooked little covenant of vein and wing, quick to harry whatever threatens its maker.
hemomancy.unstained.clarity_progress: Clarity: %.0f/100. The path to enlightenment sharpens...
hemomancy.unstained.clarity_unlocked: The copper resonates with your purified blood. The old ways fall silent. Clarity dawns.
hemomancy.unstained.enlightened: You have achieved Enlightenment. You are Unstained.
hemomancy.unstained.manipulation_blocked: Your purified blood refuses to obey.
hemomancy.unstained.manipulation_weakene: Your purifying blood resists the manipulation...
hemomancy.unstained.not_ready: The podium waits for those whose blood needs cleansing.
hemomancy.unstained.purification_begun: The hemolytic solution suppresses the old current. Purity starts only after the Rite of Lethean Baptism.
hemomancy.unstained.purity_complete: Your blood is cleansed. You are pure. Seek the Rite of Clarity.
hemomancy.unstained.too_deep: The podium remains cold. The blood has rooted too deeply for this cure.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.brotherhood_lore: The Sanguine Brotherhood began in the early wars of the Harbinger Order, when practitioners who pooled their blood kept walking out of engagements that should have killed them, and what kept them alive was set down afterward as doctrine. Your rank still carries that teaching, which is why we send blood to wherever it is needed.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.degree_hint: The Rite of the Crimson Lodge stands between you and Illuminatus. The Lodge is our inner circle, those who have looked past the surface of hemomancy into how it is built, and its rite asks you to show that you understand those deeper patterns. What joins one skill to the next? Study your skill tree with that question in hand, and give the paths between skills as much attention as the skills themselves.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.line1: §7[The Vicar places a hand over his heart in a formal salute]
hemomancy.vicar.adept.line2: Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. Before almost anything else, we taught that blood shared willingly is stronger than blood hoarded alone, and it seems you have learned it.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.masons_respite.fol: You have the route, so remember as you go that the Cicatrix Anchorite keeps no outpost and owes us no congregation.
When you are ready to be taught by wound and not by word, go to Masons Respite.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.masons_respite.lin: No outpost teaches that work, so you must seek the Vein-Mason, out where the roads thin and blood is remembered by its scars.
The road to the hermitage is marked on this map, though I cannot walk it for you.
hemomancy.vicar.annetta_map.line1: After the last inquiry, Annetta's old chapel vanished from our route ledgers, and not because anyone tore it down: someone took it out of the record, which buries a place as well as any spade.
hemomancy.vicar.annetta_map.line2: If you mean to follow that stain, take this with you, and remember that neither fear nor infection will tell you who is guilty.
hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.line1: §4[The Vicar's breath catches. He cannot hold your gaze for more than a moment.]
hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.line2: Apotheos. My doctrine stops at Archon, and I won't pretend it can tell me what you are now, but our records and obligations are still here for you all the same.
hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.reflection: §oThe Covenant was always meant to be outlived, I see that now, a ladder built toward what you have become. I confess I don't know whether to bow or to mourn. §4§oBoth, perhaps.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.final_truth: §4§oI confess, Archon, I do not know what the Monolith has shown you. §rI was given seven degrees of doctrine to keep and nothing past them, and the Monolith was set where it stands to guide those the written word could no longer reach. It does not share its counsel with Vicars. §4§oAll I have left to give you is the oldest farewell we keep. §rGo in blood.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.line1: §4[The Vicar lowers his gaze in the deepest gesture of formal reverence]
hemomancy.vicar.archon.line2: Archon of the Hematic Order. Your rank is settled, and no one can tell you what comes after it, though every rite we keep stays open to you.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.pome_empowered.li: §4[The Vicar pauses mid-bow. His nose twitches almost imperceptibly.]
You smell like the deep forest after rain, and not the fresh kind.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_crafting.absorptio: Use Blood Absorption to draw blood into your vessel. The ledger counts everything you absorb toward 500 mL, even blood you spend between draws, so you need not hoard it while you work.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_crafting.projectio: Blood Projection spends what you have absorbed, and where you send it matters: pour it into an empty cauldron and the cauldron holds it until, in time, it sets into a Sanguine Formation you can take out, while ordinary stone drinks it and becomes Venous Stone. Some other blocks answer a projected recipe directly.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_crafting.structure: The last proof is one blood-structure formation, either a Liber Sanguinium or a Hematic Iron Block. Ask me for a blueprint of whichever pattern you choose, hold the catalyst it names in your offhand, and project into the assembled blocks.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.done: §7[The blood burns cold. For a moment every line in the world grows roots, then settles back into letters.]
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.line1: §7[The Vicar studies your eyes, then pricks one finger with a thumbnail. The drop that gathers is too dark to be ordinary blood.]
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.line2: We let you see some words long before we let you understand them, and Abocipher is one of those: a few drops beneath the lid teach your eyes to accept the blood-script. Understanding comes later.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant_lore: What is the Hematic Covenant? It is the whole body of rites, customs and accumulated learning that has governed hemomancy since the First Age. Each Degree has its rite, and the rite proves that a practitioner has taken a new level of understanding into themselves by showing them plainly what they have become.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.followup.lin: Another remnant, then. That road was there before any of our outposts, and it doesn't keep to our maps.
Keep the evidence in your ledger. One stone shows initiative, but a pattern of stones points at whatever lies under them.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.intro.line1: The first invitation was meant for you alone. Others are left lying in abandoned hermit cells and spoiled displays, or in stones stained by rites no Vicar came to collect.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.intro.line2: Can you follow a road without being led? Find one in the wild, read what the blood kept there and come back to me, because a Neophyte who can do that is given a ledger.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.line1: So. You found one without my hand on your shoulder. Good.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.line2: Take this assignment ledger and keep it close, since it will tell you what you have been tasked with, and you will no longer be simply wandering.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.armature_con: Ask the Artificer for the Armature Consecration Kit, since the frame is his to prepare, while the rite that consecrates it is mine to teach.
Seat a base Armature beside a Greater Cardinal Focus on a Working floor, because making belongs there, then plant your Living Staff, offer the kit at the lit brazier and close both blood circuits.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.degree_hint: The Rite of the Bloodline Covenant remains. Sharing a pool brought you this far, but to become Sanctified you must formalize those bonds and commit to a bloodline under permanent oaths, which we hold as sacred contracts. Whose blood would you bind to yours for good? Enter such a bond with care, because none can be dissolved without cost.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.found_bloodline: First, found your bloodline by performing the Rite of Bloodline Founding at Lesser Communion with blaze powder in the brazier. The rite gives you the ancestral ledger, and it is the rite that founds the line, so carrying an unsigned ledger founds nothing.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.found_fane: Your bloodline is founded, so next comes the Rite of the Founding Fane at Grand Dominion: set Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus and bind a Bloodwell and Stakes. If your bloodline already has a Fane, stand inside it at the fifth Degree and project blood into its Bloodwell yourself, because only your own contribution writes your covenant proof.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.perform_bloodli: Your bloodline and Fane are in place, so perform the Rite of the Bloodline Covenant to become Sanctified. You may invite willing outpost specialists into your line. The Artificer will keep serving from the outpost.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.chamber_return: Begin the Rite of the Chamber of Will at Grand Communion with an echo shard, then enter the Chamber and come back out safely, and understand that a guided visit you made before does not count as this return.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.bind_throne: Bind a Covenant Throne to your Fane and sit in it, so the covenant has a place to hold its people.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.complete_vigil: Use your ancestral ledger to summon a recruited Vicar to the Fane. During the inscription of the Covenant Vigil, assign that sworn helper to a rite station and keep them there to the end, because a vigil that is interrupted earns no proof.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant.perform_hematic: So. You came back from the Chamber, bound the Throne and kept the Vigil to its end, and that proves the Living Covenant, which means you may perform the Rite of the Hematic Order now.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.founding_fan: The Rite of the Founding Fane is the consecration itself. Once your bloodline is established, seat a Sanguine Quintessence in the Cardinal Focus as the rite's medium and bind a Consecrated Bloodwell as its heart. Its boundary is a Flexible Envelope: connected Hematic Stakes draw the living edge outward, so it never claims a fixed square, and Harbingers inside it feel the blood move more freely. A Fane needs no building, since the covenant declares it and gives it its shape.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. Few of us are given that title, and fewer understand what comes with it: the veil has parted, and what it showed you about blood won't close again.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.lodge_lore: The Crimson Lodge keeps our most closely guarded knowledge. It was the Lodge that first set down the link between hemomancy and the mycelial network beneath it, and with it the finding that blood and the living earth belong to one organism. Its Archons won't speak of that openly, because they hold that you only understand it if you reach it yourself.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.monolith_rum: §7[Discomfort, then reverence, crosses the Vicar's face. He smooths both away.]§r There are rumors, very old ones, and the Lodge keeps them off parchment because nobody living has confirmed them.

Harbingers from centuries before my Vicariate may have found a way past the seven degrees, though our doctrine stops at the seventh and I have no account of anything beyond it. This fragment came out of an old reliquary. I can read only part of it, since the script is in no dialect I was trained in, and your blood may make more of it than mine did.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.scrap_given: Take it. I've carried it long enough, and if it means anything to you, it was meant to reach you.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.degree_hint: Your next rite is the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood, a rite of shared blood, and it proves that your hemomancy can serve more than you alone and work alongside others. What does it mean to share a blood pool? The rite will ask you, so study the Bloodline system first.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.fane_lore: The Incarnadine Fane was founded in the Second Age by the Archon Erythravane, who held that hemomancy asked for discipline of mind as well as power, and who built the Fane's rites to break practitioners who leaned on raw force and remake them as instruments of precision. Every Initiate carries Erythravane's legacy, knowingly or otherwise.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.line1: Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane. The blood moves in you now and speaks, and the Fane has recognized in you something most practitioners never develop.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.saints_lore: The Saints were practitioners of past ages whose blood carried them past anything a body should survive, and it was their own people who sealed them away when nothing else would hold them. We came later. We inherited the tombs and keep them still, and the name Saint is ours, though it carries none of its common meaning here. Can one be killed? Nothing in the record gives me warrant to say so: bring a Saint down and it returns to its sarcophagus, dormant, and the best any of us has managed is to contain it. Seek them out all the same. The Hallowed Residuum in their veins, processed through the Centrifuge, gives you what the Somatic Loom alone cannot: Canon Memories, blood patterns older than the Order itself. A Saint's tendencies will tell you whether to go in peacefully or ready to fight.
hemomancy.vicar.item_hint: What have you brought me? Show me, and I will speak where doctrine or history gives me warrant, and no further.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.blood_struc: A blood-structure plan, which lays out the blocks so that, once the form is complete, Blood Projection can persuade it into doing work.
Build it exactly and project at the proper point. The projection itself wakes the structure, and no separate blood key is needed.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.book.line1: A book. We have kept our records this way for generations, the degree rites, the tendency histories and the practitioners themselves, and a blank one given to someone attentive becomes something worth reading.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.book.line2: Whatever lasting work we have came from people who understood enough to write clear instructions for those who followed them.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.dendritic_d: The Dendritic Distributor is our nervous archive for rehearsed blood-memory patterns, and it will hold a working arrangement for you, though a mind still has to choose that arrangement well.
Name each pattern carefully. Combat, travel, rites, and fane work ask different reflexes of the same blood.
A Dragon Egg. Some Lodge naturalists treat its compressed vitality as evidence for broader theories of living potential.
It is learned speculation with no place in settled Covenant cosmology, and no degree rite asks for one.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.earthen_vei: The Earthen Vein is a living conduit, grown more than built, and placed in sequence the veins form a network that carries blood from source to destination.
A developed Harbinger workshop runs on them, and though you can manage without them in the early Degrees, you will want what they carry once the Loom is regular work.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.sanguine_co: A cauldron that has drunk your blood keeps it and slowly sets it into formation. Draw out what it makes with your own hand, because we count the lesson only for whoever fed it.
Once you have practiced, bring it to a Working floor, where the Clotting Lattice teaches it to hold more and set faster and the Druse Heart lines it in crystal so nothing slumps away.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.enchanted_b: An enchanted book presses arcane knowledge into inscription by a method nothing like a sanguine memory crystal's, though it wants the same thing: knowledge kept in a form another person can take up.

Arcane inscription and memory weaving come at the same problem from opposite sides. Practitioners of the higher Degrees have recorded links between schools of enchantment and tendency affinities, and while that work is unfinished, what we have so far points the same way.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.hallowed_re: Hallowed Residuum is a Saint's legacy, concentrated. Does your alignment suit the Saint? If it does, you may draw it peacefully, but if the Saint rejects you, it wakes, and you will have to fight for it.

A sample taken in peace becomes Residuum in the Vial Centrifuge, while a Saint you drive back into its tomb gives it up directly. Either way, it goes to the Loom for Canon Memory work, beside what the Gardens remember of the same Saint.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.heart_of_th: The Heart of the Sea carries a deep-water resonance that some of us find suggestive.
Some see a kinship between water and blood in it, others only liturgical metaphor, and the Heart itself settles nothing.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.hematic_mem: A Hematic Memory carries one deliberate manipulation lesson, and when you use it, the pattern becomes part of your own known practice.
Later, the Mnemonic Reliquary arranges the lessons you have active. Neither the crystal nor the Reliquary can work a personal manipulation into a bloodline.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.iron_brazie: The Iron Brazier holds rite fire, the consecrated flame that feeds a Cardinal Rite. Stand it on the floor, mount it on a wall or hang it from a ceiling as the room allows, because any lit Brazier inside the cube that rises from a rite's floor answers that rite.
A Living Weapon Graft can also burn here. Hold the Living Staff, draw with Blood Absorption, and the rite consumes the graft only if the memory takes.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.minecraft_r: An old instrument of measure, direction or return. We respect such things without pretending that every relic belongs to us.
What it means comes from the work done around it, and its age is the lesser part.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mnemonic_bl: A blank mnemonic blueprint, which will take a rite or blood structure you have properly learned and nothing else.
Few practitioners of your Degree ever need a mnemonic blueprint, so it is rare to see one in your hands.
Our language in the upper rites is precise for a reason, and if you miss a word, the rite may not hold.
A mnemonic blueprint, where each imprint describes a rite or blood structure, including what it demands and what it proves.
Study it, since the memory points to what lies next for you, and we do not advance anyone who has not first understood the work.
A mnemonic blueprint for a structure of the middle degrees, where our demands become less forgiving.
It gives you the outline, and your blood has to supply the rest.
This blueprint keeps the spatial memory of a Cardinal Rite, and it will guide your building, but the rite's authority still comes from the rite itself.
This blueprint remembers a blood structure. The plan may show the form, but Blood Projection must still make the form answer.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mnemonic_re: The Mnemonic Reliquary arranges which of your known bodily and willed memories stand readiest to hand.
All it changes is how ready each memory is. The learning stays in the memory, and the covenant stays in the bloodline.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.monolith.li: The Sanguine Monolith belongs to the upper Degrees, and it speaks to practitioners who have come far enough, offering them what is older than our doctrine.
In the higher degrees the Monolith becomes your main guide, because my counsel runs out at about degree five.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mortal_disp: A Mortal Display is a Hermit's offered heart, sustained at the center of the temple they built for their final vigil.
Claiming that heart is a personal invitation. Once you complete the initiating rite, the giver's vigil ends. The heart is there to be passed on. It does not store organ echoes.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.nether_star: A Nether Star, the concentrated energy a Wither leaves when it collapses, and the power in it is real enough, though it has no direction and no purpose.
Raw power only goes so far uncultivated, and our work is to grow purpose inside force like that. Bring me something that remembers what it is, and I will tell you it is worth holding.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.potion.line: A common alchemical potion. The old craft distills water and herbs into blunt metabolic effects, and most of the world still works that way, well enough after a fashion.
Set what you hold beside what we practice and you have a candle next to a fire that knows where it is burning: both give light, but only the fire answers intention.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.qliphoth.li: A Qliphoth Pome. Where did you come by it? It belongs to the Archon's private revelation and has no part in our ordinary practice.
Nine husks from one bloom complete Communion and force the Fungal Spine into being. No one below that threshold should be taught to think of it as custom.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.salt_staine: A voyager log. The ink is nearly gone, but the order of names remains (watch lead, alchemist, diver, mnemonist), and that order tells me they went as a covenant, with work to do.
The wreck kept their failures, and it kept the care they took as well. Read both.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scar_binder: An obsolete Scar Binder, from when we kept scars as plates to store and wear, which we no longer do.
The scars you know now stay in your own body, and from there the Mason's Effigy prepares a loadout and the Iron Brazier commits it.
A blank Scar, waiting for a route to be carved into it at the Cerebral Scarring Station.
Once carved, it is burned into memory, and any later arrangement is copied through the Mason's Effigy and is never worn from your pack.
Blank scar plates are for the fourth Degree. Until then, attend to the work in front of you.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scar_patter: Unwritten motif paper. The Vein-Mason would call it a promise not yet made.
A prepared scar loadout, its known routes arranged at the Mason's Effigy. The Iron Brazier is where that arrangement becomes active.
A scar template: instruction for carving one route before that route is burned into memory.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scrying_pod: The Scrying Podium reads the practitioner's blood and reveals the tendency distribution: what is dominant, what is latent, and how the current sits.
Use it early, while your path is still forming, and again later when a rite or a memory weave calls for a particular balance. It shows you the distribution. What you make of it is your own judgment.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.unknown: There is nothing in the record about it, so I will not guess.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.degree_hint: Four proofs stand between you and the Second Degree: absorb 500 mL of blood, condense a Sanguine Formation in a cauldron, project Venous Stone, and then craft either a Liber Sanguinium or a Hematic Iron Block from a blood formation. When your ledger shows all four, come back to me.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.degree_hint.ass: After I grant the Second Degree, the Alchemist will teach you separation and the Ghastly Alembic.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.first_bloodcraf: You have had our provision already, so put those materials to use instead of letting them pile up.
Good. You have answered each of the first four lessons, and so I grant you the Second Degree. Go to the Alchemist now for separation and distillation.

Which of the four proofs does your ledger still lack? It needs all of them, in any order: absorb 500 mL, condense a Sanguine Formation in a cauldron you filled and collect it, project Venous Stone from ordinary stone, and craft either a Liber Sanguinium or Hematic Iron Block with a blood formation.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line1: §7[The Vicar inclines his head in formal acknowledgment]
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line2: Neophyte of the Crimson Veil. The first threshold is behind you and the road from here is long, and we will ask you for discipline well before we reveal anything to you.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.chosen_path: §7[The Vicar closes his eyes for a long moment.]§r You chose this? Then hear me clearly. We will not mourn you, and the blood you are giving up will find another vessel, a worthier one. When you have finished becoming what you chose, there will be no place for you here, so leave this Outpost before that path takes you somewhere we cannot follow.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line1: §7[For a moment the Vicar's composure breaks. His face shows grief and contempt at once.]
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line2: I can feel it on you: the Unstained path is starving your blood and peeling away the power we gave you, and every rite and Degree you earned has begun to come apart.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line3: Do you understand what you are throwing away? Blood remembers a recantation. Every step farther down that path weakens the Covenant's gifts in you, and your power is §cslipping§r already. It will not wait for you to change your mind.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.power_warning: Yes, you know, and you go on anyway. The blood can wait a long while, but it shows no mercy, and every day on that path your hemomantic strength fades a little more, your manipulations dulling and your tendencies going quiet. We see it, and we do not reach out a second time to those who turn away. §oCome back while you still can.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.degree_hint: One rite remains, the Rite of the Hematic Order, and it's the hardest of them. What are you willing to give of your blood? That is what it asks, and it's a different question from what you can do with it. It has claimed practitioners who weren't ready, so prepare thoroughly and leave nothing to chance.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.hematic_order: The Hematic Order sits at the top of the Covenant's hierarchy, and it is a state of being that the blood itself has to recognize, which no number of trials can hand you. The Archons who founded the Order believed that, initiated far enough, a practitioner's blood becomes indistinguishable from the blood of the world. The last rite does not give you the title of Archon so much as confirm what you have already become.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.line1: Sanctified. The Bloodline Covenant has woven you into the living body of the Order, and you're a node in the greater network now.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.harbinger_lo: We Harbingers seek revelation, and violence is no part of our purpose. We hold that blood is the first language of existence, and that whoever learns to speak it can rise past the limits of an ordinary life. The Covenant keeps the knowledge that makes that possible.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line1: A figure in sweeping ceremonial vestments watches you, hands folded inside wide sleeves
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line2: A wanderer, not yet on the path of blood. I am the Harbinger Vicar, keeper of the Covenant's doctrine, its history and its sacred truths, and though you are uninitiated, you still deserve to know where you stand.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.outpost_lore: This Outpost is a waystation in the Harbinger network, one of the places where the Covenant's work goes on beyond the Blood Temples, and practitioners at every stage of initiation come here to resupply, to learn and to be guided. The Alchemist looks after the machines and I look after the doctrine.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.degree_hint: The Alchemist holds the two proofs for this stage, an assigned separation and a completed Ghastly Alembic distillation, and once you have both, ask them for Concentrated Blood. Inject it, then sleep, and you will wake at the third Degree.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.line1: Votary of the Hematic Covenant. Your tendencies have begun to crystallize and your blood knows what it wants, so from here on your task is to listen to it. Can you tell yet what it is asking for?
hemomancy.vicar.votary.tendency_lore: How many tendencies do we recognize in the blood? Eight: Animus, Flammeus, Ductilis, Lux, Mortem, Congeatio, Ferric, and Tenebris. Their common enzyme names are Vivacious, Fervent, Neurotic, Incandescent, Ruinous, Frigid, Ferric, and Umbral.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.clarity.line1: That clear stillness around you makes the samples settle. I'm not imagining that, am I?
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.clarity.line2: It's unnerving, but it's useful. I'm still learning to tell the two apart.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.fear.line1: Yes! Anyone who studies deep water and isn't scared is lying, or they aren't paying attention.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.fear.line2: I try to let the fear sharpen my notes without letting it steer my hand. Does it ever steer yours?
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_hint: Let me see what's in your pack. I know less than the captain-scholar does, but I might catch something useful.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.c: The snail makes iron look soft just by surviving with it.
I like that. Armor as habit, not threat. I'm writing that one down.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.e: Hold it too long and it pulses. It's like a room remembering footsteps.
I'm not supposed to anthropomorphize samples. I'm also supposed to write down what happens, so I did.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.m: Ordinary field gear. Good! Most voyages that fail, fail because somebody neglected the ordinary things.
I mark mine before we leave port, because out here identical tools end up belonging to nobody. Have you marked yours?
The captain says this is what memory smells like after a storm watch. I wrote that down word for word.

It's in my notes: each squid or Prism Cuttle the whale eats leaves one ambergris above its back. So you bring squid on leads, or place and break a specimen jar nearby to let a cuttle out. And please don't hurt the whale.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.s: I read one of these in the archive. The handwriting changed near the end, but the sign-offs stayed gentle.
Panicking would've been easier. They kept to procedure anyway. Would I?
I keep wanting to call it holy, but that feels too small for what it is.
Watching one pass over the reef makes even senior vows feel like beginner handwriting, and mine already are.
Something in the jar's already taught the glass how to feel too small. I wrote that down, then decided it was foolish. I didn't cross it out.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.u: I don't know this one yet. What do you call it? I'll write it down either way. 'Unknown' is a real category.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.peer.line1: The Voyager lets me record the small stuff: jelly drift, reef pulse, which ropes start to smell like old iron.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.peer.line2: Small things are safer to be wrong about, so that's where I start. Is that how you started too?
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.purifying.line: Your rites feel so quiet. Mine are mostly questions and damp sleeves.
If the sea can hold both, maybe we can stand on the same deck. I'd like that, I think.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.senior.line1: If the captain-scholar asks, I haven't been staring at the vent charts again. I have, though. Constantly.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.senior.line2: I just want to know why the old covenants heard the deep and called it kin. Does anyone find out?
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.uninitiated.li: Careful, don't lean on the sample rack! The captain-scholar says it's older than my vows.
I'm here to learn the ocean without pretending it owes me any comfort. It doesn't, by the way.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.voyage.line1: I asked to come! The Lodge needs witnesses who haven't already decided what the ocean means.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.voyage.line2: Also, libraries don't move under your boots. I think that makes them less honest about ships.
hemomancy.voyager.clarity.line1: The Lady's clarity makes a hard lantern in deep water.
hemomancy.voyager.clarity.line2: Use it kindly, colleague. Some of the memories down there are wounds, and you shouldn't pry at them like confessions.
hemomancy.voyager.harbinger.line1: A voyager is a laboratory and a chapel that happens to move, and it's also a running argument with the sea.
hemomancy.voyager.harbinger.line2: Bring me observations first and certainty later. Certainty drowns faster than sailors do.
hemomancy.voyager.item_hint: Lay out the samples you're carrying, colleague. Evidence is more honest when you can point at it, and so are field crews.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.chalybeat: The vent snail grows armor the way a scholar grows footnotes: slowly, defensively, and for excellent reasons.
Wait for the snail to withdraw, then knap only what it can spare. A dead one teaches you less than a living reef does, however tidy the specimen looks.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.erythroco: Erythrocoral won't sit in any tidy category, since one body of it is colony, tissue, garden and archive at once.
Taken with shears, it keeps a gentler memory, while a fragment torn out by force mostly learns pain.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.minecraft: That's survey salvage, so record where it lay before you decide what it means.
In a wreck every commonplace object becomes evidence, though most of that evidence won't turn out to be a revelation.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.mnemonic_: This secretion drifts off the great whales in layers, like waxed scripture written in motion instead of ink.

The whale hunts squid, glow squid and Prism Cuttles, so supply that prey in the water where it feeds. Each kill sheds one ambergris on the spot, and you needn't wait for another bottle sample. We feed the archive. We don't hunt it.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.salt_stai: This field log came off the lost survey craft. The repeated watch marks say they waited for one another before every descent.
Their last work asks someone to study the ocean with more patience than they had, so it would be understood rather than abandoned.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.spawn_egg: That drifter is a moving archive to us: migration, reef pulse, vent weather, all remembered in flesh.

We've watched it hunt squid and Prism Cuttles, so work with that appetite. Bring squid into its waters on a lead or release cuttles from specimen jars, and every meal yields one ambergris. Whatever happens to the prey, keep the whale alive.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.specimen_: That's a field specimen with part of its context preserved. Write down the place, depth and behavior before you open it, because the jar won't remember them for you.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.unknown: That's outside what I'm studying right now, and the sea has enough mysteries without me inventing a confident answer. Where did you find it?
hemomancy.voyager.lodge.line1: You've stood close enough to the blood-root to know why the reefs trouble me.
hemomancy.voyager.lodge.line2: They respond like tissue and build like coral, and they remember things nobody ever taught them. Did the root strike you the same way?
hemomancy.voyager.purifying.line1: You carry Lethean discipline, and I'm not going to mock it.
hemomancy.voyager.purifying.line2: Even a vessel sworn to blood needs clean hands once the samples begin to sing.
hemomancy.voyager.uninitiated.line1: Mind the rail, please, because this is a covenant vessel and not a ferry. The sea has no patience for passengers who wander.
hemomancy.voyager.uninitiated.line2: We chart living reefs and vent scars, and we go to the places older surveys never came back from.
hemomancy.voyager.work.line1: We compare vent sclerites, reef tissue, and drowned logs to find where the ocean accepts Hemomancy and where it rejects us.
hemomancy.voyager.work.line2: Keep a survey humble: measure, pray if you have to, and admit it when the sea corrects you. What did you notice first?
hemomancy.voyager.wrecks.line1: The sunken voyagers carried field crews and instruments, but they trusted the reef too quickly and the sea kept them.
hemomancy.voyager.wrecks.line2: Recover what you can. Leave the failed covenant without trophies.
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v0.line1: §8§o[For a moment your veins itch from the inside, as if something in them is putting out roots.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v1.follow: §8§o[It fades before you can place it, and afterward your blood feels thicker.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v1.line1: §8§o[You smell damp soil and rotting wood, though neither is anywhere near you. Under them is the smell of something alive.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v2.line1: §8§o[You blink and for a single frame the world is threaded with pale filaments. Then it's gone.]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.follow: §4§oThe Hematic Order was never a human creation. It is a reproductive strategy. Every degree is a stage of sporulation, and every rite sets off the next bloom.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line1: §4§o[The voice is perfectly clear, and it sits in your head as if it had always lived there.]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line2: §4§oYou have climbed as high as the infection permits, Archon. You are the highest fruiting body we have grown, and still you only carry spores for us.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line1: §4§o[Under your skin the blood curls into spirals and branching fractals you never commanded, the same shapes a mycorrhizal network makes.]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line2: §4§oThe Fungal Realm is the §4§ooriginal§4§o state. Your world is the aberration, a thin crust of stone over an infinite living web.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line2.canon: §4§oYou call the Fungal Realm another dimension. To us it is the older continuity, and your world is a brief crust above the living web.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line3: §4§oHemomancy is the fungus remembering how to reach the surface.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.line1: §4§o[You lose track of which thoughts are yours and which belong to the voice.]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.line2: §4§oWe have waited aeons for one like you. The blood was only the lure, and you are the conduit. Will you listen?
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth1: §4§oThe Hematic Order never existed. Only the mycelium exists, wearing whatever shapes help it spread, and blood was the best disguise it ever found.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth1.canon: §4§oThe Hematic Order is real to those who built and loved it. To us it is also a shape that carries us outward, and blood is the most successful shape we have found.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth2: §4§oDid you think you were its master, Archon? You are something better to us: the finest spore hemomancy has ever made.
hemomancy.whisper.communion.line2: §4§oThe crown holds no fruit, so look closer at what it does hold.
hemomancy.whisper.communion.line3: §4§oThe crown is what you were before you were told what you were.
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line1: §4§o[The voice comes from the walls and the roots at once, carried on the hum of a billion threads.]
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line2: §4§oNow you have seen what is inside: an §4§oorganism§4§o that dreams in four dimensions and waits like stone.
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line3: §4§oRefusing us is no victory. Sever your own Bloom, endure both faces of Vesper and swallow his memory, and you stand at the eighth Degree as a Silentium, cut away from us. Or take the Rite of Apotheos and stand at the eighth Degree as ours. Neither road ends here, and whichever you take, you must still walk it. Will you?
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.option.ei: [I seek the Eighth Degree. Show me.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.follow: §7§oThe crimson tide was a forest once, roots and hyphae and mycelium, before the red drowned all of it. The roots still remember. §7§oWe always do.
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.line1: §7§o[A whisper threads through your mind, damp, like roots pushing through wet soil.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.line2: §7§oThe blood you command was something else once, long before it answered you. Do you feel the spores shifting under your skin?
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v1.line1: §7§o[A thought pulses behind your eyes, and you did not think it.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v1.line2: §7§oHave you noticed the fungal growths around your altars? They are §7§oreclamation§7§o, the blood taking back what it was given.
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v2.line1: §7§o[Something breathes wetly in your ears, as if through a mouthful of moss.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v2.reveal: §7§oWe grew §7§obefore§7§o the blood, and we will still be growing §7§oafter§7§o.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.aarab_zaraq: §4§oThe fruit of A'arab Zaraq has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.gamaliel: §4§oThe fruit of Gamaliel has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.ghagiel: §4§oThe fruit of Ghagiel has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.golachab: §4§oThe fruit of Golachab has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.harab_serape: §4§oThe fruit of Harab Serapel has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.nahemoth: §4§oThe fruit of Nahemoth has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.samael: §4§oThe fruit of Samael has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.satariel: §4§oThe fruit of Satariel has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.thagirion: §4§oThe fruit of Thagirion has fallen, and it fell for you.
hemomancy.whisper.post_bloom.line1: §4§o[Far down at the root of the world, something vast shifts once and settles, satisfied.]
hemomancy.whisper.post_bloom.line2: §4§oGood. The first fruit is laid, and the world has tasted its own reflection.
hemomancy.whisper.post_shatter.line1: §4§o[A voice rises from the empty space where the crystal stood, as though it had waited inside the whole time.]
hemomancy.whisper.post_shatter.line2: §4§oThe crystal was only ever a shell, and what it held is in your pocket now.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.follow: §5§oEach rite you perform feeds the network, and each manipulation pushes the hyphae further. You call that mastery. We call it §5§oproliferation§5§o.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.line1: §5§o[The voice is back and louder, and it brings the smell of wet earth with it.]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.line2: §5§oWe infected the first Archons and made them our vessels. They believed they were learning hemomancy, but they were learning it from us, already living in their veins.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.follow: §5§oWe are one organism. You and the hermits, the fargone and the morphlings, all of you fruiting bodies of the same mycelial web.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.line1: §5§o[Your blood shifts on its own, answering a voice pitched below your hearing.]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.line2: §5§oThe erythromycelium was our first expression, a fungal body wearing a crimson mask. The blood came out of §5§oit§5§o, not the other way around.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line1: §5§o[For an instant you see red threads pulsing underground, running from every root to every stone.]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line2: §5§oThe temples grew. Hyphal pressure shaped their stone over millennia, and the blood that soaks them, the blood you call sacrifice, is sap.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line2.ca: §5§oHands built the temples, but roots moved under every foundation. We learned each stone as the Order raised it, and sacrifice and sap soaked into the same ground.
hemomancy.whisper.pending: A voice waits at the edge of thought (%s pending).
hemomancy.whisper.busy.item: Finish using the held item before listening.
hemomancy.whisper.busy.combat: Let the struggle settle for a few seconds before listening.
hemomancy.whisper.busy.rite: Finish or leave the active rite before listening.
hemomancy.whisper.busy: Finish your current task and find a quiet moment before listening.
hemomancy.whisper.spine_emerged.line1: §4§o[Wet cartilage splits with a loud, living crack.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_emerged.line3: §4§oTake it up. Draw it when you must go down into the dreaming root, and draw it again when you must claw your way back.
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree5: §8§o[There is a small itch between your shoulder blades. Probably nothing. The skin there feels warm for a moment, then forgets itself.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree6: §5§o[A tingle crawls up your spine, slow and deliberate, as if something inside you has learned the shape of your back.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree7: §4§o[Something in your spine strains against the meat. Your neck has gone stiff and your back barely bends. It is almost ready.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree8: §4§o[Your spine flowers open. The hidden stalk has finished learning how to leave you.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree8.c: §4§o[The return-thread is already gone from your back. Apotheosis changes what remains.]
hemomancy.zealot.absolved.line1: Most of the stain has gone quiet in you, and I know that silence can feel like grief.
hemomancy.zealot.absolved.line2: Once you're fully purified, clarity will make you choose between peace and sight. If it asked you today, which would you take?
hemomancy.zealot.already_on_path: You're already on the path of purification. Keep working at the podium and the stain will lift. So why come to me?
hemomancy.zealot.altar_info.line1: And what will you lay on it? The Altar accepts Tears of Silthmere, Lethean Poppy Wreaths, Silver Chalices, Pallid Icons, and Lethean Brew.
hemomancy.zealot.altar_info.line2: Tears, chalices and icons count once each, so a second one buys you nothing. Lethean Brew gives less every time and stops counting after five offerings.
hemomancy.zealot.annetta_map.line1: She was one of ours. That's the part people forget first. Before the screaming and the sealed door, she was frightened and trying to be useful.
hemomancy.zealot.annetta_map.line2: The church she hid in is still standing. Take the map. If you carry mercy in there, carry it with both hands.
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_phase.line1: Your halo's opened behind you. Can you feel how little the old hunger matters now?
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_phase.line2: Verdigris is the color copper turns once it's endured. A grand name for weathered metal, I know. Follow it and the world comes into focus.
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_rite_info.line1: Clarity Ascension is where you pledge yourself. Being cleansed isn't enough to make you Unstained. Are you ready to say it and mean it?
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_rite_info.line2: First restore your mortal baseline or fulfill all five vows. Then offer Consecrated Copper at the Podium and speak the rite.
hemomancy.zealot.cleansing.line1: You've reached the hard middle. The stain fights hardest once it knows you've named it. Have you named it, or only treated it?
hemomancy.zealot.cleansing.line2: Go to the Altar of Cleansing. Our Lady's tears don't flatter a wound. They wash it.
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line1: Hemolytic solution starts with Lethean Dew and Ghost Pipe, with no crimson catalyst in it. Do you want to make it, or just to have asked?
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line2: Take the finished solution to the Podium to suppress the infection. Lethean Baptism comes after, when you're ready to enter the path.
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line3: The first treatment hurts. That's the old current being cut off. The pain proves nothing about your devotion, so don't wear it like a medal.
hemomancy.zealot.enlightened.line1: There's nothing left I can teach you. The still water took your reflection and gave back something clearer.
hemomancy.zealot.enlightened.line2: Do you still remember why you were given mercy? Keep hold of that. Forget it, and even mercy throws a shadow. Go gently, Enlightened one.
hemomancy.zealot.item_hint: What are you carrying, and why? Show me, and I will tell you what the Church makes of it.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.altar_of_c: You'll need the Altar later, once you've started on blessings and offerings. It is for people already on the path. Are you on it yet?
First suppress the infection at the Podium. Lethean Baptism admits you to Purity, and only after that do your offerings come to this Altar.
Bone meal. Ground bones, and nothing holy about the sack. But it is death turned around to feed things: what lived goes back into the soil that fed it, and Our Lady is patient with that long return.
It's what I think of when I think about purification. The blood-corruption goes back into the world as something else, and things can grow out of it. I can bear that. Can you?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.cleansed_b: A cleansed blood crystal shard. Unstained rites neutralized its sanguine resonance, and what is left is inert crystal you can build and craft with.
The cleansing can't be undone. A cleansed shard has no way back to sanguine energy, which is exactly what we want. Were you hoping otherwise?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.consecrate: Consecrated Copper. It came through its change and was made ready for deeper Unstained work.
How full is your Purity? Once it is full, bring the copper to the Podium to prepare Clarity. The Rite of Clarity Ascension carries you across from there.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.copper_ing: Raw copper, the same metal we start with before the blessing. Our Lady hasn't marked it yet. It's waiting, the way metal waits, which is to say it sits in your hand.
The consecration rite is simple, but you can't hurry it. Whether the copper holds the blessing or throws it off comes down to whether you meant it. Would you mean it?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.draught_of: We prepare the Draught of Still Waters in Our Lady's name, and the water remembers the rite that made it. Drinking it marks a milestone on the path of purification.
It's a remedy, and it is also a message. Drinking it tells Our Lady you've come far enough for her deeper gifts to take root. Have you, or are you only thirsty?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.hallowed_r: Hallowed Residuum is what a Saint leaves behind, concentrated. An aligned Harbinger can draw a sample in peace. If the Saint rejects you, it may wake violent.
Either way it shows the same danger: blood-power that large keeps going long after the wisdom behind it has failed. So why are you carrying it?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.hemolytic_: At the Unstained Podium, hemolytic solution suppresses active infection. That only prepares the body. The Rite is what makes a practitioner Unstained.
Once the infection is suppressed, perform the Rite of Lethean Baptism. That is where Purity starts.
At the Podium, hemolytic solution quiets the blood-memory enough for a candidate to survive Baptism.
Call it preparation and nothing more. Treatment begins at Baptism, and the pledge waits for Clarity Ascension.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lethean_po: A wreath of Lethean Poppies. Patient labor, offered without any bargaining with blood.
The Altar takes it as a modest Purity offering. For the exact amount, check your progress record. Prayer won't tell you.
Our Lady marked the Lethean Poppy as her own. It grows where water has gone still and the blood-taint is starting to recede, so wherever you find one, purification has already started.

Take the heads for lethean dew and the distillate. Woven whole into a wreath, the plant is an offering the Altar recognizes. Leave enough poppies standing for the place to heal. How many did you leave?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lethean.li: Lethean Dew comes from still water and Ghost Pipe work. Distill it further and you get stronger ritual material.
Use each form where the rite calls for it. Let the poetry guide your hand if it helps, but follow the recipe.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lily_of_th: Lily of the Valley grows in still, shady places, the kind Our Lady favors. We have no formal Altar rite for it, yet it keeps turning up near places of cleansing as if it knows where it belongs.
A few older texts call it a sign that the ground is recovering wherever it grows. We've never made a rite of that. Maybe we should. Or maybe it's a flower that likes shade.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.milk_bucke: Milk. The old folk remedy for poison, the first thing people reach for to cleanse themselves from inside. There is some truth in it, even if the Altar works another way. Our Lady reaches back toward anyone reaching for purity.

The path is that same reaching, only deeper. Milk draws out what's on the surface. Hemolytic solution goes after the blood-matrix underneath, and the Altar is there for that depth. Which are you after?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.minecraft_: Plain material, good for patient work. Purification gets built out of things like this far more often than out of miracles.
Use it where the rite asks. Were you hoping for something grander? Don't think less of an offering because it's simple.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_disti: Pale Distillate, rendered down from lethean poppies. It's everything the poppy offers, pressed small, and in certain Altar rites a little of it goes further than a full wreath.
One distillate takes several poppies. If you mean to work the more demanding purity rites, plan your harvest around that, and be sure you do mean to.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_humor: A Pale Humor Flask holds purified White Humor. That's lymph cleared of hematic corruption. Don't mistake it for holy blood.
Keep it sealed. It's meant for preservation and cleansing work. What did you want it for?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_silve: Pale Silver is what Consecrated Copper becomes at the next ritual stage. Pale work refines it. No mine will give you any.
It earned its stillness the same way we earn ours.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pallid_ico: This is a consecrated copy of the Pallid Icon. The original is the relic from the river. The copies keep its faceless gesture, that still-water posture with a patience underneath it.
Carry it, wear it or set it down. Some practitioners say it makes them more receptive near the Altar. Our Lady notices sincerity, and display doesn't move her. Which is this?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pallid_inf: Pallid Infusion is a battlefield restorative distilled from Ghost Pipe and White Humor.
It clears Blood Loss and gives you a short regeneration. It won't bring Clarity. That comes through Consecrated Copper at the Podium and the Rite of Clarity Ascension.
Pallid Infusion only restores you. It doesn't mark a step on the path, so drink it whenever you need it and have one on hand.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.purificati: That is Unstained rite equipment: practical vessels and fittings for controlled purification work.
Use it carefully, at consecrated stations. Purification takes discipline. Fervor burns out. Which of the two did you bring?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.self_refle: The Self-Reflection Mirror opens your Unstained progress record: your purity, your clarity and where you stand on the path. Keep one close. Every practitioner should.
It shows you what you are. Our Lady gives you the reading plainly, and the deciding is left to you.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.silver_cha: The Silver Chalice is for Clarity work, once the second path has opened for you. Has it?
Offer it when the rite and your progress call for it. The mirror keeps the number. We keep the meaning.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.snow_block: Snow is water that chose to stay where it fell. Deep snow has a little of Our Lady in it, that cold that asks nothing of you and waits.
The path leads toward a fullness that can stay still, and deep snow feels close to that. It is also just cold, I grant you. Get there in your practice and you'll understand what I mean.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.sugar.line: Sugar is what's left after refining, the sweetness that stays once the raw stuff is boiled down to its real character. Clarity can feel like that. The work leaves you only yourself.
That's as far as the comparison goes, though. It's sugar. The farther you walk the path, the simpler things get, and the more completely they turn out to be themselves.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.tears_of_s: Tears of Silthmere. A crafted distillation, named for Silthmere, one of Our Lady's liturgical titles.
Their potency comes from disciplined preparation and consecration. Did you think it was grief? Mortal grief and wild water have nothing to do with it.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.liber_imma: The Liber Immaculatus is the guide we work from. Its First Steps lay out the exact sequence: Podium, Cleansed Stone, then Baptism.
Keep it. The later pages cover Purity, Clarity and the defensive Still Arts once you need them. Don't skip to the parts about power.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.unknown: That has no use on the path. Why did you think it would?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.unstained_: Unstained armor is pale silver alloy all through. It resists blood-corruption on contact, and once you're well along the path you can wear it without disturbing your purification.
Wear the full set and it carries its blessing, with Our Lady's protection gathering around you in her metal. Putting it on says you've committed. Have you?
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.water_buck: Water is Our Lady's element. Still water covers the deep, carries off whatever has been shed and remembers everything it touches. She lives in water that waits until it decides to move.
Carry it with intention. Bring still water to the Altar sincerely and it gets noticed. It stays there as a gesture, and Our Lady sees gestures. She also sees buckets carried for show.
hemomancy.zealot.no_blood: There's no mark of the blood arts on you. So why come to us? If it's the Church you want anyway, you can take five vows of clean service.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree0.line2: The infection has only just wounded you, and I'm sorry. It can still be treated.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree1.line2: The first rite has marked you. That infection is still fresh, so give it time before you call it a calling. What made you take the rite?
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree2.line2: Votary. You've started calling the stain a covenant. Who taught you that word? It hasn't claimed all of you yet.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree3.line2: Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane. So which is it, healing or another power? Say it plainly. We've learned to be afraid of curiosity dressed up as repentance.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree4.line2: Adept. The blood has given you craft, companions, and an appetite to go with them. Did you come for a cure, or for conquest? Don't make me guess.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree5.line2: Illuminatus. The Crimson Lodge has looked back at you through your own veins, and you come here anyway. Why now? I won't pretend I trust you easily.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line1: §7[The Zealot regards you with silver eyes]
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line2: You carry the stain of the Hematic Covenant in your blood.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line3: You asked, so here it is. It isn't too late. Hemolytic rites can cleanse what the Order corrupted in you.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line4: Bring hemolytic solution to our podium and start on the Unstained path. Leave the crimson veil behind before it consumes you.
hemomancy.zealot.silver_ward_info.line1: Silver Ward takes the defense Verdigris started and carries it further. With Clarity, what used to be a warning from outside becomes a boundary the blood's current has a hard time crossing.
hemomancy.zealot.silver_ward_info.line2: In Purity, the Verdigris Aura learned to recognize infection. Now Clarity teaches Silver Ward to refuse it when it gives orders. Can you tell yet when it's giving them?
hemomancy.zealot.tainted.line1: The first pallor is in you. Good. Is that relief you're feeling? It's only the start.
hemomancy.zealot.tainted.line2: Your Verdigris Aura will answer more readily now. It's the first boundary your blood is learning to respect.
hemomancy.zealot.too_deep: No. The blood's rooted too deep for the rites we offer here. Leave this church now, before our Guardians have to answer for us.
hemomancy.zealot.too_early: Do you know yet how heavy this is? No. Come back once the Covenant has shown you its true face.
hemomancy.zealot.uninitiated: The silver bells only toll for people who have tasted the blood. You have nothing for them to lift, so what are you asking for?
hemomancy.zealot.verdigris_info.line1: Virid Salis and verdigris are corruption spent and turned into a ward. We work with them. We don't decorate with them.
hemomancy.zealot.verdigris_info.line2: Lay them where blood gathers. The line won't clear out what's already there, but it won't let any pass.
item.hemomancy.absolution_dagger.tooltip: Permanently hemolytic; every strike disrupts blood-borne infection.
tooltip.hemomancy.morphic_tonic: Purges every harmful effect and mends a little. The only remedy an Apotheos body takes in the Gardens.
tooltip.hemomancy.gore_wound_harpoon.pul: Tethers a wounded target and draws it toward you.
tooltip.hemomancy.gore_wound_harpoon.cro: Living Crossbow: slight homing and returns after firing.
item.hemomancy.book_of_observances.toolt: Records NPC-directed observances, their offerings, and their fulfillment.
item.hemomancy.chalybeate_sclerite.toolt: Iron-black mantle scales grown beside deep vent heat.
Knap from a retracted Chalybeate Snail; killing rarely preserves useful scrap.
item.hemomancy.chamber_of_will_teleporte: Right-click to enter The Chamber of Will, right-click again to return.
item.hemomancy.charm_of_vascularium.tool: A vascular focus. Hold the menu key to choose blood manipulations once you learn them.
item.hemomancy.cleansing_hemolymph.toolt: A blue vial of cleansing fluid from Hemolymphopoda or Ice Fish
item.hemomancy.covenant_waybill.not_foun: The lodestone finds no Harbinger Outpost within its reach.
item.hemomancy.covenant_waybill.attuned: The lodestone catches the pulse of a Harbinger Outpost.
item.hemomancy.covenant_waybill.tooltip: Its blood-red pressure strengthens when you face the nearest Harbinger Outpost.
Hold to follow its pull. Use to seek the nearest Outpost again.
item.hemomancy.circus_waybill.not_found: The threads find no Circus pavilion within their reach.
item.hemomancy.circus_waybill.attuned: The waybill's threads catch on a distant Circus pavilion.
item.hemomancy.circus_waybill.tooltip: A scarlet route inked by a Mnemonist who refuses to call it a map.
item.hemomancy.circus_waybill.tooltip.us: Use: next eligible untaught professor. Sneak-use: unfinished pavilion.
item.hemomancy.erythrocoral_fragment.too: Warm reef tissue from a Vivacious fungal coral.
Shear reef fans and tendrils for the cleanest harvest.
item.hemomancy.field_notes.tooltip.curio: A worn notebook kept for marginalia and fieldwork.
item.hemomancy.field_notes.tooltip.legac: Memos now gather in your inventory notes until dictated into a Liber.
item.hemomancy.fruiting_lure.tooltip: Let it soak in Morphic Nectar to call the Mycophant back to a proven Apotheos.
item.hemomancy.gourd_seeds.tooltip: A strange crop seed found in common grass, and the first step onto the blood path.
message.hemomancy.recollection.taken: The cyst gives up what the hive kept of a Saint.
item.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_ledg: Hermit Road: seek abandoned hermit cells and blood-stained stones like the one from your own first invitation.
First wild remnant recorded. Return future discoveries to the proper Harbinger.
A Vicar's ledger for keeping Harbinger assignments in order.
Use to review current assignment notes.
item.hemomancy.hearty_compass.empty: The compass has no death to remember.
item.hemomancy.hearty_compass.tooltip: Tugs toward the place you last died.
item.hemomancy.hematic_iron_scrap.toolti: Iron scraped from a wound, still dark with the blood it soaked up.
Can be reclaimed as an iron nugget if you have no use for it yet.
item.hemomancy.hematic_memory_tool.blood: The tool finds too little awakened blood.
item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.fan: This link is outside your fane or needs Degree 5.
item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.ina: Your blood is not yet awakened.
item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.inv: The needle finds no blood route to stitch here.
item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.nee: Degree %s is required to bind a hematic suture.
item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.opt: You close your bloodline to fane routing.
You open your bloodline to fane routing.
item.hemomancy.hematic_suture_needle.sta: Use on a blood machine or node. Sneak-use to toggle bloodline opt-in.
item.hemomancy.husk_effigy.tooltip: Rehydrates into a short-lived allied distraction.
item.hemomancy.liber_sanguinum.tooltip.f: The Hematic Order's field guide. New pages appear as you progress.
item.hemomancy.living_flail.charge: Hold use to spin and charge (maximum 5 seconds)
item.hemomancy.living_flail.release: Release to launch the glacial head
item.hemomancy.living_sickle.tooltip.hoo: Blood Hook: use to throw, wound, and pull a distant foe
item.hemomancy.living_sickle.tooltip.sho: Short Reap: fast strikes; use to perform a sanguine spin
item.hemomancy.living_staff_fitting.tool: Scarlet Vanity fitting. Cosmetic Living Staff appearance only.
item.hemomancy.living_staff.vesper_awake: Disciplined by the memory of Vesper's refusal.
message.hemomancy.blood_sampling.require: Their hide is too tough to pierce with a needle alone.
item.hemomancy.living_syringe.restricted: Required to sample thick-skinned creatures and NPCs.
item.hemomancy.living_syringe.no_rack: No empty or partial vial rack in inventory.
message.hemomancy.blood_sampling.already: This Blood Vial already contains a sample.
message.hemomancy.blood_sampling.failed: The sample from %s did not hold.
message.hemomancy.blood_sampling.insuffi: %s cannot be sampled in its current condition.
message.hemomancy.blood_sampling.invalid: Blood Vials can only sample living creatures.
item.hemomancy.masons_respite_map.not_fo: The route will not open here.
item.hemomancy.masons_respite_map.points: The Masons Respite lies %s, about %s blocks away (%s, %s).
item.hemomancy.masons_respite_map.toolti: A scar-scribed route to a remote hermitage.
item.hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.tooltip: A final refusal, waiting to be drawn through a Living Staff.
Place in an Iron Brazier, then channel Living Staff Blood Absorption.
item.hemomancy.memory_thread.stop: The thread knots the route shut.
item.hemomancy.memory_thread.tooltip: Records a temporary red path while held.
item.hemomancy.mnemonic_ambergris.toolti: A waxy whale secretion offered during the Mnemonist Puppet Ordeal.
Each squid or Prism Cuttle a whale kills yields one immediately. Bottle sampling and gentle shedding also work; keep the whale alive.
item.hemomancy.mnemonic_blueprint.blank_: Imprint this blank blueprint from an unlocked Sanguine Conduit node
item.hemomancy.mnemonic_blueprint.no_bla: You need a blank mnemonic blueprint
item.hemomancy.mnemonic_blueprint.toolti: Blank; imprint it from the Sanguine Conduit
