Right-click in the air to study
item.hemomancy.mnemonic_folio.tooltip: Stores up to 30 stacks of mnemonic blueprints
item.hemomancy.mycophant_tendril.tooltip: The Mycophant's last hypha. It treats its wearer's body as fruiting ground.
Equip in the Charm of Vascularium slot to become fully fungalized.
item.hemomancy.orb_of_perspective.encoun: You can't change the Chamber's perspective during an ordeal.
item.hemomancy.orb_of_perspective.no_oth: You have earned no other Chamber perspective.
item.hemomancy.orb_of_perspective.not_be: Cast the Orb beyond the Chamber floor.
item.hemomancy.orb_of_perspective.outsid: The Orb works only inside its owner's Chamber.
item.hemomancy.orb_of_perspective.toolti: Throw beyond your Chamber platform to recall another earned perspective.
item.hemomancy.pale_silver_pickaxe.toolt: Pale silver, refined until no hematic taint remains.

item.hemomancy.terrestrial_speculum.no_v: You have no claimed Earthen Veins to travel to.

item.hemomancy.vein_spider.no_inventory: The spider cannot bite into that block.

message.hemomancy.vesper.wound_open: His carapace splits and blades no longer bite. Hold Blood Absorption on the open wound and drain him.
message.hemomancy.mycophant.claimed: She draws you against the brood. Tear free before you are taken in.
message.hemomancy.mycophant.fusion: Her wings close around you. She is trying to become you.
message.hemomancy.mycophant.broken: You tear out of her. She reels, wounded by the refusal.
message.hemomancy.mycophant.heir.title: The Hive Yields
message.hemomancy.mycophant.heir.subtitl: Nothing it has grown held out against its own gate. You are its heir.

message.hemomancy.mycophant.expelled: The Nursery returns you unfinished. It will remember after five minutes in the Gardens.
message.hemomancy.mycophant.tender_phase: It no longer strains against you. It opens.
message.hemomancy.mycophant.victory: The Mycophant folds tenderly into the nectar. The stalking is over.
message.hemomancy.mycophant.watches: The dark between the fruiting bodies is watching.
message.hemomancy.mycophant.whispers: Something beneath the Gardens has learned your rhythm.

message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.awak: The corpus is incensed. Strike it to begin the trial.
message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.dorm: Hold an empty Blood Vial and draw blood from the corpus.
message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.fail: The mausoleum stirs. A Saint awakens.
message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.reli: The relic knocks against the stone. Saint %s answers.
message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.resp: The corpus stirs. Keep drawing blood with empty Blood Vials, then process the Consecrated Syringe in a Vial Centrifuge.
message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.succ: The Saint's remains yield an enzyme.
morphling.hemomancy.sunburst.description: A gold lichen strain. In sunlight it feeds its host and spares food for whoever is failing nearby.
morphling.hemomancy.sunburst.stage.unfed: Faint gold under the skin, warmer in sunlight.
morphling.hemomancy.sunburst.stage.fledg: A gold-orange tint that brightens in sunlight and pulses slowly.
morphling.hemomancy.sunburst.stage.devel: Orange lichen rosettes crust the shoulders.
morphling.hemomancy.sunburst.stage.matur: Crust over the shoulders and upper back, frond buds at the shoulder blades.
morphling.hemomancy.sunburst.stage.apex: Broad fronds fan from the back and glow in sunlight.
morphling.hemomancy.sunburst.stage.prima: A canopy of fronds over the head. Anchored, it roots into the ground.
morphling.hemomancy.sunburst.court: Raised by the Giving Light. Its partner is a green alga that feeds it sunlight.
morphling.hemomancy.holdfast.description: A knotted strain that grips stone. It holds its host in place and shelters whoever stands behind.
morphling.hemomancy.holdfast.stage.unfed: A stony grey-brown cast to the skin.
morphling.hemomancy.holdfast.stage.fledg: A grey-brown tint flecked with coralline pink.
morphling.hemomancy.holdfast.stage.devel: Knotted holdfast nubs at the wrists.
morphling.hemomancy.holdfast.stage.matur: Branching roots wrapped around the forearms.
morphling.hemomancy.holdfast.stage.apex: Thick clusters on the forearms and calves; the fingers end in gripping strands.
morphling.hemomancy.holdfast.stage.prima: Root masses at the hands and feet. Anchored, the strands spread into the ground.
morphling.hemomancy.holdfast.court: Raised by the Holding Stone. Its partner is a red alga that cements itself to stone.
morphling.hemomancy.mermaids_purse.descr: A fast open-water strain. It banks blood from the hunt and spends it on whoever is hurt worst.
morphling.hemomancy.mermaids_purse.stage: A faint cobalt cast across the back.
A cobalt back fading to silver flanks, a crimson shimmer down each side.
Finlets along the forearms and calves, a slim purse at each flank.
Fin ridges along the arms. The purses swell with banked blood.
A sail along the spine that lies flat, then rises and flushes at speed.
A full sail, a crescent tail fin and a short bill over the brow.
morphling.hemomancy.mermaids_purse.court: Raised by the Shared Wake. Its partner is a gut bacterium that digests blood.
morphling.hemomancy.dead_mans_rope.descr: A strain of pulsing violet veins. Its strands catch falls and tie its host to an ally.
morphling.hemomancy.dead_mans_rope.stage: Violet-blue glints under the skin, branching like veins.
A translucent violet-blue tint with fine branching glints.
A vein network over the wrists and hands, pulsing slowly.
Veins over the shoulders; ribbon strands trail from the forearms.
Strands linked into beaded chains, a light pulse running down each.
A train of strands several blocks long trails behind.
morphling.hemomancy.dead_mans_rope.court: Raised by the Woven Current. Its partner is a bacterium that makes its light.
morphling.hemomancy.ink_cap.description: A shaggy black strain. It hides its host from notice and spends itself as ink to get them away.
morphling.hemomancy.ink_cap.stage.fledgl: An ink-black tint fading to bone white at the highlights.
morphling.hemomancy.ink_cap.stage.develo: Shaggy pale cap scales at the crown.
morphling.hemomancy.ink_cap.stage.mature: A tall shaggy cap over the head, its rim blackening and dripping.
morphling.hemomancy.ink_cap.stage.apex: A black veil hangs from the cap to the shoulders and drips ink.
morphling.hemomancy.ink_cap.stage.primal: The veil takes the head: a dark hood to the waist, filaments showing.
morphling.hemomancy.ink_cap.court: Raised by the Veiled Fold. Its partner is a black yeast that darkens its tissue.
morphling.hemomancy.hushbell.description: A frost-grey strain that conserves. It slows its host's needs and folds shut around them when hurt.
morphling.hemomancy.hushbell.stage.fledg: A frost blue-grey tint with a slow pulse, like held breath.
morphling.hemomancy.hushbell.stage.devel: Folded membrane flaps at the shoulders.
morphling.hemomancy.hushbell.stage.matur: A folded mantle wraps the chest and back.
morphling.hemomancy.hushbell.stage.apex: A bell-shaped mantle hangs to the knees from a weighted rim.
morphling.hemomancy.hushbell.stage.prima: The bell reaches the ankles. When it folds shut, it closes over the head.
morphling.hemomancy.hushbell.court: Raised by the Still Bell. Its partner is a bacterium that thrives in the cold.
morphling.hemomancy.marrowplume.descript: A bone-white strain beaded red. It feeds on bone, wounds and kills, and wastes none of it.
morphling.hemomancy.marrowplume.stage.fl: A bone-white tint beaded with small red droplets.
morphling.hemomancy.marrowplume.stage.de: Scarlet clubs bud at the knuckles and wrists.
morphling.hemomancy.marrowplume.stage.ma: Red club-stalks along the forearms, each with a feathery crown.
morphling.hemomancy.marrowplume.stage.ap: Taller stalks, sheaths to the shoulders, rooting stalks at the calves.
morphling.hemomancy.marrowplume.stage.pr: Bone-pale sheaths beaded red, a crown of plumes at the back. Anchored, it roots.
morphling.hemomancy.marrowplume.court: Raised by Last Marrow. Its partner is a bacterium that dissolves bone.
morphling.hemomancy.kinbud.description: A pale strain with a flame-coloured mane. It stings, and regrows what its host loses.
morphling.hemomancy.kinbud.stage.unfed: Skin pale enough to show the blood moving under it.
morphling.hemomancy.kinbud.stage.fledgli: A pale, translucent tint with a faint amber flicker.
morphling.hemomancy.kinbud.stage.develop: Small buds at the nape and along the spine.
morphling.hemomancy.kinbud.stage.mature: A short mane at the nape, amber to crimson, rippling like flame.
morphling.hemomancy.kinbud.stage.apex: A long mane down the back. In a fight, a second head buds at the shoulder.
morphling.hemomancy.kinbud.stage.primal: The crown takes the head: a smooth pale polyp ringed with flame-coloured tentacles.
morphling.hemomancy.kinbud.court: Raised by the Kindling. Its partner is a vent bacterium that lives on heat.
screen.hemomancy.book_of_observances.obs: Fashion a pale icon from cleansed memory and surrender it before possession becomes devotion.
Reward: 12 Purity and 3 Pale Silver Ingots
Condense Lethe's gift by patient craft instead of waiting for the dawn.
Reward: 10 Purity and 2 Tears of Silthmere
Consecrate copper until it takes to warding more readily than to corruption.
Reward: 5 Clarity and 2 Pale Silver Ingots
Collect Ghost Pipe, the flowers that grow where death came without violence.
Fashion a vessel for release, then bear it back without spilling its promise.
Reward: 8 Clarity and 4 Pale Silver Ingots
Bring the Acolyte four Ghost Pipe blooms and four Lethean Poppies.
Offering: 4 Ghost Pipe and 4 Lethean Poppies
Reward: Hemolytic Solution and Pale Distillate
Build a Pallid Retort and distill Hemolytic Solution.
Use a Pallid Retort to complete the distillation
Reward: 6 Consecrated Copper, Pale Silver, and Pale Distillate
Build a Stillwater Condenser and collect four Lethean Dew.
Reward: 8 Consecrated Copper and 2 Pale Silver
Complete Still Waters or Pale Consecration while another soul benefits.
Shelter another player or living Church guide
Reward: Consecrated Copper and pledge preparation
Supply the Guardians with coatings that destroy infection at the point of contact.
Reward: 8 Purity and 4 Consecrated Copper Ingots
Prepare a solution that loosens the blood's hold without feeding its hunger.
Bring a bell fit to mark corruption without panic, and let the watch hear your Clarity.
Reward: 12 Clarity and 3 Tears of Silthmere
Bind pale poppies into a patient ward and return it to the Acolyte.
screen.hemomancy.crossbar_radial.mode.fo: Stay near the puppeteer and attack nearby hostiles.
screen.hemomancy.crossbar_radial.mode.gu: Hold the puppeteer's current position and attack nearby hostiles.
screen.hemomancy.crossbar_radial.mode.hu: Seek hostile creatures within tether range.
screen.hemomancy.crossbar_radial.mode.pa: Follow without acquiring targets unless explicitly focused.
screen.hemomancy.crossbar_radial.title: Marionette Crossbar
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: The Evening Star is broken and its memory is yours. You stand outside the hive, Silentium of the Order.
Vesper's memory waits. Burn it in a lit Iron Brazier and draw it in with the Living Staff to finish your Silence.
The Apotheos rite is complete. Your covenant has ascended through Blood Beneath Blood.
You chose ascension. Complete the Apotheos rite to fulfill Blood Beneath Blood.
The severed wound is open. Enter it and defeat both faces of Vesper. If you fail, you can try the ordeal again.
Grow a Bloom of your own and consume its nine named pomes. The ledger records each husk carried into your blood.
Your Silence is only a decision. Prune your own Qliphoth to cut open the final refusal.
Use the ninth-pome Fungal Spine, survive the first projection, and answer the revelation.
The covenant now has both a name and a place. The Sanctified rite is open.
Consecrate your bloodline's Fane, or, at Degree 5, project blood yourself into its usable Bloodwell while standing inside the boundary.
The Blood Lust vestment is complete and appointed as Crimson Lodge witness-work.

Practice an armor upgrade and reach Degree 5 with active blood. Use a crafted or gifted Armature Consecration Kit to complete its rite at a Greater Cardinal Focus. The Artificer gives you one kit free.
Return to the Artificer wearing a full Blood Lust set for a cosmetic staff fitting.
Upgrade one forked armor piece into Blood Lust.
All eight enzyme expressions recorded. Your Vial Centrifuge work is done.
Carry each enzyme to record all eight expressions. Cultivation is a separate Vocation step.
Find the structure in the outer End and enter its nerve web. The Mnemonist can give you a bearing. You don't have to kill any of its residents.
Approach a Choir Keeper, Myelin Borer, or living chorus growth. Observing one is enough. Do not bring a specimen.
The same Mind visit counts here. This report records the memory inquiry and leaves your loadout slots and costs alone.
This report uses the same Mind visit plus a biology observation. Nothing is consumed.

Sample an Excoriated or Phlegethontic Bombardier with a Living Syringe. Sneak-use the syringe to eject its rack, use the rack on an idle Vial Centrifuge, and remove the vial without spinning. Hold it in your main hand for the Alchemist. Microscope identification is optional.
Carry five Scyphus items. A five-cup plant in the world doesn't count until you gather it, and breaking a cluster drops as many as it holds.
At Degree 5, show either blood sample and five Scyphus items to an Alchemist. All components and items stay with you. You don't need this Side report for promotion.

Ask the Alchemist for a Deep Dark bearing. Examine Ahaematic colloid from a sculk catalyst or Warden with a Hematic Microscope. Earlier analysis counts, and so does later sample-replay evidence. Reading a Vigil record alone does not.
At Degree 5, tell an Alchemist what the sample showed. You keep the sample, and the report doesn't reset or finish the Vigil Beneath inquiry.
Ask the Vicar about the Circus, then speak to a Mnemonist for a Scarlet Waybill. Visiting the pavilion counts even if you found it earlier. Its routes are optional.
Ask a Vicar for a vessel bearing, or find a Voyager at an Overworld Erythrocoral Reef. Talk about the crew's work and record one observation. You don't need ambergris.
The Vicar accepts an observation you made earlier. You don't need this Side assignment for Degree 4.
The Vicar points toward wet Overworld country. Visit the Fungal Gardens biome. The projection dimension doesn't count.
Carry one Infected Fungus and one Puffball Fungus. Both grow naturally in the Overworld gardens, and you keep them after inspection.
Show both plants to an Alchemist after the visit. The report records the survey, and you keep both specimens.
Fruit an enzyme in the Lantern
Take any enzyme from a Mycelial Lantern's output. You don't need an earlier catalog record, and work done at Degree 3 counts.
Capture or record a wild Polyp
Capture a Morphling Polyp with an empty Specimen Jar and hold the filled jar in your main hand, or use an earlier Polyp Bestiary record.
At Degree 4, show the Polyp jar or prior record to an Alchemist. You keep the specimen, and you don't need an Incubator.
Bring filled ecology specimen jars to the Alchemist. Morphling layer families recorded: %s.
The covenant survived in shared action. The Archon rite is open.
Enter and safely leave the Chamber, bind the Covenant Throne, then finish Covenant Vigil with a surviving assigned helper.
Four specimens cataloged. Keep harvesting: Bulbs serve bloodcraft, Foul Paste starts living infrastructure, and Spore Sacs feed cultures.
Three lanes: Bleeding Heart/Sarcodes to Bleeding Bulbs; Infected Fungus/Stinkhorn/Devil's Tooth to Foul Paste; Puffball/Rafflesia to Spore Sacs. A Fungling sample also yields Infected Fungus.
Use Blood Projection to craft a Hematic Iron Block.
Speak with the Alchemist and accept the First Separation.
Accept First Draws. You get five empty Blood Vials once, and any that don't fit wait until you have space. You never need this Side work for Degree 2.
Left-click eligible common animals with empty Blood Vials. Only successful collections count.
Use at least three of cattle, pigs, sheep, chickens, rabbits, or goats. Keep the filled vials for later.
Use Blood Projection to craft a Liber Sanguinium.
Gain a total of 500 mL using Blood Absorption. Spending blood does not erase earlier progress.
Complete one ordinary Ghastly Alembic recipe and take its result. This proves the Votary lesson required for Degree 3.
Meet the Vicar and accept formal initiation to reach Degree 1.
Claim the Mortal Display and leave the first stained marker behind.
Report the remnant to a Vicar and receive this ledger.
Craft or place the Degree-1 station for separating sampled blood.
Extract the enzyme marked by your assigned separation spin.
Return to the Alchemist with the recovered enzyme for the Living Syringe and vial rack.
Find a Hermitage Remnant and read the blood echo at its stained stone.
Take a living blood sample in a Blood Vial.
After First Separation and an Alembic distillation, ask the Alchemist for Concentrated Blood. Inject it, then complete a night's sleep.
The Concentrated Blood is circulating. Complete a night's sleep to awaken as an Initiate.
Load filled vials in opposite slots and start a balanced Centrifuge spin.
All seven base living weapon forms are known and appointed as a full arsenal.
Unlock, craft, and complete one Rite of the Assumed Limb with a Living Weapon Graft.
Known living weapon forms: %s/%s. Learn all seven conjure forms before claiming the fitting.
Return to the Artificer after learning all seven living weapon forms.
A complete matching fork set is appointed as a staff fitting.
Wear a complete matching Barbed, Chitinite, or Prismatic set and return to the Artificer.
Upgrade one Hematic Iron piece into Barbed, Chitinite, or Prismatic armor.
A full Hematic Iron set is appointed as a staff fitting. Equip it at a Degree-3 Scarlet Vanity.
Craft and place a Hematic Armature.
Wear a full Hematic Iron set and return to the Artificer for a cosmetic staff fitting.
Complete the first iron-to-Hematic-Iron armor upgrade in the Armature.
Place the carved Scar in a lit Iron Brazier, then hold Blood Absorption to learn it (100 mL).
Carve the given pattern into a Scar item at the Cerebral Scarring Station.
Place the Effigy-prepared Scar Pattern in a lit Iron Brazier, then hold Blood Absorption to commit the loadout (50 mL).
Reach Degree 4 and ask the Vicar who teaches the old scarring rites.
Use the Masons Respite Map and receive the first Scar Pattern from the Vein-Mason.
Use the Mason's Effigy, Runic Motif Paper, and projected blood to prepare a loadout pattern.
Return to the Vein-Mason for a continuation kit: a second pattern, blank scar, catalyst, and Motif Paper.
A complete matching Degree 7 set is appointed as a staff fitting.
Complete the Rite of the Monolithic Armature with a Monolithic Cornerstone.
Wear a complete matching Degree 7 set and return to the Artificer for a cosmetic staff fitting.
Complete one late Armature upgrade: final lineage armor, or Silent Archon Vestments once you are Silentium.
The Mnemonist indexed your vessel, and the Somatic Loom crystallized your first deliberate memory.
Craft a blank Hematic Memory, have the Mnemonist index it with archive materials, then complete a Somatic Loom weave. Raise the Loom itself on a Lesser Working floor.
screen.hemomancy.puppeteers_spindle.degr: Requires Degree %s before the ordeal rite can surface.
screen.hemomancy.puppeteers_spindle.know: Known. Click to prepare this shape for field use.

screen.hemomancy.puppeteers_spindle.tria: Recipe unlocked at Degree %s. Defeat the unbound trial form to learn it.
