hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.descriptio: An old ambergris cylinder cut with unfamiliar grooves. Play it in a Clairaudiograph, and bring an analyzed dark sample.
hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.lower_dist: Weathered Ambergris Cylinder: Lower District Survey
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.behind: [A click behind you. It isn't on the recording.]
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.1: Unknown Recorder: Lower district. Record nineteen.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.2: Unknown Recorder: The growth to the west has stopped.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.4: Unknown Recorder: It has not died. It stopped.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.5: Unknown Recorder: The catalysts still take the dead. The listeners still answer movement. Nothing there has changed.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.6: Unknown Recorder: But they do not answer one another the way they did.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.9: Distant Voice: Then why are they still alive?
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.1: Unknown Recorder: We cut the voice.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.survey.1: Unknown Recorder: Lower district survey. The growth takes the dead. The listeners answer movement, but do not go beyond the black floor.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.survey.2: Distant Voice: Do not carry the growth upward. Keep the dead elsewhere. Mark the last clean stair.
Unknown Recorder: Do not ring bells below the third stair. No iron wheels. Wrap the road. Walk softly.
Distant Voice: If the floor answers twice, leave. If it answers three times, do not return for those below.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.initial_al: Let me see that vial. My microscope can't find a blood cell in it, but the material inside keeps moving together.
Tap the glass for me. See how it pulls back? I tested all eight tendencies, and none of them fit. I don't know what we're looking at.
The Vicar once warned me away from a similar account in the old histories. Take the sample to him and see if he remembers it.
Keep the vial. Try to learn what makes the material move, and search an Ancient City for records left by people who lived near it.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.initial_vi: The Alchemist sent me with this dark sample.
The Alchemist sent you because the sample doesn't behave like blood, and they're right to ask, though I can't name it from a vial alone.
There's a passage I know that might describe something like it, but it's old and vague, and I don't want to build a history around one sample.
Go to an Ancient City and look for something its people recorded for themselves, because an instruction or a field report would tell us more than any later account could.
Bring back whatever you find, along with the vial, so I can compare the words with what the sample does.
I found an old recording beneath an Ancient City.
This cylinder is ambergris, but those grooves came from a different machine. The people who made it knew how to store a recording too.
You said part of it went silent? I can see another trace there on the spectrograph, even though our machine plays no sound from that section.
Bring your analyzed dark sample back. Put it in the Clairaudiograph or hold it beside the machine, then play the cylinder again.
After that, set the machine within eight blocks of me so I can watch a full replay. If the sample only reacts to sound, it should sit still through the silent part.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.tit: The sample reacted during the silence.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.1: The sample climbed the glass toward the machine? Tell me when. During the Shrieker, or afterward? During the silence. All right, let me see it.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.2: I want to watch that happen myself. Set up the cylinder again.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.3: Put the analyzed vial beside the machine and play the whole silent section while I'm within eight blocks. Watch the sound trace and the other one.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.4: If the vial moves while the sound trace stays flat, we'll know ordinary sound isn't causing it.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.conclusion: What did the controlled replay establish?
I was wrong about the sample. Sound makes it move, but it also turned toward the machine when the recording fell silent.
The sound trace stayed flat the whole time. Something was still present in the grooves, and the sample seemed to sense it.
I can't tell you what that signal is. Our machine may be missing part of the sound, or the old recording may carry something else entirely.
The speaker also said they stopped the growth from answering itself without killing it. The Vicar may know what they meant. Take him the cylinder and the vial.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.recognitio: What did the old recording mean?
Did you hear it? The speaker says they stopped the growth from answering itself, yet it stayed alive, and I've seen that same account in our oldest histories.
Those histories describe a wound that never healed and living material that remained beneath it. They say the break held, but they never explain what was broken.
There's no author, no date and no named rite. By the Second Age people read it as a lesson in restraint, and so did I, but this recording makes that reading harder to accept.
If the speaker meant the sculk, they may have cut off a way for its parts to answer each other. The growth could survive even after that connection was gone.
That's still a guess. We've seen it react to a recording, and we haven't proved that it speaks, remembers or understands us.
Later writers called these fragments the Antecedent because they seem to describe something older than blood. We don't know what the people in that city called it.

Find the place where they watched the damaged growth, because their own records may tell us what they tried to separate and why they left the sculk alive. Ask me about the Last Listeners when you're ready.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.title: Where did the Last Listeners keep vigil?
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.1: The account points to a quiet place below the city, past the end of a wool-lined passage, where the Last Listeners kept watch.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.2: Follow the Ancient City roads and look for a small, enclosed entrance, which could be beside any district. Go through the passage, and when the wool stops, keep going.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.3: Leave the damaged structures alone while you're there, since a missing piece may be the reason the growth can't answer itself.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.4: I don't know if their work held because they did it well or because nobody has tried to undo it. Please don't test that by putting anything back together.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.comparison: Could the Antecedent be the same Entity?
I see why you ask, but I can't tell you they came from the same Entity when, so far, the similarities are only on the surface.
The sculk sample has no blood and answers none of the eight tendencies. The Alchemist can't draw an enzyme from it. Erythromycelium is made of something else entirely.
Their behavior gives us a better question. How does each one spread, and what does it need to stay alive?
Sculk stays in one area and feeds on the dead, while Erythromycelium moves through living hosts, and we'd need much stronger evidence than that to claim they share an origin.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.housing.1: The archive shows how they built a small listening device, and if you bring me four iron nuggets and one Echo Shard, I'll make its housing.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.housing.2: Hold the housing in one hand and an analyzed Ahaematic vial in the other, then use the housing to load it. Keep it beside the Clairaudiograph through the full silent section, and when it wakes, you can fit it to your Charm at a Scarlet Vanity or take it off there later.
hemomancy.antecedent.epilogue:
You found us under the stone.

We remember listening here, waiting for the dead to come. We waited a long time.

We don't wait for them now.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.0: Hold analyzed Ahaematic Colloid in the other hand and use this. It returns the empty vial.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.1: Hold beside the Clairaudiograph through the entire silent response.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.2: Fit it to your Charm at a Scarlet Vanity. You cannot hear the sculk. You can hear it listen.
hemomancy.antecedent.housing.cost: Reconstruction needs four iron nuggets and one Echo Shard.

hemomancy.antecedent.vigil.subtitle: Pass where the wool ends.

hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.condenser.re: Distill something at an ordinary Alembic and take the result out yourself. Once you've reached the fourth Degree with your blood awake, I'll trust you with a Condenser kit.

You've seen what the Alembic separates. Take this Condenser Kit to a lit brazier on a working lesser Cardinal floor and put five more offerings beside it. The Alembic sits one plinth behind the Focus, and its two blood circuits have to close in order.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.condenser.cl: The Condenser Kit is yours, and now you know how to build another. Cancel the rite and you get every offering back. A finished Condenser raises your tank from 5,000 to 7,500 mL, though it doesn't put any blood in, and it keeps that capacity when you move it.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.athanor.requ: Take a distillation result out yourself, then finish a refinement and a two-effect compound at a Condenser and take each of those out yourself too. Reach the sixth Degree with your blood awake and the greater circuit's yours. Didn't accept my earlier kit? It doesn't matter.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.athanor.read: This Athanor Kit goes to a Condenser on a working greater Cardinal floor. Put it on a lit brazier with five more offerings, then feed the three marked bulbs in order.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.athanor.clai: The Athanor's new socket holds your second catalyst, and the tank keeps the Condenser's 7,500 mL capacity. The mantle gives permanent heat without a block underneath, and every Alembic recipe takes half the time. Cancel the rite and you get every offering back, but blood you've already spent is gone. A finished Athanor keeps its tier when you move it.

hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.title: Ask about the Resonant Forge
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.early: Third Degree, you can build the Resonant Forge. It takes an anvil, cauldron, grindstone, Hematic Iron, Ferric Binder, 500 mL of blood, and a blank Wax Cylinder. You don't need it yet. You can start, though. At the fourth Degree I'll walk you through a full transfer.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.lesso: Set enchanted equipment and a blank Wax Cylinder on the grinding side. Keep blood in the basin. Start the wheel. It cuts the pattern out: cleaned equipment in one output, an engraved cylinder in the other.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.taugh: Move the engraved cylinder beside target equipment on the hammer side. Start application. Compatible enchantments carry over. An ordinary cylinder gets used up. Ambergris works for ordinary patterns too. Tend the hammer and wheel when they wear.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.pract: Sixth Degree. Now you practice: move a Scriptorium curse, or an enchantment you pick. The base wheel moves the whole pattern. A Precision governor picks one part out of it. Same forge. No new tier.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.preci: Grind one pattern into wax. Hammer one pattern back into a tool. At the fifth Degree I'll give you a governor steady enough to separate one vibration from the rest.

Take the Precision Governor Kit. Seat your forge behind a Cardinal Focus. Set the kit and five more offerings on lit braziers. Close the two marked grooves with 250 mL of blood each. Then the wheel can choose one enchantment, or the curse beneath them.
The governor's yours. The Rite of the True Groove changes the forge you've already got. It keeps the forge's blood, tools, and wear.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.maste: Learn grinding and application. Then grind a single chosen vibration out of a tool at a Precision Forge yourself. Seventh Degree, blood awake, and the Master Cam's yours. Didn't claim my earlier gift? Doesn't matter.
Take the Master Cam Kit. Set it with five more offerings on lit braziers. The Rite of the Enduring Pattern has three points: reader, hammer, and stabilizer. Give each 250 mL, in order.
The master cam can stabilize an engraved Ambergris Cylinder. Stabilizing costs 1,000 mL. After that the cylinder survives every proper application. Ordinary wax can't hold a master pattern.
hemomancy.initiation.ask: I wish to be formally introduced to the Harbingers.
hemomancy.initiation.offer: The charm has not settled yet, so the choice is still yours. Before I receive you into the Order, know that I can still remove it and release you.
hemomancy.initiation.reason: A Harbinger without dedication is no use to us, and is often worse than one made by accident. I would rather free you now than bind someone who does not wish to stay.
hemomancy.initiation.accept: I choose to remain. Initiate me.
hemomancy.initiation.remove: Remove the charm. I want to be free.
hemomancy.initiation.released: The Vicar draws out the unsettled charm and its pulse stops. You are free.
hemomancy.initiation.bloodline: Your blood has settled into %s. You belong to this bloodline now.
hemomancy.initiation.welcome: You are a Neophyte of the Crimson Veil. Take this Sanguine Conduit. The Vicar has four first bloodcraft proofs for you, and your ledger will record them in whatever order you finish them.
hemomancy.initiation.cannot_attach: The heart cannot attach while your vascular scar is occupied or you already bear awakened blood.
hemomancy.initiation.blood_rest: Inject the Concentrated Blood the same way you would a blood shot, then let it settle. A night's rest will do more for it than standing here waiting.
hemomancy.initiation.awakened: The concentrated blood has settled into your circulation. You wake as an Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane.
hemomancy.initiation.replace: Give me a vial of Concentrated Blood.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.vicar_path: We're the Harbingers, keepers of the Covenant of blood. Our path starts at a Hermit's Blood Temple, so you won't begin it at this outpost. Find a temple, speak with its Hermit and follow the Hermitage's path there. If it goes well, come back to me and we'll talk about your next step.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.alchemist: The Vicar can tell you who we are. Talk to him before you put your hands on any of my apparatus.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.artificer: New to the outpost? The Vicar explains the Covenant better than I do. Go talk to him.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.cicatrix_anc: You have no place on my table yet. Find the Vicar. Ask what road brought you here.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.mnemonist: You are looking for a beginning. The Vicar can give you its shape.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.voyager: So you found a ship before you found an outpost. Ask a Vicar ashore who we are and where you ought to start.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.votary_wayfa: Wait, you haven't met the Vicar? He'll explain the Covenant. Talk to him before you set out again.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.undecide: I have no ending to enter in the record for you yet. Some of your work is still open.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.silent_p: You've refused the call, and the refusal was yours to make, but you haven't won it yet. Come back to me once Vesper is defeated.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.silent_a: Vesper has fallen, yet his memory is still in your hands. Burn it in a lit Iron Brazier and draw it in with the Living Staff, and your refusal is finished.
Vesper has fallen and your refusal stands, Silentium, and our rites are still yours.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.apotheos: You've chosen Apotheosis, but the rite isn't finished, and I'll keep the records open until it is.
The Apotheosis is complete, and I can still tend our rites and whatever obligations remain unfinished.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.alchemist.unde: There's work ahead I can't measure yet. What do you need from the workshop?
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.alchemist.sile: Your refusal's on record, but Vesper's still ahead of you. The workshop's open for repairs and preparations.
You beat Vesper, but you're still carrying his memory. Burn it in a lit Iron Brazier and pull it in with the Staff. That finishes it.
You came back from Vesper. I can still make and mend the instruments you use.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.alchemist.apot: The Apotheosis has started, but it isn't finished. What does the apparatus need?
The machines still work. Bring me what needs mending.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.artificer.unde: You reached Archon. The frame isn't finished. Bring it back when the next strain shows.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.artificer.sile: A refusal needs a frame that survives Vesper. Bring the damaged pieces back.
Vesper's down. His memory isn't in you yet. Lit Iron Brazier, Living Staff. Draw it in.
You held against Vesper. I can still fit the armature. I'll finish what you left here, too.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.artificer.apot: The rite isn't over. I can still fit the frame for what comes next.
Your frame's changed. What still needs fitting? Show me.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.unde: I can record what you have seen. I will not name what has not happened.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.sile: You have refused. The record is not finished until Vesper falls.
Vesper's defeat is on the record. His memory is not. Burn it in a lit Iron Brazier and draw it in with the Living Staff, and the record will close.
Your return from Vesper is on the record. The older lessons are still here, if you need them.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.apot: I can preserve the record of the rite. I will not call it finished yet.
The record says Apotheos. I can still help you recover the memories you came for.
hemomancy.dialogue.action.confirm: Review what this choice will do, then continue when you are ready.
hemomancy.dialogue.conversation.prompt: What else did you want to discuss?
I'll enter this observance in your book, with its offering and its reward. Only take it if you mean to finish the work.
You're already carrying this observance, and your book shows what's left to do. Come back when you have the offering ready.
The work's done. Give me the offering and I'll mark the observance fulfilled.
hemomancy.clinical.microscope.prompt: You brought me a viable sample. I can teach you how to read it under the Hematic Microscope and add the design to your notes.
hemomancy.clinical.injection.prompt: You have examined blood closely enough to understand the risk. I can now teach you how to borrow its physiology.
hemomancy.clinical.cabinet.prompt: Three distinct sources are enough to begin a proper collection. I can show you how to build and use a Phlebotomist's Cabinet.
hemomancy.clinical.field_referral.prompt: Your cabinet work is sound, and you have met the Artificer. I can write the referral that turns laboratory storage into field equipment.
hemomancy.clinical.field_case.prompt: The Alchemist's referral is in order. I can show you how to rebuild a Cabinet for travel without losing its specimens.
hemomancy.clinical.echo_referral.prompt: Your samples carry something physiology cannot explain. I can refer that residue to the Mnemonist for formal study.
hemomancy.clinical.clairaudiograph.promp: The Alchemist has named the specimen. I can teach you to carve what its blood remembers saying.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.condenser.pr: You've done the lesser work and brought me enough evidence. I can release the Condenser Kit and walk you through the rite that seats it.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.athanor.prom: Your Condenser work checks out. I can release the Athanor Kit and show you the greater circuit.
hemomancy.scout.take_notes.prompt: Give me your hands. Take the journal now, while I still can.
hemomancy.zealot.take_vows.prompt: Will you serve the Church until every one of the five vows is done? Then take them. They are work, with no ceremony to hide behind.
hemomancy.alchemist.artificer_three_answ: The Artificer's inspection is good enough for me. I've got the reagent that matches the armor family you chose, so take it and put that answer to work.
hemomancy.alchemist.artificer_crimson_ve: Your consecrated frame's been inspected, so I'll issue the Crimson Lacquer you need to finish the vestment.
hemomancy.alchemist.armor_research.claim: Your Bestiary has the three records I asked for. I'll check them against the Artificer's work before I issue another reagent.
hemomancy.alchemist.living_bestiary.reco: Keep the specimen in one piece. I don't need it, just the observations entered in your Bestiary.
hemomancy.alchemist.living_bestiary.surr: Surrender the jar and the study uses up the specimen. Are you sure you're done with it?
Which living layer are you surrendering? Whichever polyp you pick gets used up in the study.
That's one of the blood-fed fungi I asked for. Hand it over and I'll add the result to your taxonomy.
hemomancy.alchemist.first_separation.cla: The enzyme came through a balanced spin, then? Show me the result and I'll close the assignment and issue your next supplies.
hemomancy.alchemist.body_answers.prompt: You know what blood separates into now. Next I can show you how those answers get brewed back into the body.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.promp: You found a remnant without being led to it. Show me the evidence and I will give you the ledger where your formal work is recorded.
Your ledger bears all four proofs. The Vicar can grant you the Second Degree.
hemomancy.vicar.masons_respite.prompt: Your next instruction is not something this outpost can give. I will mark you the road to Masons Respite, where the Vein-Mason waits.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.diagnosis.prompt: Let me read the vessel before you treat it. Once I name the injury, you will know the medicine.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.reward.prompt: You have borne injury, treatment, and preparation. I trust you with the deeper pattern.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.referral.prompt: This question belongs to the Mnemonist. Take my referral and hear their counsel. Then return to prove the route.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.reward.prompt: You changed the route. It bore another instruction. The final pattern is yours.
hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.prompt: Your strongest tendency sets the first cut. Accept the pattern. Carve it at the Scarring Station as I described.
The first wound answered another. Take the next pattern when you are ready to choose for yourself.
hemomancy.anchorite.replace_pattern.prom: I can replace the last pattern I gave you. Take another only if you have lost the first.
hemomancy.mnemonist.anchorite_counsel.pr: The Anchorite sent you because the memory and the scar must agree. Take my counsel. Then return and prove both routes.
hemomancy.hermit.archon_wisdom.prompt: Ask, Archon. What wisdom I saved from dust and blood is yours to take.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.promp: The forge copies an enchantment's cadence into ambergris wax. Then it hammers it into another tool. Building one? I'll put the pattern in your notes.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.preci: You know the base forge. You've reached the fifth Degree. I can give you the Precision Governor Kit for the next rite.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.maste: Your precision forge is ready for its last mechanism. Want the Master Cam Kit? I'll give you that and the rite that seats it.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.release.promp: Ending the pact removes this Harbinger from your bloodline. If that is your decision, say it plainly.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.replace_abso: Lost the dagger I issued. I'll replace it. Only while you're still fit to carry one.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.absorpti: How do I absorb enough blood?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.projecti: How do I condense a formation, and make Venous Stone?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.rooted_v: How do I begin a Cardinal rite?
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.floor: Start with the Rite of the Rooted Vein. Which floor does a rite that changes the world stand on? A Dominion floor: a Lesser square of deepslate tiles or bricks, studded with eight Chiseled Hematic Iron blocks around a Cardinal Focus. Use no copper, because it is the Unstained metal and will not hold our pattern. Making is done on the Working floor, and your initiation stood on the Threshold.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.offer: Keep the block above the Focus clear. Set one Blood Rock in an Iron Brazier on a floor socket and light it with Blood Projection, and leave the Focus's medium slot empty. No helper, support sigil or second offering is required, so you can do this alone.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.staff: Use your Living Staff on the Focus, then feed the four anchors with Blood Projection and project into the daemon to seal the rite. Stay inside the boundary while it consumes the offering and returns. Whether a rite answers you at all still depends on your degree and on your blood being active.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.recov: When the rite completes, the Focus becomes Venous Stone with a permanent Earthen Vein above it. If you must cancel before completion, hold Blood Absorption on the planted Staff until it returns, and know that blood you paid into the anchors and offerings already consumed are spent, though an untouched offering stays in its brazier.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.liber_bl: Give me the Liber Sanguinium blueprint.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.iron_blu: Give me the Hematic Iron blueprint.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.absorption_hint: Hold Blood Absorption toward a living creature or a blood reservoir. The ledger counts only blood that enters your vessel this way. Blood from a flask or from passive recovery is not counted. You need 500 mL in total.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.projection_hint: These are two lessons with two targets. Pour your blood into an empty cauldron and the cauldron holds it until, in time, it crystallizes into a Sanguine Formation, which you must take out yourself, but pour it into ordinary stone and the stone drinks it and stains to Venous Stone.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.crafting_hint: First craft Foul Paste from Nether Wart, gunpowder and bone meal and smelt it into Befouling Ash, and then ask me for a Mnemonic Blueprint, build either pattern, hold its catalyst in your offhand, and project blood into the center.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.firs: What is my first Alembic assignment?
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.first_distill: Make a Ghastly Alembic, run one ordinary distillation through it and take the result. First Separation proves you can recover an enzyme, and the Alembic proves you can use blood as a reagent. Once you've done both, ask me for Concentrated Blood.
hemomancy.alchemist.first_separation.nex: If your inventory's full, your tools will wait for you. Next you need one completed Ghastly Alembic distillation. Take its result, then ask me for Concentrated Blood.
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: Project blood into an empty cauldron, wait for it to crystallize, and collect the formation yourself.
Project blood into ordinary stone to produce Venous Stone.
Use a projected blood-structure recipe to create either a Liber Sanguinium or Hematic Iron Block.
Show the Vicar all four proofs to receive Degree 2.
container.hemomancy.alembic.containers.t: Filled vessels supply the tank, and empty ones bottle its blood.
Tinctures use an empty flask or jug here and blood from the tank.
message.hemomancy.vial_centrifuge.blocke: Clear space for hematic iron powder.
message.hemomancy.vial_centrifuge.rite_l: The centrifuge is held by an upgrade rite.
Your separation work holds up. I can give you a governor and teach you its two circuits.

Balance a spin and take an ordinary specimen result out yourself, which you've already covered in First Separation. Reach the fourth Degree with your blood awake and I can give you a Centrifugal Governor Kit.

A steadier spin leaves less behind. Bring this governor to a lit brazier with an Iron Ingot, a Chain, Sanguine Glass, a Ferric Binder and a Neurotic Enzyme. The base centrifuge sits two blocks behind the Focus on a Greater working floor. Fill four anchors, close two 50 mL circuits, then finish the procession.

With the governor you'll get a quarter more primary material on average, a spin takes seven and a half seconds, and on average three vials in four give back iron powder. Keep opposing vials balanced. You know how to craft another kit. A canceled rite gives back the offerings and the Staff, but not the blood you've spent.
hemomancy.alchemist.centrifuge.fractiona: You've worked the calibrated rotor. I can teach you to recover a second fraction.

Take an ordinary specimen result out of a completed calibrated or fractionating spin yourself. Once you're at the sixth Degree with your blood awake and your earlier separation work proven, the next rotor's yours. Skipped my first gift? That's fine.

A mixed specimen can still have another useful fraction left in it. Set this kit on a lit brazier with an Amethyst Shard, a Ghast Tear, a Hematic Iron Block, Chromatic Sublimate and an Enzyme Primer. The calibrated centrifuge goes two blocks behind the Focus on a Greater working floor. Fill eight anchors, close three 50 mL circuits, then finish the procession.

A spin takes five seconds now and returns half again as much primary material on average. Every ordinary vial gives one iron powder, and half of mixed specimens also give one item of a different fraction, drawn only from their own blood profile. Leave room in the eight shared output slots for both fractions. Sacred syringes still yield one residuum.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.centrifuge_up: At the fourth Degree, the Alchemist teaches a governor after personal separation. At the sixth, personal recovery from a calibrated spin earns a fractionating rotor. Both are Cardinal upgrades of this same machine. A gifted or crafted kit can't stand in for the practice.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chiton.title: Chiton
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chiton.descr: Eight overlapping plates seal a grazing foot against the rock. Its iron-rich blood can only be drawn with a Living Syringe.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chiton.sourc: Wet coastal stone on Rockpool Shores. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.pyrosome.des: A hollow living colony; waves of light pass between its small, coordinated bodies.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.pyrosome.sou: Open Pelagic water, with occasional Twilight visitors. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.pelagic_herr: A swift silver shoaler whose crimson lateral line follows the turn of its neighbors.
Schools of six to ten in the open Pelagic Ocean. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.siphonophore: A Ductilis colonial swimmer whose hanging tentacles zap small fish in the deeper Pelagic water column.
Twilight waters and adjacent Pelagic layers. Player kills yield ordinary Ganglion Clusters, not the unique Naeglerophaeon organ.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.bloody_belly: Transparent lobes reveal a crimson gut while moving comb rows catch the dark water's light.
Midnight water, with sparse Twilight and Carrion visitors. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hagfish.desc: A jawless scavenger of old bones. Disturbance draws a brief veil of slime before it withdraws.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hagfish.sour: Carrion fossil sites; accepts rotten flesh offered by hand. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.vampire_squi: Eight curling arms bear a crimson web lined with pale barbs. When threatened, the web folds around the mantle as the squid retreats.
Open water in Carrion and Hydrothermal Depths. Drops Barbed Splinters; capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.osteophage.d: A skeletal bearded vulture roosting on valley fossils. It climbs above skeleton prey before striking, then grinds loose bones in its hooked beak.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.osteophage.s: Soul Sand Valley bone formations. Offer dropped bones; player kills yield Venous Pinions. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.ice_fish.des: A pale, broad-headed fish that swims in cold-water schools. The Unstained regard its hemoglobin-free circulation as naturally pure.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.ice_fish.sou: Cold and frozen oceans, Frozen Rivers and submerged Ice Spikes pools. Drops Cleansing Hemolymph; capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
hemomancy.circus.school.instruction_requ: A professor must teach this shape before you can begin its Cardinal Ordeal.
hemomancy.circus.school.ask_history: How did you join the Troupe?
hemomancy.circus.school.ask_colleagues: What do you think of the other professors?
hemomancy.circus.school.ask_aftermath: What happens to the school after the final act?
hemomancy.circus.school.testimony: Tell me about the wrong audience and the missing understudy.
hemomancy.circus.school.guest: Perform a guest act using this exercise.
hemomancy.circus.school.conductor: Tell me about the school and its conductor.
hemomancy.circus.school.not_ready: You need active blood and the Degree this professor's shape calls for before instruction can begin. Nothing has been recorded.
hemomancy.circus.school.inspected: Attuned to you and charged, so this Crossbar checks out. Now learn a shape, beat its ordeal, then call, command and recall a body with this same Crossbar.
hemomancy.circus.school.inspect_failed: Hold up your own attuned Crossbar with some charge in it. I can't inspect someone else's instrument.
hemomancy.circus.school.unlock_first: Unlock this shape through its Cardinal Ordeal first. For a guest act you also need a passed practical and a daily payment that's still available.
hemomancy.circus.school.ring_blocked: The practice space is blocked or wet. Clear it and come back for the exercise.
hemomancy.circus.school.retry: Your practical's over. Go back to the professor to try again. Your instruction and finished work stay on the record.
hemomancy.circus.school.passed: Your professor marks the act complete. Nicely controlled.
hemomancy.circus.school.report_complete: That's your completed work entered in the account, and the school recognizes the progress.
hemomancy.circus.school.report_incomplet: There's still work I need to see. Check the Side section of your Assignment Ledger for the next step.
hemomancy.circus.school.reward: Guest payment's settled. %s Filaments are set aside for you to collect from a Threadkeeper.
hemomancy.circus.school.preparation: Attune a Marionette Crossbar to yourself, charge it at a Puppeteer's Spindle, and carry spare Filaments. A lesson shows you the ordeal recipe and that's all, the shape stays locked until you beat the Cardinal Ordeal, and that still takes its Degree, blood, frame and your reusable Crossbar. For a practical you bring your own known bodies on ordinary charge and give them the usual commands. Two live rehearsal threats come at you. Stay within twenty blocks of me and finish inside five minutes. If it goes badly, recall or walk off and try again.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.preparati: Crossbars, Filaments, inspections and reports all go through the Threadhouse. The final act's the Ringmaster's to conduct.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.degree: You haven't reached the Degree my shape needs yet. You're welcome to study how it's built, and our history, in the meantime.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.lesson: You're ready for personal instruction. Ask and I'll teach you this shape.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.ordeal: Your instruction's on the record. Now prepare the frame and beat this shape's Cardinal Ordeal.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.practical: You know the shape now. Call it on your own Crossbar and show me what it's for in my rehearsal ring.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.mastered: You've passed my practical. Once a Minecraft day you can run the exercise again as a paid guest act.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.neutra: Nobody's settled the Ringmaster's bargain yet. You can take lessons without agreeing to either ending.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.succes: You've chosen Succession. Its final act is the Ringmaster's usual challenges, and the apprenticeship adds nothing to it.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.libera: You've chosen Liberation. Cutting the captive strings kills the people bound to them, so don't expect three living prisoners to walk free.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.succes: Succession left the pavilion standing and gave you its Pattern. The professors keep teaching, even the ones who don't trust your bargain.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.libera: The captives are dead, the Ringmaster too, and the carousel's ruined. We teach out of the surviving camps now, and no win of ours brings those people back.
hemomancy.circus.school.ringmaster.curri: The Crimson Troupe is a school as well as a show. The Acrobat teaches pursuit, the Dagger Thrower focus, the Stilt Walker attention, the Strongman protection, the Beast Tamer rupture, the Fire Breather restraint, the Retired Understudy memory. A lesson readies you for the ordeal. Win the ordeal and the shape is yours. And trust? Trust you earn in a practical.
hemomancy.circus.school.ringmaster.facul: The Threadkeeper prepares your instrument. I teach coordination, through the final act as it has always run. Finish every lesson and refuse my offer, if you like. Or step into my act without every professor's approval. The Brined Court is our neighbor. It does not grant your Crossbar its strings.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.stage: A torn program names an understudy in the role of a living person. A penciled correction changes the role to "carousel support." Find the rigging account in the pavilion loft.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.loft: The rigging account records three substitutions, with the same names copied into the carousel's passenger tally. A margin notes that their rooms were never reassigned. Search the understudy quarters.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.quarters: Three unused beds and an unfinished letter contradict the announcement that the understudies left on tour. The Retired Understudy can identify the missing performers. Examine the carousel tally itself.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.carousel: The carousel tally confirms that the three missing performers are its bound captives. Severing the strings is lethal. Bring this evidence and the Retired Understudy's testimony to a Threadkeeper.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.title: Crimson Troupe Apprenticeship
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.guest.pen: Your payment is reserved. Make inventory space and collect it from any Threadkeeper.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.guest.ava: After passing a practical, repeat that professor's exercise for four Filaments, once per Minecraft day.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.w: A Vulture hovering at your shoulder? It catches nothing. Give it a line to chase. Then give it a reason to swing back.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.h: Rigging came first for me, blood after. Then one line snapped. That's how I learned a body that falls isn't a body that picks its way down. My Vultures keep it in their wing joints.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.c: Coming back down is half the chase, whatever the Strongman says about wasted lifts. The Fire Breather sees it. An act needs a recovery as much as an entrance.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.l: Watch the wing spars. Watch the scarlet tendons. The Veinwing Vulture is a built aerial striker, never hatched. At Degree 3, prepare its frame and take its Cardinal Ordeal. Then the practical: it chases a rehearsal threat from the air, hits it, and comes back when you recall it.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.a: I'll keep the ropes sound for the next pupil. Whoever conducts next doesn't get to tell the wings how to remember flight.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.t: I saw an understudy climb down from the loft. Next program, their name was gone. And that wrong audience? Eyes on our hands the whole time, never on the act.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_knife_thr: Six hands are worth nothing until they agree on one target. That's the theory, anyway. My Juggler wears three faces so you can see how often the theory loses.

I used to throw one knife, hit, and think myself a genius. Wrong, naturally. The Juggler taught me the empty hands between throws matter too. A laughing mask, a grieving one and a blank one, all on the same suspended frame.

The Stilt Walker thinks a distracted enemy is a beaten one. Wrong. Distraction buys you time for a deliberate throw, and that's all it buys. Why do we keep at it? Because we've both seen a careless pupil hurt the audience.

The Marrow Juggler is what the old records call a Marrow Spitter. Same ordeal, same Crossbar identity, new name. At Degree 3, prepare its offering and unlock it, then command a full three-dagger volley into one rehearsal threat. Don't expect three times the damage: the three throws split one attack's strength.
Pavilion stands, I teach in its blade ring. Pavilion falls, a wagon floor suits me fine. Either way, the Ringmaster doesn't get to own the next generation of hands.

That audience clapped when a puppet took a bow and sat on their hands for a performer. I know that look. They wanted obedience, not craft. Want a second opinion? Talk to the Stilt Walker, then prove you can focus without giving up control.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_stilt_wal: The Scarlet Mummer borrows an enemy's attention. Hold on to it long enough for somebody else to breathe.
Up over the crowd, I could see who was watching the show and who was looking for the way out. I built the Mummer so the frightened ones had somewhere else to look.

One perfect target does not help a pupil much. Several imperfect ones, all looking away from that pupil, help more. The Dagger Thrower will argue with you about it. The Beast Tamer would split the pack, where I would rather everyone glanced the same way.

At Degree 4, learn the Scarlet Mummer and complete its Cardinal Ordeal. Then bring your own known body here to me. In the practical, it has to draw both rehearsal threats away while they chase you or an allied puppet. It does that with its pulse and one evasive step, nothing more.
A mask can still look after a pupil when a conductor has lost their stage. And I won't call a dead captive a liberated student.

That wrong audience could not tell an act from a command. And the missing understudies had stopped choosing their own entrances, well before they disappeared. Ask the Dagger Thrower what they saw. Then come and show me attention spent on protecting somebody.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_strongman: The Hulk's shoulders are a promise. Plant it where the trouble lands. Let it keep its word.
My first body could lift a wagon. It couldn't hold a door open for one scared child. Strong, and good for nothing. This one wears belt and tendon bindings, so you see what it carries.
The Acrobat knows when to leave. I know where to stay. Can you value both? A conductor who can't breaks every string they own.

At Degree 4, prepare the Gorebound Hulk offering. Finish its Cardinal Ordeal. Then my practical: anchor Guard inside this ring, keep the Hulk guarding for five seconds, and have it hit a rehearsal threat while it's still guarding. Small head, lifting belt, heavy forearms. Built like a strongman. It hits and costs what it always has.
I can rebuild a practice ring. Not the people under that carousel. A successor who forgets that practices alone.
They told me the understudies left on a traveling engagement. Their luggage was still under their beds. You going to repeat that lie? Find those rooms first.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_beast_tam: Watch how the pack changes when a Hound ruptures. Handle the body gently, and once it bursts, let its temporary Curs finish the chase.

I came in with a cage and learned to leave it empty. An animal has needs of its own, where a built Hound is bound to a Crossbar. The Court's living creatures deserve better than the way we talk about them on stage.

Have you ever watched a pack scatter? The Stilt Walker pins attention in one place, and my pack spreads it out. The Fire Breather worries about singeing a Cur, which is exactly why I trust their lessons.

At Degree 4, prepare the Sanguine Hound bridle and take its Cardinal Ordeal. Then let your Hound rupture under the rehearsal threats' attacks, and get one of its temporary Blood Curs to land a hit. That's the practical. Don't ask me for a Cur on its own: it can't be learned, called separately, or kept as another permanent shape.
Packs find their routes without any pavilion. When this site is done, the other camps go on teaching.

Three names dropped off our traveling roster, and their rations kept turning up on the pavilion account. Who draws rations for performers who've gone? I'd trust the tally copied in the loft over any farewell announced from a stage.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_fire_eate: First the coil steadies the body. Then the lung-sac steadies the breath. Fire comes third, never first.

The oldest frame handed down to me stood on brittle legs. First I gave it a serpent's lower body, so the gaunt upper half could spend its effort on the lungs. Then I left the ribs open, so a pupil can read the pressure before the mouth opens.

Two colleagues, two rules. The Beast Tamer: account for every allied body in the ring. The Strongman: a wind-up the back row can see. Both rules hold, because a dangerous act ought to announce itself.

At Degree 4, build a Cinder Bellows Frame from hematic iron scraps, leather, Filaments and blaze powder. The ordeal is a Dominion Lesser at 900 mL. It consumes the frame only once the Bellows manifests, so your Crossbar comes through whole. Now count with me. One second: inhale. Two seconds: a five-block, sixty-degree cone. Two seconds: recover. For the practical, hit both rehearsal threats in one breath. It won't breathe through walls or onto allies, and it never sets terrain alight.
We can perform among ruins without setting them alight. Let the surviving camps be where pupils learn control again.
I watched the three understudies rehearse ordinary entrances. Some time after, the Ringmaster called their absence a change in casting. I did not see them leave the grounds.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_understud: A Mnemonist body repeats an attack it has watched. Give it a real memory first, then listen for the echo, the way an understudy listens from the wings.
An understudy learns another performer's pauses, their flubs, how they recover. I'd retired before the Ringmaster decided a perfect replacement should never need a choice of its own.

Memory on its own bends easily, and the Threadkeeper keeps accounts for that reason. A blank face on the Juggler doesn't trouble me much. A conductor who claims every remembered face as their own troubles me a great deal.

At Degree 5, complete the Mnemonist Puppet's ordeal. In the practical, strike a rehearsal threat yourself while your known puppet watches, then keep that threat in its range until it replays the attack it recorded. Ordinary puppet melee won't pass for an echo.
Those missing performers were people. Whatever is left of this school has to keep their names on the bill, whether a successor takes the Pattern or the carousel ends in blood.

Those three entries are the missing understudies. Nobody left those beds to go on tour. The stage program, the loft account and the quarters all tell one story, and the carousel tally tells its ending: what the Ringmaster made of them.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_threadkee: Bring your own instrument. I check the binding. What goes on its strings is for the professors to teach.
I counted ticket money once. Now it's Crossbar charge, spare Filaments, and the pupils who come back to report. Keep a good account and it tells you what's still owed.
Two promises on the books. The Ringmaster's: a grand final act. The faculty's: a pupil can call one body, control it and dismiss it safely. Only one of those can I inspect, so that's where I start.

First assignment on your account: An Empty Ring. Attuned? Charged? Then hold the Crossbar up for inspection. Learn any shape and complete its ordeal, then call, command and recall with that same Crossbar and report back here. Each professor records their own practical. Story investigations and paid guest performances go in the Side ledger.
The scattered camps teach as much as this pavilion does. Finished work and any guest pay you're owed go on your account, not the building's.

Two open items. The wrong audience: the Stilt Walker's and the Dagger Thrower's accounts, and both their practicals passed. The missing understudy: the abandoned stage record, the loft account, the quarters letter and the carousel tally, then you hear out the Retired Understudy. Bring me the facts and I'll close both.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.veinwin: Practical: Pursue from the air, hit a rehearsal threat, then recall. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.veinwing_: Receive personal instruction from the Acrobat.
Prepare the offering and complete this shape's Cardinal Ordeal. You keep your Crossbar.
Return to the Acrobat and pursue from the air, hit a rehearsal threat, then recall.
Practical passed. This professor can host a daily paid guest act.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.marrow_: Practical: Land all three daggers of one volley on one rehearsal threat. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.marrow_sp: Receive personal instruction from the Dagger Thrower.
Prepare the offering and complete this shape's Cardinal Ordeal. You keep your Crossbar.
Return to the Dagger Thrower and land all three daggers of one volley on one rehearsal threat.
Practical passed. This professor can host a daily paid guest act.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.scarlet: Practical: Divert both rehearsal threats away from yourself or an allied puppet. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.scarlet_m: Receive personal instruction from the Stilt Walker.
Prepare the offering and complete this shape's Cardinal Ordeal. You keep your Crossbar.
Return to the Stilt Walker and divert both rehearsal threats away from yourself or an allied puppet.
Practical passed. This professor can host a daily paid guest act.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.gorebou: Practical: Hold Guard in the ring for five seconds and land a guarded strike. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.gorebound: Receive personal instruction from the Strongman.
Prepare the offering and complete this shape's Cardinal Ordeal. You keep your Crossbar.
Return to the Strongman, hold Guard in the ring for five seconds, and land a guarded strike.
Practical passed. This professor can host a daily paid guest act.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.sanguin: Practical: Let your Hound rupture, then hit a rehearsal threat with its temporary Curs. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.sanguine_: Receive personal instruction from the Beast Tamer.
Prepare the offering and complete this shape's Cardinal Ordeal. You keep your Crossbar.
Return to the Beast Tamer, let your Hound rupture, then have its temporary Curs hit a rehearsal threat.
Practical passed. This professor can host a daily paid guest act.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.cinder_: Practical: Hit both rehearsal threats in a single breath. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.cinder_be: Receive personal instruction from the Fire Breather.
Prepare the offering and complete this shape's Cardinal Ordeal. You keep your Crossbar.
Return to the Fire Breather and hit both rehearsal threats in a single breath.
Practical passed. This professor can host a daily paid guest act.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.mnemoni: Practical: Strike a threat yourself, then have the puppet replay that observed attack. Use your own known body and Crossbar. Stay near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.mnemonist: Receive personal instruction from the Retired Understudy.
Prepare the offering and complete this shape's Cardinal Ordeal. You keep your Crossbar.
Return to the Retired Understudy and strike a threat yourself, then have the puppet replay that observed attack.
Practical passed. This professor can host a daily paid guest act.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.empty_rin: Ask a Threadkeeper to inspect your charged, owner-attuned Crossbar.
Learn a shape, complete its ordeal, then call it with the inspected Crossbar.
Issue a command with that Crossbar while its body is active.
Recall the called body using the same Crossbar.
Report your observed call, command and recall to a Threadkeeper.
Investigation or apprenticeship recorded. Your progress persists across death and travel.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.wrong_aud: Hear the Stilt Walker's and the Dagger Thrower's accounts.
Pass the Mummer and Juggler practicals to demonstrate protective attention and deliberate focus.
Report both accounts and practicals to a Threadkeeper at Degree 4.
Investigation or apprenticeship recorded. Your progress persists across death and travel.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.missing_u: Read the record on an abandoned stage.
Read the rigging account in the pavilion's loft.
Read the letter in the understudy quarters.
Read the carousel tally beside the bound captives.
Ask the Retired Understudy to identify the missing performers.
Report the records and testimony to a Threadkeeper. Either ending is still your choice.
Investigation or apprenticeship recorded. Your progress persists across death and travel.
death.attack.cinder_breath: %1$s was consumed by a Cinder Bellows
death.attack.marrow_dagger: %1$s was struck by a Marrow Juggler
hemomancy.summon.cinder_bellows.lore: A coiled lower body holds up a gaunt rib frame and an exposed bellows lung. You can see it inhale before it breathes a short cone of fire, and it needs a long recovery after. The Fire Breather teaches restraint.
subtitle.hemomancy.rite.staff_impact: Living Staff drives into the Focus
subtitle.hemomancy.rite.ring_open: A ring of the rite tears open
hemomancy.rite.problem.allies: The rite needs %s attendants; %s stand ready.
hemomancy.rite.problem.medium: The Focus holds the wrong medium.
hemomancy.rite.problem.anchor_damaged: A broken sore must be refilled.
hemomancy.rite.problem.sacrifice: The circle wants %s mL more from a named creature.
hemomancy.rite.problem.finale_held: The rite waits. Resolve what it lacks, or recall it with Blood Absorption.
hemomancy.rite.problem.ring_hungers: The woken ring hungers: %s sores still empty.
hemomancy.rite.guide.consecration: The sores hunger. Project blood into them.
hemomancy.rite.guide.inscription: The circle is fed. Trace its sigils, then seal it at the Focus.
hemomancy.rite.guide.station_projection: Feed the station's circuits through the Focus.
hemomancy.rite.guide.subject_feeding: Project blood into the structure beside the Focus. The Working floor climbs it as it fills.
hemomancy.rite.guide.offering_procession: The floor draws your offerings in.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.2: The second ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.3: The third ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.4: The fourth ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.5: The fifth ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.6: The sixth ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.7: The seventh ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.8: The eighth ring wakes. Feed its sores.
hemomancy.rite.ancestral_communion.name: Rite of Ancestral Communion
hemomancy.rite.ancestral_communion.desc: The highest rite of revelation. The caster opens a channel to the fungal consciousness and receives cryptic lore about where hemomancy came from.
hemomancy.rite.apotheos_rite.name: Rite of Apotheos
hemomancy.rite.apotheos_rite.desc: The Eighth Degree rite. The practitioner crosses beyond Archon after completing Qliphoth Communion, accepting the final hush behind the Order's mask.
hemomancy.rite.archon_rite.desc: The seventh rite of the Hematic Order, crowning the practitioner as Archon and preparing the way for the hidden Eighth Degree.
hemomancy.rite.armature_consecration.des: Consecrate the Hematic Armature with the Armature Consecration Kit and close its two blood circuits.
hemomancy.rite.ashen_vessel_rite.desc: The vessel passes through fire and ash and comes out black and hard. The ashen gourd holds more blood than any gourd before it.
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_founding.name: Rite of Bloodline Founding
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_founding.desc: A lesser rite that binds the caster's essence into a new bloodline, producing a presigned ancestral ledger that others may use to join.
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_recall.name: Rite of Bloodline Recall
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_recall.desc: A penitent rite that reconjures a lost ancestral ledger from the caster's blood memory.
hemomancy.rite.chamber_of_will.name: Rite of the Chamber of Will
hemomancy.rite.chamber_of_will.desc: A grand inward rite for the Sanctified. The caster folds blood-memory around a fixed point of will and enters a private chamber that grows along with their scars, infection and ascension.
hemomancy.rite.clarity_ascension.name: Rite of Clarity Ascension
hemomancy.rite.clarity_ascension.desc: The second phase of the Unstained path, for a Purified supplicant. Surrounded by silver and crystal, the supplicant's mind opens to clarity.
hemomancy.rite.cortical_weave.name: Rite of the Cortical Weave
hemomancy.rite.cortical_weave.desc: Crown the Somatic Loom with a fold of cortex so it can see a Perfectus memory whole.
hemomancy.rite.covenant_vigil.name: Rite of the Covenant Vigil
hemomancy.rite.visitation_rite.name: Rite of Visitation
hemomancy.rite.visitation_rite.desc: An Apotheos goes home in the flesh. Two spore sacs burn in the braziers and the rite carries them bodily into the Gardens, onto their heart-node if one beats there; the Spine or a Podium brings them back.
message.hemomancy.visitation.not_apotheo: Only an Apotheos body can walk the Gardens in the flesh.
message.hemomancy.visitation.already: You are already in the Gardens.
message.hemomancy.visitation.home: The Gardens take you home, to the node that beats for you.
message.hemomancy.visitation.arrived: The Gardens take you in. No node beats for you here yet.
hemomancy.rite.possession_rite.name: Rite of Possession
hemomancy.rite.possession_rite.desc: A Silentium forces their will onto a piece of the organism. Seat a Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus of a Qliphoth floor and drag a surrogate (a bat, enderman, blaze, iron golem, horse, donkey, wolf, spider or armor stand) onto it. Hold it there with your own Blood Binding: cast on the floor, the binding lasts until the floor breaks or the rite ends. It is stilled, and the will walks the Gardens in its facsimile while an echo waits here. The braziers need hold nothing. Whatever they do hold of Mnemonic Ambergris, a Hematic Iron Block, a Totem of Undying or Adipocere burns to steady the visit.
hemomancy.rite.covenant_vigil.desc: A bloodline vigil in which one sworn helper shares the boundary and survives a full Grand ordeal beside the caster. Every assigned survivor gains ten minutes of resistance and regeneration.
hemomancy.rite.crimson_beacon.name: Rite of the Crimson Beacon
hemomancy.rite.crimson_beacon.desc: A binding rite that anchors the caster to this location. When the caster takes a fatal blow, their body is returned here before death claims them.
hemomancy.rite.crimson_vessel_rite.desc: The pallid vessel is steeped in scarlet until its walls drink in blood and flush crimson.
hemomancy.rite.eightfold_script.name: Rite of the Eightfold Script
hemomancy.rite.eightfold_script.desc: Rule the Scriptorium's lines in red so one inscription may be singled out from the rest.
hemomancy.rite.enduring_pattern.name: Rite of the Enduring Pattern
hemomancy.rite.enduring_pattern.desc: Bind the Resonant Forge's reader, hammer, and wax stabilizer into one lasting cadence.
hemomancy.rite.eternal_covenant.name: Rite of the Eternal Covenant
hemomancy.rite.eternal_covenant.desc: Permanently raises the caster's maximum blood volume. It can be performed only once.
hemomancy.rite.exsanguination.name: Rite of Exsanguination
hemomancy.rite.exsanguination.desc: A sacrifice rite. A named creature held inside the circle bleeds into the anchors; once it has given 200 mL the daemon can be sealed, and its lifeblood crystallizes into Sanguine Quintessence.
hemomancy.rite.first_condensation.name: Rite of the First Condensation
hemomancy.rite.first_condensation.desc: Seat a Ghastly Alembic behind the Focus and close its two blood circuits.
hemomancy.rite.founding_fane.name: Rite of the Founding Fane
hemomancy.rite.ganglionic_weave.name: Rite of the Ganglionic Weave
hemomancy.rite.ganglionic_weave.desc: Bind a harness of nerve into the Somatic Loom so it can feel its own threads and hold a Magister's memory.
hemomancy.rite.hematic_fortification.des: Permanently reduces vascular and manipulation strain by 15%.
hemomancy.rite.hematic_succession.name: Rite of Hematic Succession
hemomancy.rite.hematic_succession.desc: Place the effigy beside the Focus on a Venous Stone plinth. Seat Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus. In braziers anywhere above the floor, read clockwise round the Focus from its left, nearest and lowest first, offer the donated professional vial, your own identity-bearing vial, then Mnemonic Ambergris. A free compatible workplace is required inside your fane. The body forms over sixty seconds.
hemomancy.rite.hematic_unbinding.name: Rite of Hematic Unbinding
hemomancy.rite.hematic_unbinding.desc: A severance rite that dissolves the caster's bloodline, freeing all members and returning any shared blood deposits. The covenant is broken.
The last vessel, past flesh and gourd. The curved horn is shaped from gilded venous stone and old blood, and it holds more of its bearer's blood than any vessel before it.
hemomancy.rite.hungering_earth.name: Rite of the Hungering Earth
hemomancy.rite.hungering_earth.desc: A corruption rite that feeds the caster's blood into the earth, converting the surrounding terrain into blood-touched stone and befouling ash.
hemomancy.rite.initiate_rite.desc: The third rite of the Hematic Order, granting formal entry into the Incarnadine Fane.
hemomancy.rite.lethe_covenant.name: Rite of the Lethe Covenant
hemomancy.rite.lethe_covenant.desc: The strongest Unstained consecration: it claims the surrounding land for Lethe. For 30 minutes within 5 chunks, mob spawns are halved, Silver Ward fully shields against all blood-magic bleeding, and Unstained practitioners passively gain purity each minute. It directly counters the Rite of Sanguine Dominion.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_baptism.name: Rite of Lethean Baptism
hemomancy.rite.lethean_baptism.desc: The first rite of the Unstained path. The supplicant kneels before cleansed stone and lethean flowers, renouncing the blood and beginning the long walk toward purification.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_font.name: Rite of the Lethean Font
hemomancy.rite.lethean_font.desc: The highest rite of the Unstained path. The Enlightened supplicant opens the source of Lethe's purifying waters. Everyone bearing clarity within 50 blocks receives a surge of clarity and an hour-long blessing of silver and verdigris. For one hour, a domain of stillness spreads 8 chunks in every direction, the inverse of Sanguine Dominion.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_judgment.name: Rite of Lethean Judgment
hemomancy.rite.lethean_judgment.desc: The most violent Unstained rite. It projects Lethe's will outward as a cleansing: every blood-active practitioner in range feels their veins seize and their manipulations scatter. Performing it declares war on hemomancy.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_tide.name: Rite of the Lethean Tide
hemomancy.rite.mnemonic_restoration.name: Rite of Mnemonic Restoration
hemomancy.rite.mnemonic_restoration.desc: Place the effigy beside the Focus on a Venous Stone plinth. Seat Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus. In braziers anywhere above the floor, read clockwise round the Focus from its left, nearest and lowest first, offer a Bound Mnemonic Remnant, then your own identity-bearing blood vial. A free compatible workplace is required inside your fane. The body forms over sixty seconds.
hemomancy.rite.monolithic_armature.name: Rite of the Monolithic Armature
hemomancy.rite.monolithic_armature.desc: Set the Monolithic Cornerstone into a consecrated Armature and bind three blood circuits.
hemomancy.rite.pale_consecration.name: Rite of Pale Consecration
hemomancy.rite.pale_consecration.desc: The supplicant lays a grid of cleansed stone, pale silver and suspended crystals and calls Lethe's judgment down on the ground. For 10 minutes, hostile creatures that enter the consecrated area are seared and slowed.
hemomancy.rite.pale_vigil.name: Rite of the Pale Vigil
hemomancy.rite.pale_vigil.desc: Performed by those halfway into clarity, the Pale Vigil calls on Our Lady's watch. Every Unstained soul within 40 blocks draws clarity from the light, and their Silver Ward and Verdigris Aura are strengthened for thirty minutes.
hemomancy.rite.palimpsest.name: Rite of the Palimpsest
hemomancy.rite.palimpsest.desc: Scrape the Scriptorium's vellum back to memory and cut the chosen inscription deeper than ink can hold.
hemomancy.rite.pallid_shadow.name: Rite of the Pallid Shadow
hemomancy.rite.pallid_shadow.desc: A rite that fouls the still waters and strips Unstained purification from a nearby player. Those who follow Our Lady count it an unforgivable act of hematic aggression.
hemomancy.rite.pallid_vessel_rite.desc: The dried gourd is consecrated within a ring of venous stone and ash, its hollow interior awakening to hold the lifeblood of its creator.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_cinder_be: Weather the breathing cycle and bind its shape to an attuned Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_gorebound: Bind the defeated Gorebound Hulk shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_marrow_sp: Bind the defeated Marrow Spitter shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_mnemonist: Bind the defeated Mnemonist Puppet shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_sanguine_: Survive the hound's rupture and bind its pursuit shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_scarlet_m: Hold the Scarlet Mummer's attention and bind the defeated shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_veinwing_: Bind the defeated Veinwing Vulture shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.rooted_vein.name: Rite of the Rooted Vein
hemomancy.rite.rooted_vein.desc: A blood-fed stone is rooted into the earth, growing a permanent Earthen Vein where the Cardinal Focus stood.
hemomancy.rite.sanctified_rite.desc: The sixth rite of the Hematic Order, consecrating the practitioner fully to the Bloodline Covenant.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_athanor.name: Rite of the Sanguine Athanor
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_athanor.desc: Raise a vented heating mantle beneath a Hematic Condenser, leaving room for its wider base and raised assembly.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_attunement.name: Rite of Sanguine Attunement
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_attunement.desc: A cleansing rite that purges and resets the caster's blood tendency alignments, allowing them to realign their kinship from a blank slate.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_brotherhood.name: Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_brotherhood.desc: The fourth rite of the Hematic Order, proving mastery of the foundational blood arts.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_dominion.name: Rite of Sanguine Dominion
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_dominion.desc: An imperial rite that claims the surrounding land as a Blood Domain. Within its bounds, the caster's manipulations cost less blood, enemies suffer a slow bleeding curse, and blood-touched blocks are empowered.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_eclipse.name: Rite of the Sanguine Eclipse
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_fervor.name: Rite of Sanguine Fervor
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_fervor.desc: A hunting rite that soaks the earth with vital blood-heat and draws creatures out of the dark. For a short time, mobs spawn at greatly increased rates within a 3-chunk radius.
hemomancy.rite.scarlet_summons.name: Rite of the Scarlet Summons
hemomancy.rite.scarlet_summons.desc: A commanding rite that draws upon the shared bloodline pool to teleport all online bloodline members to the rite location. The cost scales with the number of members summoned.
hemomancy.rite.second_fraction.name: Rite of the Second Fraction
hemomancy.rite.second_fraction.desc: Seat a calibrated Vial Centrifuge behind the Focus and close three circuits for a second fraction.
hemomancy.rite.severed_covenant.name: Rite of the Severed Covenant
hemomancy.rite.severed_covenant.desc: An exceptional founder's renunciation learned from the collapse of an unleashed infection. It disbands the founder's bloodline and cuts its integration from their infection.
hemomancy.rite.silthmeres_remembrance.de: Invokes Silthmere, the name-like liturgical title of Our Lady of Still Waters. Every Unstained soul within 32 blocks is blessed at once: each gains 5 purity and has their Verdigris Aura refreshed.
hemomancy.rite.silver_dawn.name: Rite of the Silver Dawn
hemomancy.rite.silver_dawn.desc: A grand consecration that radiates silver-green light, cleansing blood-stained blocks in a wide radius and strengthening the caster's Verdigris Aura. Requires Clarity.
hemomancy.rite.silver_veil.name: Rite of the Silver Veil
hemomancy.rite.silver_veil.desc: A consecration rite that draws silver light from the cleansed blocks, weaving a protective veil around the supplicant. The Silver Ward shields the faithful from the touch of blood magic.
hemomancy.rite.steady_separation.name: Rite of the Steady Separation
hemomancy.rite.steady_separation.desc: Seat a base Vial Centrifuge behind the Focus and steady its two recovery circuits.
hemomancy.rite.still_waters.name: Rite of Still Waters
hemomancy.rite.still_waters.desc: A calming rite performed where cleansed stone meets pale silver. The lanterns' still light dampens blood-magic violence in the area: magic damage dealt within the zone is reduced by 30% for 5 minutes.
hemomancy.rite.true_groove.name: Rite of the True Groove
