material.hemomancy.sanguine_condenser.de: An empty cauldron that has taken projected blood. It sets Sanguine Formations; Working rites grow it into a Latticed and then a Druse Condenser.
material.hemomancy.hematic_iron_scrap.de: Scrap metal infused with blood iron. Smelt into ingots.
material.hemomancy.blood_crystal_shard.d: A shard of crystallized blood energy.
material.hemomancy.blood_rock.desc: Dense stone saturated with sanguine energy.
material.hemomancy.foul_paste.desc: A vile mixture used in blood crafting recipes.
material.hemomancy.sanguine_conduit.desc: Channels blood energy between devices and structures.
material.hemomancy.puppeteering_thread.d: Restraint fiber from Peacock Spiders, surface Hemojellies and Blood Drunk Puppeteers; used in memory weaving and stored Crossbar tension.
material.hemomancy.bleeding_bulb.desc: Primary bleeding-heart flora reagent for hemomantic recipes.
material.hemomancy.blood_chum.desc: Bloody bait mass that briefly chums nearby fishing waters without improving treasure quality.
material.hemomancy.adipocere.desc: Corpse wax. Scrape it off an unharvested bog body with an axe, take it from bog revenants, distil it from honeycomb and a Ruinous Enzyme, or find it crusted on the walls of old dungeons, strongholds and ancient cities.
material.hemomancy.vivianite_cluster.des: A cluster of blood-aligned vivianite crystals, used to make vivianite glass.
material.hemomancy.spore_sac.desc: Collected fungal spores for various applications.
material.hemomancy.chitinous_husk.desc: Hardened exoskeletal material from blood creatures.
material.hemomancy.serpent_scale.desc: Scale from a blood serpent. Used in advanced crafting.
material.hemomancy.toxicognath.desc: Venom-bearing mouthpart taken from a Venom-Rib Centipede.
material.hemomancy.fargone_proboscis.des: A blood-drinking proboscis cut from a Fargone.
material.hemomancy.telson.desc: A desiccant scorpion stinger and venom bulb prepared for corrosive armor baths.
Distended royal brood tissue used in hardening armor oleums.
material.hemomancy.cuttlefish_chromatoph: Color and light cells shared by Prism Cuttles, Bloody-Belly Comb Jellies and Luminal Cicadas.
material.hemomancy.sclerotic_oleum.desc: Armor-hardening quench oil for Chitinite sidegrades.
material.hemomancy.aculeate_vitriol.desc: Biting corrosive infusion for Barbed sidegrades.
material.hemomancy.chromatic_sublimate.d: Prismatic control-sheen coating for Prismatic sidegrades.
material.hemomancy.venous_pinion.desc: Rare balancing feather from a Venous Strider, used for emergency-fall sabatons.
material.hemomancy.hematic_iron_powder.d: Ground hematic iron. Intermediate step before smelting into ingots.
material.hemomancy.sanguine_quintessence: The purest distillate of blood energy. Required for high-tier workings.
material.hemomancy.blood_stained_stone.d: Craft each from one Venous Stone, one Sanguine Formation, and redstone, or find it in a Hermitage Remnant. A blank Hematic Memory needs four.
material.hemomancy.fungal_spine.desc: The ninth owner-bound Pome from one Bloom completes Communion and grants this Spine. Its first use projects your consciousness for two minutes, then forces return.
material.hemomancy.curved_horn.desc: A curved horn from a blood-aligned creature. Sturdy and resonant.
material.hemomancy.fervent_husk.desc: The shed exoskeleton of a Flammeus-aligned creature.
material.hemomancy.vivianite_scalpel.des: A precision blade of vivianite crystal. Required to begin organ extraction at the Visceral Mirror. Also doubles vivianite yield when harvesting Bog Bodies.
material.hemomancy.neurotic_enzyme.desc: Ductilis enzyme for impulse and motion. Chicken blood can yield this enzyme in a Vial Centrifuge; some spins yield Vivacious instead. One is needed for a blank Hematic Memory.
material.hemomancy.fervent_enzyme.desc: Flammeus-aligned enzyme. Amplifies heat and combustion effects.
material.hemomancy.frigid_enzyme.desc: Congeatio-aligned enzyme. Channels cold and crystallization.
material.hemomancy.incandescent_enzyme.d: Lux-aligned enzyme. Focuses radiant and illuminating properties.
material.hemomancy.umbral_enzyme.desc: Tenebris-aligned enzyme. Enhances shadow and concealment workings.
material.hemomancy.recycled_enzyme.desc: Reclaimed enzyme matter. Weak but versatile across tendency types.
material.hemomancy.hematic_iron_helm.des: Fire-resistant armor forged from blood-infused iron.
material.hemomancy.blood_lust_helm.desc: Savage armor that empowers bloodthirsty combat.
material.hemomancy.barbed_blade.desc: Cruel living weapon lined with blood-drawing barbs.
material.hemomancy.chitinite_mace.desc: Heavy mace crafted from hardened chitinite.
material.hemomancy.sanguis_lancea.desc: A living lance that drains blood on hit.
material.hemomancy.living_syringe.desc: Collects creature blood into the loaded eight-vial rack. Learn microscopy and vial injection from the Alchemist.
material.hemomancy.hematic_iron_sword.de: A sword forged from hematic iron. Bleeds the target on a clean strike.
A knapping tool for shaping hematic iron into finer components.
material.hemomancy.living_blade.desc: A blade of animate sanguine tissue. Grows sharper as blood is drawn.
material.hemomancy.living_axe.desc: An axe formed from living blood-iron. Severs and drinks in one motion.
material.hemomancy.living_spear.desc: A spear that banks damage dealt in bright light, then spends it on a Lux burst.
material.hemomancy.living_staff.desc: A staff of animate sanguine matter. Channels manipulation cost.
material.hemomancy.living_baghnakh.desc: Clawed gauntlet of living tissue. Hold attack to rake again whenever the strike cooldown readies.
material.hemomancy.living_crossbow.desc: A crossbow grown from blood-iron sinew. Fires bolts of coagulated blood.
material.hemomancy.living_torch.desc: A living brand that keeps fervent blood burning at its crown.
material.hemomancy.living_flail.desc: A cold chained head of living tissue that drags heat from whatever it strikes.
material.hemomancy.bloody_vial.desc: Small vial for blood samples and centrifuging.
material.hemomancy.blood_gourd_white.des: Organic gourd cultivated to store blood naturally.
material.hemomancy.bloody_jug.desc: Larger blood storage vessel. Holds 1,000 mL.
material.hemomancy.morphling_jar.desc: Captures and stores a living morphling.
material.hemomancy.vial_rack.desc: Holds multiple bloody vials in organized storage.
material.hemomancy.bleeding_heart.desc: Crimson flower that bleeds on harvesting. Brews into blood-positive potions.
material.hemomancy.infected_fungus.desc: A fungus colonized by the Fungal Entity's influence. Key brewing reagent.
material.hemomancy.stinkhorn_fungus.desc: A pungent, blood-red fruiting body. Used in Foul Paste and memory weaving.
material.hemomancy.rafflesia.desc: A rare bloom found on particularly pure calcified hyphae.
material.hemomancy.sarcodes.desc: A crimson snow plant that grows where blood has soaked the earth.
material.hemomancy.devils_tooth.desc: Tooth-shaped fungus dripping with a reddish fluid. Caustic on contact.
material.hemomancy.morphling_polyp.desc: The base larval form of a morphling. Place in the Morphling Incubator to develop.
material.hemomancy.morphling_sunburst.de: A gold lichen strain that feeds its host in sunlight and passes nourishment on to others.
material.hemomancy.morphling_holdfast.de: A knotted, root-fisted strain that grips wet stone and holds its host in place.
material.hemomancy.morphling_mermaids_pu: A fast hunting strain that grows sail and fin, and banks the blood of its kills for the school.
material.hemomancy.morphling_dead_mans_r: A strain of pulsing violet veins that ties its host to an ally with a strand it can let go.
material.hemomancy.morphling_ink_cap.des: A shaggy black strain that veils its host from notice and spends itself as ink to escape.
material.hemomancy.morphling_hushbell.de: A frost-grey strain that folds its host into a closed, dormant bell to wait out harm.
material.hemomancy.morphling_marrowplume: A bone-white strain beaded with red that feeds on bones and remains and roots into them.
material.hemomancy.morphling_kinbud.desc: A pale strain with a flame-coloured mane that stings, buds and regrows what it loses.
material.hemomancy.scar_blank.desc: An uncarved scar tablet. Base material for all scar inscriptions. Requires Adept rank.
material.hemomancy.scar_transcendence.de: Lux-aligned scar (Tier III). Tougher skin and resistance under open sky, paid for in speed and blood capacity.
material.hemomancy.scar_sol.desc: Flammeus-aligned scar (Tier II). Hits harder and sets attackers alight, but strips armor.
material.hemomancy.scar_heart.desc: Animus-aligned scar (Tier I). Extra health, paid for out of your blood capacity.
material.hemomancy.scar_descendence.desc: Congeatio-aligned scar (Tier III). Faster movement, slow falling and a slowing aura, paid for with weaker, slower swings.
material.hemomancy.scar_moon.desc: Tenebris-aligned scar (Tier II). Shadow-swift, but the strike grows lighter.
material.hemomancy.scar_eye.desc: Tenebris-aligned scar (Tier III). Permanent night vision and speed. It drinks blood constantly and weakens your strikes.
material.hemomancy.scar_feral.desc: Ductilis-aligned scar (Tier I). Quickens the nerves for faster swings, but thins the skin.
material.hemomancy.scar_thorn.desc: Ferric-aligned scar (Tier I). Iron in the blood adds armor and slows the feet.
material.hemomancy.scar_shade.desc: Tenebris-aligned scar (Tier I). Moves faster and hides in darkness, but hits softer.
material.hemomancy.scar_pyre.desc: Flammeus-aligned scar (Tier I). Sharpens the strike and strips away a little armor.
material.hemomancy.scar_marrow.desc: Animus-aligned scar (Tier II). Deep reserves of life, at the cost of blood and speed.
material.hemomancy.scar_blight.desc: Mortem-aligned scar (Tier I). Rot sharpens your strikes, but each kill poisons you briefly.
material.hemomancy.scar_rime.desc: Congeatio-aligned scar (Tier I). Quicker legs, slower hands, and hits that slow the target.
material.hemomancy.scar_flux.desc: Ductilis-aligned scar (Tier II). Faster swings and Haste on kills, with thinner skin.
material.hemomancy.scar_halo.desc: Lux-aligned scar (Tier I). Radiance toughens the body and blinds attackers, but slows the step.
material.hemomancy.scar_anvil.desc: Ferric-aligned scar (Tier II). Iron thickens the shell and slows the pace.
material.hemomancy.scar_veil.desc: Lux-aligned scar (Tier II). Light-forged toughness, purchased with sluggish feet.
material.hemomancy.scar_phoenix.desc: Animus-aligned scar (Tier III). Much more health and regeneration below half health, paid for with 400 blood capacity.
material.hemomancy.scar_wither.desc: Mortem-aligned scar (Tier II). Poisons what it strikes and costs you max health.
material.hemomancy.scar_glacier.desc: Congeatio-aligned scar (Tier II). Slows nearby monsters and struck targets, but also your own swings.
material.hemomancy.scar_chimera.desc: Ductilis-aligned scar (Tier III). Faster swings and kill-chain boosts, paid for in armor and max health.
material.hemomancy.scar_corona.desc: Flammeus-aligned scar (Tier III). The blood runs so hot it sets attackers burning and blisters the armor off.
material.hemomancy.scar_crucible.desc: Ferric-aligned scar (Tier III). The heaviest Ferric scar: thick iron armor, slow feet, slower swings.
material.hemomancy.scar_oblivion.desc: Mortem-aligned scar (Tier III). Withers what it strikes while draining your blood and max health.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_catalogued_r: A cataloged reagent used in blood alchemy and enzyme work.
material.hemomancy.qliphoth_bloom.desc: The Bloom of the Qliphoth rite plants your Seed. Pick and consume all nine sequential owner-bound Pomes from this one Bloom to complete Communion.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_structural_o: A structural or decorative bloodcraft block.
material.hemomancy.liber_sanguinum.desc: Liber Sanguinium: the Hematic Order's field guide.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_bloodcraft_v: A bloodcraft vessel or gourd-family component used in sanguine storage, rites, or remedies.
material.hemomancy.gourdvine_tap.desc: A living Degree-2 reservoir. It passively grows blood, fills an inserted Blood Gourd, and matures with Foul Paste, Spore Sacs, or enzymes.
material.hemomancy.sanguine_salve.desc: A concentrated Bleeding Bulb remedy that restores 25 health to the single most damaged vein section.
material.hemomancy.vascular_poultice.des: An enzyme-set field dressing that restores 12 health to each of the two most damaged vein sections.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_ritual_fixtu: A ritual fixture or idol used to anchor advanced bloodcraft structures.
material.hemomancy.mycelial_lantern.desc: A Degree-3 living workshop. A persistent tendency culture fruits one matching enzyme in 2,400 ticks for 600 blood.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_living_harbi: A living Harbinger implement grown for field use.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_wearable_har: A wearable Harbinger implement tied to blood rites, masks, or vestments.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_block_or_gro: A block or growth from blood-rich fungal ecologies.
material.hemomancy.shared.an_organic_com: An organic component used in advanced Harbinger crafting and creature-derived recipes.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_hallowed_sai: A hallowed saint-reagent extracted for advanced consecration work.
material.hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.desc: Earned once by defeating both faces of Vesper through your owned Qliphoth wound. Teach it to your Living Staff through an Iron Brazier and Blood Absorption.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_late_stage_q: A late-stage qliphoth reagent used in monolith and consecration work.
material.hemomancy.qliphoth_pome.desc: Consume nine sequential owner-bound Pomes from one Bloom to complete Communion. Unbound fruit feeds you but cannot replace that proof.
material.hemomancy.qliphoth_seed.desc: At Degree 7, press further in your Sanguine Monolith conversation to shatter it and recover this Seed. Seat it as the medium for the Bloom of the Qliphoth rite.
material.hemomancy.vicars_consecration_k: The Artificer's Degree 5 offering for the Rite of Armature Consecration.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_fungal_cultu: A fungal culture or spore sample used in mycological bloodcraft.
material.hemomancy.shared.a_visceral_ech: A visceral echo reflected through the Mortal Display and Visceral Mirror systems.
material.hemomancy.altar_of_cleansing.de: Sacred altar devoted to Our Lady of Still Waters. Grants purity boosts through offerings.
material.hemomancy.unstained_podium.desc: Podium used in Unstained rituals and ceremonies.
material.hemomancy.suspended_cleansed_bl: A blood crystal purified through Unstained rites. Radiates cleansing energy.
material.hemomancy.cleansed_stone.desc: Stone purified of all sanguine taint. Foundation for Unstained structures.
material.hemomancy.pallid_lantern.desc: A soft-glowing lantern consecrated in the name of the Pallid Matron.
material.hemomancy.cleansed_sanguine_gla: Purified glass that blocks blood resonance.
material.hemomancy.pale_silver_block.des: A block of compressed pale silver. Used in Unstained rite structures.
material.hemomancy.pale_silver_bells.des: Decorative chime block cast from pale silver. Rings faintly in still air.
material.hemomancy.lethean_poppy.desc: Sacred flower of the Pale Lady. Source of pale distillate and poppy wreaths.
material.hemomancy.ghost_pipe.desc: A pale, leafless plant that grows only where the ground is still.
material.hemomancy.puffball_fungus.desc: A soft white fungus. Bursts when touched, releasing a cloud of cleansing spores.
material.hemomancy.tears_of_silthmere.de: Rare tears shed in devotion. Grants a powerful one-time purity boost at the Altar.
Woven from lethean poppies. Offer at the Altar for +5 purity.
material.hemomancy.silver_chalice.desc: Vessel of purification. Offer at the Altar for +5 clarity.
material.hemomancy.pale_silver_ingot.des: Purified silver free of sanguine taint. Base material for Unstained equipment.
material.hemomancy.pale_distillate.desc: Concentrated essence distilled from lethean poppies.
material.hemomancy.cleansed_blood_crysta: A blood crystal shard purified of sanguine taint.
material.hemomancy.pallid_icon.desc: Holy icon depicting Our Lady of Still Waters.
material.hemomancy.hemolytic_vial.desc: A vial of hemolytic solution. Dissolves sanguine formations on contact.
material.hemomancy.pale_humor_flask.desc: A flask of purified pale humor. Restores purity in small measure, or pours into a pool for item purification.
material.hemomancy.draught_of_still_wate: A sacred draught blessed by Our Lady. Soothes blood corruption.
material.hemomancy.hemolytic_solution.de: Solution that dissolves sanguine formations. Core anti-blood reagent.
material.hemomancy.hemolytic_plating.des: Plating treated with hemolytic solution. Resists blood magic.
material.hemomancy.neutralizing_gasket.d: Gasket that neutralizes blood-based energy transfer.
material.hemomancy.hemolytic_plating_blo: Structural block made of hemolytic plating. Blood-proof construction.
material.hemomancy.cleansing_hemolymph.d: Purified hemolymph used to cleanse blood corruption.
material.hemomancy.lethean_dew.desc: Dew collected from lethean flowers. Erases blood memories.
material.hemomancy.lethean_brew.desc: Potent brew of lethean essence. Powerful memory erasure.
material.hemomancy.unstained_helm.desc: Armor forged with pale silver, blessed against blood corruption.
material.hemomancy.unstained_warhammer.d: Heavy warhammer consecrated by the Unstained. Devastates blood creatures.
material.hemomancy.unstained_shield.desc: Shield blessed by the Pallid Matron. Wards off blood magic attacks.
material.hemomancy.self_reflection_mirro: Opens the Unstained Progress screen to view purification status.
material.hemomancy.absolution_dagger.des: A pale-silver dagger consecrated for extraction rites. The Unstained carry it for mercy cuts, not combat.
material.hemomancy.liber_immaculatus.des: The sacred text of the Unstained path. Records the stages of purification and the Lady's teachings.
material.hemomancy.shared.an_unstained_f: An Unstained fixture used in cleansing, still-water rites, or pale-silver construction.
material.hemomancy.cleansed_sanguine_pan: A purified building material for Unstained structures.
material.hemomancy.shared.an_unstained_t: An Unstained tool, weapon, or vestment forged for cleansing rites.

hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.first: You've come all the way down. We felt you on the stair, every tier of it. Stay as long as you like.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.0: The ones in the walls were people, and they still are. They only stopped needing to move.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.1: Nobody is kept here. Each of us came down a tier at a time, over a whole lifetime.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.2: There's food in the pool and room on the ledges, and nobody here will ask you for anything.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.3: When one of us goes still at last, the moss carries what they knew to all the rest of us.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.4: That's how we talk to the walls, and it's how the walls answer us when we're quiet enough.
hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.5: Marimo gives slowly. Food first, then belonging, and at the very end a place in the walls. Are you hungry?
hemomancy.court.presence.hydra.call: Be still, petitioner, and do not reach for it. The great head rises only to look upon who has come.
hemomancy.court.presence.refused.marimo: Marimo's moss does not come away.
hemomancy.court.presence.refused.site: The Court does not let this be broken.
hemomancy.court.warden.named.growth: You tore up what we planted for everyone. It wasn't yours, and it wasn't only ours either.
hemomancy.court.warden.named.undercroft: You reached into the walls for one of us. They're still people down there, and they felt your hand.
hemomancy.court.warden.named.harm: You raised your hand against someone who lives here. Nobody in the Garden does that to anyone.
hemomancy.court.warden.named.second_gift: You took what was set out for the others. There's always enough here, but only when it's shared.
hemomancy.court.warden.turned_away: The Giving Light turns you away until you make amends. Bring an offering of food.
hemomancy.court.warden.amends: You brought something back to the table. That's all we wanted, and it's enough. Come and sit with us again.
hemomancy.court.amends: Your offering is taken. The Giving Light counts you a guest again.
hemomancy.court.champion.open: The Kindling will let you challenge their Champion.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_unknown: You don't know the Court yet.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_shunned: The Kindling won't let you near their Champion.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_champio: You already hold the Champion's title.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_strain: Only a strain at Apex can challenge the Champion.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_standin: The Kindling have to count you a friend before you can challenge their Champion.
hemomancy.court.champion.refused_wait: Your last challenge is too recent. Wait a day.
hemomancy.court.champion.called: Then let it be tested. Champion, come out from among the elders: a petitioner asks for your title.
hemomancy.court.champion.named: The head has looked upon you and lowered its crown. The Sanctum names you Champion of the Kindling.
hemomancy.court.champion.won: You hold the title of Kindled Champion.
hemomancy.court.champion.buds: The Champion buds another ring of its crown.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.relay_chart_iss: The Voyager draws you a Relay Chart.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.relay_chart_car: You already carry a Relay Chart.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.read_let: Who was this letter meant for?
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.lost_let: I lost a sealed letter a drowned Votary was carrying.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.ask_abou: Who else keeps to the sea?
hemomancy.vicar.court.lead: Now that you stand at the fifth Degree, the record can tell you something it kept back until it could do you some good: we are not the only Harbingers who carried the blood into the sea, and the ones who went furthest call themselves the Brined Court.
hemomancy.vicar.court.voyager: I have no warrant to speak for them, and I confess I know them mostly through other people's letters. The Voyagers have dealt with the Court far longer than we have, so find a Voyager on the Erythrocoral Reef and ask. Whether you go is yours to decide.
hemomancy.vicar.court.chart: If you lose the way, any Voyager will draw you another Relay Chart.
hemomancy.vicar.court.letter_lost: You took a letter off a drowned Votary and lost it before anyone read it? Then describe the seal to me. Sunburst crust on a drowned envoy's letter can only mean the Brined Court, and the record will take a careful description where it has no letter.
hemomancy.vicar.court.known.voyager: A Voyager has already told you about the Brined Court, so I will not repeat them badly. What did you make of their account?
hemomancy.vicar.court.known.letter: You've already had a letter from them, I see. A drowned envoy's seal is better warrant than anything I could add, so let a Voyager chart the way.
hemomancy.vicar.court.known.alchemist: The Alchemist has already pointed you seaward, I hear. So. The Voyagers are the ones who can chart the way to the Brined Court.
hemomancy.vicar.court.known.found: You found the Brined Court before I could send you, so what you saw there counts, and I won't pretend my introduction came first. Was it what you expected?
hemomancy.dialogue.voyager.option.court_: How would I find the Lighthouse Garden?
hemomancy.dialogue.voyager.option.relay_: Could you draw me another Relay Chart?
hemomancy.voyager.court.line1: Some Harbingers went into the sea and stayed there; they call themselves the Brined Court, and they keep the strains we only catalogue.
hemomancy.voyager.court.line2: We deal with them at a cordial distance: we measure, we witness where they cultivate, and we don't presume. Their nearest door is the Lighthouse Garden.
hemomancy.voyager.court.letter_lost: A Votary gave up a sealed letter to you and the sea took it back? Tell me what the seal was made of, because Sunburst crust means it was bound for the Brined Court.
hemomancy.voyager.court.known.voyager: We've spoken of the Brined Court already, and nothing in our survey of them has changed since then.
hemomancy.voyager.court.known.letter: You've already had a letter from them, I see; the drowned envoys never delivered theirs, so in a way you finished the voyage for them.
hemomancy.voyager.court.known.alchemist: Your Alchemist sent you seaward already, I gather; the Order's Latin names are our catalogue of strains the Court actually raises.
hemomancy.voyager.court.known.found: You found the Court before anyone sent you, which is the kind of observation no survey can plan for. What did the water do when you arrived?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.ask_: Where do these strains come from?
hemomancy.alchemist.court.lead.line1: That strain's past Mature, so I'll be plain: the best cultivators of these lines aren't in the Order. Our Latin's an outsider's catalogue.
hemomancy.alchemist.court.lead.line2: They're at sea. Ask a Voyager, or follow the coast. I'd want a sample of whatever they feed theirs.
hemomancy.alchemist.court.letter_lost: You lost a sealed letter off a drowned Votary? What was the seal? If it was Sunburst crust, it's the Brined Court's, and a Voyager can chart it.
hemomancy.alchemist.court.known.voyager: The Voyagers got to you first, then. Fine. They've seen the Court's beds; I've only seen samples.
hemomancy.alchemist.court.known.letter: You've already read their letter, I gather. Good. It saves me a speech I'd have given badly.
hemomancy.alchemist.court.known.alchemis: I've told you already: the best cultivators aren't ours. Ask a Voyager for the chart.
hemomancy.alchemist.court.known.found: You found the Court yourself? Then you've seen their beds. Did the strains look healthier there than in my jars?
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.brine_seale: This is a letter of introduction that never arrived, sealed with Sunburst crust and carried by one of the crews who tried to reach the Brined Court and drowned on the way.
We call those drowned envoys Votaries now, and I would not have you finish their errand blind. A Voyager can tell you where the Court keeps its door.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.brine_s: Sunburst crust on the seal. That's a strain's exudate, dried. Whoever sealed this cultivated it.
It's meant for the Brined Court. A Voyager can chart the way. I'd like a scraping of that seal first.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.brine_sea: That seal is Sunburst crust, and the letter is one our lost crews carried toward the Brined Court before the reef kept them.
We call anything that comes back from the Court's waters Brined, the drowned envoys included. Shall I chart you the way they meant to go?
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.rest: May I rest here a while?
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.amends: Offer the food in your hand, as amends.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer: Give the food in your hand.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_st: Give the stone in your hand, for the passages.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_ca: Give the fish in your hand, for the young.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_li: Give the line in your hand, for the camp.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_in: Give the ink in your hand, for the screen.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_wo: Give the wool in your hand, for the bell's warmth.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.offer_re: Give the remains in your hand, for the fall.
hemomancy.dialogue.court.option.directio: Where do the other houses live?
hemomancy.court.rest.recent: You rested here only a little while ago.
hemomancy.court.gardener.greet.stranger: Oh, you're soaked through. Sit down, love. We'll feed you first and ask your name after. Have you eaten today?
hemomancy.court.gardener.greet.referred: Someone sent you to us, didn't they? Good. You're here now. Sit, eat, and tell us how the trip down was.
hemomancy.court.gardener.greet.known: You found us on your own? Not many do. Welcome to the Garden, friend. There's always more on the table.
hemomancy.court.gardener.greet.member: There you are! The beds missed you. So did we. Come and eat with the house.
hemomancy.court.gardener.greet.transgres: I can't feed you. Not until you've made it right. Bring something to share and we'll talk.
hemomancy.court.gardener.strain.own: Is that Sunburst on you? Look at it, it's turning to the light already. It knows it's home.
hemomancy.court.gardener.strain.other: You carry another house's strain. That's all right. We feed everyone here, whatever they carry.
hemomancy.court.gardener.house.line1: We're the Giving Light. Everyone has something to give, and everyone deserves to be fed. That's all of it, really.
hemomancy.court.gardener.house.line2: Marimo's here with us, in the bloom and the sun. When someone leaves the Garden it hurts. We don't hide that.
hemomancy.court.gardener.food.line1: There. Eat it all. Was it good? There's more if you're still hungry.
hemomancy.court.gardener.rest.line1: Lie down in the shade by the beds. Nobody will wake you. We'll keep the light low.
hemomancy.court.gardener.gift.line1: Here, take these from the beds. They glow when it's dark. Something to remember the table by.
hemomancy.court.gardener.amends.line1: Thank you. We'll put it on the table with everyone's. That's done now. Come and eat.
hemomancy.court.gardener.custom.line1: You brought food for the table? Oh, that's the Garden's own custom. Thank you, friend.
hemomancy.court.gardener.directions.line: Below us the Holding Stone braces the shore, then the Shared Wake out in the open water, then the Woven Current down in the twilight.
Deeper there's the Veiled Fold and the Still Bell, then the Last Marrow on the whale falls, and the Kindling at the vents. Eat before you go that far.
hemomancy.court.gardener.item_hint: Show me what you're carrying. I know the beds better than the books, but I'll tell you what I can.
hemomancy.court.gardener.shunned.line1: Please don't come closer. You're scrubbed clean of everything that lives with us. It could spread to the beds.
hemomancy.court.gardener.shunned.line2: I'm sorry. I can't feed you. Go back up the way you came.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_garden: You haven't met a Vicar yet? Eat with us first. The Order's Vicars will tell you the rest, up on land.
hemomancy.court.arbor.greet.stranger: Come in under the fronds, little one, and be warm, and no one here will ask what you are.
hemomancy.court.arbor.greet.referred: They told you of us, and you came down through the water, and now the light is on you as it is on all of us.
hemomancy.court.arbor.greet.known: You found the way by yourself, little one, and the many felt you come, and we are glad.
hemomancy.court.arbor.greet.member: You are ours now, and we are holding you as we hold each other, and the Garden is wider for it.
hemomancy.court.arbor.greet.transgressor: Something was taken that was not given, and the many feel it, and we cannot open to you until it is mended.
hemomancy.court.arbor.strain.own: Sunburst is on your shoulders and it is reaching for the light, and one day it may hold you as it holds us.
hemomancy.court.arbor.strain.other: You carry a strain from deeper water, and it is cold here for it, and still it is welcome.
hemomancy.court.arbor.house.line1: We are anchored here, not stone, and we could stand and walk away, and we choose to hold.
hemomancy.court.arbor.house.line2: The many are in the bloom and the light, and when you speak to us you speak to them, and they hear you.
hemomancy.court.arbor.rest.line1: Rest by our roots, little one, and the light will find you as it finds all of us, and nothing is asked.
hemomancy.court.arbor.directions.line1: The houses go down as the light goes down, and each one holds a little less of the sun than the last.
hemomancy.court.arbor.directions.line2: At the bottom the Kindling feeds the heads in the dark, and the many do not reach so far, and we grieve it.
hemomancy.court.arbor.item_hint: Hold it up to the light, little one, and we will tell you what the many know of it.
hemomancy.court.arbor.shunned.line1: You are empty of the many, and what emptied you could empty us, and we are closing.
hemomancy.court.arbor.shunned.line2: Go, little one, and do not touch the roots.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_arbor: You are new to the blood, little one, and the Order's Vicars walk on land, and they will show you the first steps.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.strang: Welcome to the Lighthouse Garden. I keep the lamp here, and I teach, when someone's ready to learn. Have they fed you yet?
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.referr: You were sent to us, then. Good. Whoever sent you knew this is where the Court begins, and that the first lesson is mine to give.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.known: You found the Garden without a guide. That tells me something about you already. Sit, and we'll see what you came for.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.member: Welcome home, Giving Light. The lamp's lit and the beds are tended. Do you need anything from me tonight?
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.transg: You took what wasn't given here. The Garden won't open to you until you bring something back to the table. Do you understand?
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.strain.own: You carry Sunburst. It'll grow faster in this water than anywhere else, once you've had the lesson. Ask me for it.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.strain.other: Your strain belongs to another house. The lesson still holds for it, but in its own water, not ours.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.house.line1: The Giving Light keeps the top of the water, nearest Marimo. Everyone has something to give, and everyone deserves to be fed.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.house.line2: The Garden is where the Court meets the world. We feed whoever comes, and some of them stay. Do you see why the lamp stays lit?
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.food.line1: Eat. A lesson's wasted on an empty stomach, and so is most of everything else.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.amends.line1: Thank you. It's on the table now with everyone's. The Garden is open to you again.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.line1: A strain fed inside its own house's water grows faster than it does anywhere else. That's the whole of the first lesson.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.line2: Your Morphling isn't a tool you carry. It's a partner that wants its home water. Feed it there and it answers. Do you see why we call it partnership?
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.known: You've had the first lesson already. Take your strain home to its own house's water and feed it there.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.early: Not yet. You'll have the lesson when you reach the fifth Degree. Until then, eat with us and rest. There's no hurry here.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.line1: Then be welcome in the Giving Light. You'll have a place at the table and a share of the work. That's what a house is.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.early: The Court takes no one in before the fifth Degree. Come back then, and ask me again.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.standin: We hardly know you yet. Spend some time in the Garden first, and let the house come to know you.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.settled: You've already moved once. The custom allows one move, and you've made yours. I'm sorry.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.directions.l: The houses keep their own depths. Holding Stone on the shore, the Shared Wake in open water, the Woven Current in the twilight.
Then the Veiled Fold and the Still Bell at midnight, the Last Marrow on the falls, the Kindling at the vents. Each house will feed its own strain best.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.item_hint: Show me what you've brought. If it came from the Court, I'll know where it was grown.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.shunned.line: I'm sorry. You're clean of every partner we live with, and whatever did that could take our strains too.
I can't teach you or feed you. Please keep your distance from the beds, and go in peace.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_lightk: You're very new to the blood. Find a Vicar of the Order on land first. Then come back, and the Garden will still be here.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.greet.strange: Stop there. You're in the refuge now. Mind the rock, it's wet. I keep this passage. You'll be safe in it.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.greet.referre: They said you'd come. You came. Good. The passage is clear. I checked it this morning.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.greet.known: Found us on your own? Then you read the rocks well. Stay inside the walls. I'll keep the sea out.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.greet.member: Holding Stone. Welcome home. Your place by the pool is kept. Nobody's moved it.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.strain.own: Holdfast on your arms. Good grip. It'll take the stone when you need it.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.strain.other: That's another house's strain. Fine. The refuge shelters everyone. Keep to the passage.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.house.line1: We're the Holding Stone. We keep the shelters and the passages. Someone always has to. Here, it's us.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.house.line2: A promise here is a wall. People build their days on it. So we don't make one lightly.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.rest.line1: Sit in the shelter, out of the swell. I'll watch the door. That's a promise.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.custom.line1: Stone for the passage. It goes in with the next repair. You've shared the upkeep. That's our custom. Thank you.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.directions.li: The Giving Light's above us, in the sun. Eat there. Out in open water swims the Shared Wake. Follow the school.
Deeper, the Woven Current strings its lines through the twilight. Below that I don't go. My passage is here.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.item_hint: Show me. If it came off the shore, I'll know it.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.shunned.line1: Stay outside. You're scrubbed bare. Whatever did that could strip the growth off us.
hemomancy.court.tidewarden.shunned.line2: The refuge is closed to you. I won't hurt you. I won't open it either.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_tidewa: No Vicar yet? Find one on land. They teach the first steps. I keep passages, not lessons.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.greet.stran: You came in under my arms, guest, out of the swell. I hold this door so the sea stays outside it.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.greet.refer: Someone above told you of the refuge, guest, and they were right to. I have held this door for longer than most of them have lived.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.greet.known: You found the refuge with no one to show you the way. Few people read the shore so well. Come in, the door is held.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.greet.membe: You are of the Holding Stone now, so this door is held for you. I keep it for every one of ours, asleep or away.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.strain.own: Holdfast is growing on you, guest, round the wrists where it always starts. One day it may hold a door of its own.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.strain.othe: You carry the strain of another house, and the door does not ask what you carry. It holds for anyone inside.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.house.line1: I chose to hold this entrance, and I could still let go and walk away from it. I do not, because people sleep behind me.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.house.line2: A promise is a weight that other people lean their lives on. I have never set mine down, and I find it hard when others set theirs down.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.gift.line1: Take this kelp from the pool, guest, and plant it wherever you shelter. Its own holdfast will keep it there through any storm.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.join.line1: Then you are of the Holding Stone, and other people will lean on you now. Do not let any of them fall.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.join.early: The house takes no one before the fifth Degree, guest. Grow into it first, then come back to this door. I will still be holding it.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.join.standi: I do not know you well enough yet to lean on you. Shelter here, keep the passages with us, then ask me again.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.join.settle: You have moved between houses once already, guest. The custom allows a single move, and yours is spent. I cannot take you in.
Above us the Giving Light feeds whoever reaches the shore. Out past the reef the Shared Wake swims the open sea as one school.
Below them the houses grow quieter the deeper they live. At the bottom the Kindling tends the vents, though I have never left this door to see them.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.item_hint: Hold it up where I can see it, guest. My hands stay on the stone while we talk.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.shunned.lin: You are scrubbed clean of every partner, and that could loosen whatever holds me here. I am closing the door to you.
Go back out the way you came in. No one in this refuge will ever strike you for it.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_braced: You are new to the blood, guest. The Vicars of the Order teach beginners on land, so go to them first. This door will wait for you.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.greet.stran: You're outside the school. Stay on the edge. We watch it. Keep pace.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.greet.refer: Someone sent you. Good. The school's moving. Swim beside us.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.greet.known: Found the school alone. In open water. Few do. Keep up.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.greet.membe: Shared Wake. One of us. Take a place inside. We'll close round you.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.strain.own: Purse on your flank. Ours. It banks the hunt. Share it with the hurt.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.strain.othe: Another house's strain. Fine. The wake carries anyone who keeps pace.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.house.line1: We're the Shared Wake. The school's our home. We don't stop long. Strength is keeping pace.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.house.line2: We swim the edge. We find the food. We turn back for the tired. Nobody's left behind.
The Giving Light. On the reef, shoreward. The Holding Stone. In the rocks, at the waterline.
Under us, the Woven Current. Lines in the dark. Deeper, the quiet houses. We don't swim that far.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.item_hint: Show us. Quick. The school won't wait.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.shunned.lin: Scrubbed bare. No partners on you. Keep off the school.
We swim away. Nobody strikes you. Don't follow.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_edge_s: No Vicar yet. On land. Go there first. We'll still be swimming.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.greet.str: You have come to the nursery, so mind the cups, there are young in them. Did you swim all this way alone?
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.greet.ref: Someone told you where the nursery lies, and I am glad of it. The school is out on its loop, but we keep this ground for it.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.greet.kno: You found the nursery without the school to lead you here, and that's a long way across open water.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.greet.mem: You're Shared Wake now, so come and count the young with me. There is one more cup than last time.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.strain.ow: That's our purse on your flank, and when someone in the school is hurt it gives to them. Let it give.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.strain.ot: You carry another house's strain, and that's fine here. The young only care how gently you swim near them.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.house.lin: We're the Shared Wake. The school is our home, and this ground is where the young grow until they can keep pace.
Strength is keeping pace with each other, so the fast ones swim the edge and the rest of us make sure no one is left behind.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.gift.line: Take these, they were cooked on the shore before we came out. A long swim goes better on a full stomach, doesn't it?
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.custom.li: A fish for the young is our custom, sharing the catch with the ones who can't hunt yet. They'll eat well tonight.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.join.line: Then you're Shared Wake. Swim with the school when you can, and always turn back for anyone who tires.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.join.earl: We take no one in before the fifth Degree, so grow into the blood first. The school will still be swimming when you come back.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.join.stan: We barely know you yet, so bring the young a share of your catch and swim with us a while, then ask me again.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.join.sett: You've moved between houses once already, and the custom allows only one move. I'm sorry, but yours is made.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.direction: The school swims a wide loop through open water, so watch for the edge-swimmers. They'll see you long before you see them.
Shoreward are the Giving Light and the Holding Stone, and the Woven Current's lines hang below the twilight. We don't take the young any deeper.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.item_hint: Hold it up where I can see it, but gently, please, and never over the cups.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.shunned.l: You've been scrubbed of every partner, and that could pass to the young, who have so little of their own yet.
Please keep away from the nursery and the cups. No one here will ever hurt you for it, but you can't come near.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_nurser: New to the blood? Find a Vicar on land first, because they teach the beginnings. We only teach the young to swim.
hemomancy.court.linesman.greet.stranger: You came down into the gully without a line. If you'll take one, I'll tie you in while you're here.
hemomancy.court.linesman.greet.referred: Someone told you the camp hangs here, and they were right to. If you want a line, there's slack on this one.
hemomancy.court.linesman.greet.known: You found the lines on your own, in the dark between the walls. Will you let me show you where they hold?
hemomancy.court.linesman.greet.member: You're Woven Current now, so tie in when you like. You can let go just as freely, and nobody will ask why.
hemomancy.court.linesman.strain.own: That's our rope in your veins. If you link with someone, tell them first that either of you can let go.
hemomancy.court.linesman.strain.other: You carry another house's strain, and that's fine on the lines. If you'll hold a strand, the camp won't ask which.
hemomancy.court.linesman.house.line1: We're the Woven Current. The camp hangs between the walls on lines, and the pods part or join as the water needs.
hemomancy.court.linesman.house.line2: If you tie in, it's because you chose to. If you let go, you chose that too, and we keep both open.
hemomancy.court.linesman.custom.line1: Line for the camp? Thank you. If the water pulls at a pod tonight, this is what'll hold it.
hemomancy.court.linesman.directions.line: Above us the Shared Wake swims the open water, and the Holding Stone and the Giving Light keep the shore. If you go up, follow the light.
Below the camp the Veiled Fold keeps its clefts and the Still Bell sits in the cold. If you go down, go slowly, because the light ends here.
hemomancy.court.linesman.item_hint: If you'll show me what you carry, I'll tell you what I know of it.
hemomancy.court.linesman.shunned.line1: You're scrubbed of every partner, and a strand could carry that through the whole camp. I can't tie you in.
hemomancy.court.linesman.shunned.line2: If you'll keep off the lines, that's all we ask. Nobody here will raise a hand to you.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_linesm: New to the blood? If you'll take some advice, find a Vicar on land first. They teach the start of it, and the camp will keep.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.greet.strang: We were holding the line when you came, and I have let go of it so that one voice can speak to you.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.greet.referr: Someone above sent you to the lines, and we felt you arrive along every strand before I let go to greet you.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.greet.known: You found the camp with no strand to guide you, which the network felt as a small surprise passing from pod to pod.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.greet.member: You are of the Woven Current now, so when you tie in we will feel you, and when you let go we will let you.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.strain.own: Our rope is in your veins already, faint and young, and one day it may hang you in a network of your own choosing.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.strain.other: You carry the strain of another house, which the network does not mind, though it cannot feel you through it.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.house.line1: While I am joined I am many, and the camp sees with all of us. When I let go I am one again, as I am now.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.house.line2: Every joining here is chosen, and every one can be undone. I have let go many times in a long life, and joined again.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.gift.line1: Take these leads, lines made to tie and to untie, so that wherever you go a joining stays something you choose.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.join.line1: Then you are of the Woven Current, and the camp will feel you on the lines whenever you choose to tie in.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.join.early: The house takes no one before the fifth Degree, so grow into the blood first, and the lines will still be here for you.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.join.standin: The network does not know you yet, so stay at the camp a while and bring line for it, then ask me again.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.join.settled: You have moved between houses once already, and the custom allows a single move, so I cannot take you in now.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.directions.l: Above the camp the light grows, through the Shared Wake and the Holding Stone up to the Giving Light at the surface.
Below the camp the light is gone, where the Veiled Fold, the Still Bell and the Last Marrow live, with the Kindling lowest of all.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.item_hint: Hold it near, so that I can see it with my own eyes while I am apart from the others.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.shunned.line: You are scrubbed clean of every partner, and through one strand that could pass into every one of us at once.
I am taking hold of the line again, and the network closes to you, but nothing here will ever strike you.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_lamp_c: You are new to the blood, so go first to the Vicars on land, who teach the beginnings, and come back to the lines later.
hemomancy.court.host.greet.stranger: You're at the door. Why have you come? I won't ask your name.
hemomancy.court.host.greet.referred: Someone sent you here. Did they say what to expect? This room is open to you.
hemomancy.court.host.greet.known: You found the cleft alone. How did you see the door? Come in, this room only.
hemomancy.court.host.greet.member: You're of the Fold now. Which room is yours? Don't tell me. I don't need to know.
hemomancy.court.host.strain.own: Ink Cap on you. Can you feel the veil yet? It keeps what you keep.
hemomancy.court.host.strain.other: Another house's strain. Does that matter here? Not at this door.
hemomancy.court.host.house.line1: We're the Veiled Fold. Shelter here doesn't buy your history. Why would it?
hemomancy.court.host.house.line2: A guest gets a room, not the house. Would you want every door opened to you? We wouldn't.
hemomancy.court.host.rest.line1: Sit, then. Nobody will come in. Shall I draw the screen?
hemomancy.court.host.custom.line1: Ink for the screen? Thank you. I won't ask whose hand it came from.
hemomancy.court.host.directions.line1: Up the slope, the Woven Current hangs its lines. They'll want to tie you in. Do you want that?
hemomancy.court.host.directions.line2: Deeper, the Still Bell keeps its cold. Then the Last Marrow, then the vents. Where will you go?
hemomancy.court.host.item_hint: What are you carrying? Show me only what you want to.
hemomancy.court.host.shunned.line1: You're scrubbed of every partner. Do you know what that carries? The door stays shut.
hemomancy.court.host.shunned.line2: Please go. No one will touch you. Nothing will follow you out.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_host: New to the blood? Then find a Vicar on land first. They'll teach you, and they won't ask why you came either.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.st: You see me. Few do. Why?
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.re: Someone named this place to you. Who?
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.kn: You came in alone. I watched you.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.me: One of the Fold. I will not ask more.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.strain.o: The veil is starting on you. Keep it.
Another house's strain. It hides nothing here.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.house.li: I fold away when I am still. That is mine to do.
Belonging asks nothing of my name. Does yours?
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.gift.lin: Dark glass. You see out. No one sees in.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.join.lin: Then you are of the Fold. Keep your own counsel.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.join.ear: Not before the fifth Degree. Come back then.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.join.sta: I do not know you yet. Stay a while. Then ask.
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.join.set: You have changed houses once. The custom is spent.
Scrubbed of every partner. I fold away from you.
No one here will harm you. Go.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_veiled: New to the blood? A Vicar, on land. Go there first.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.greet.strange: You came in through the lower door. Close it behind you. The warmth is counted.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.greet.referre: You were told of the bell. Good. Then you know the rule. Nothing wasted, everything mended.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.greet.known: You found the bell without a guide. That took care. Sit where I show you.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.greet.member: You are of the Still Bell. Your place is on the ledge. Your share is ready.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.strain.own: Hushbell is on you. It will slow your hunger. Do not waste what it saves.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.strain.other: You carry another house's strain. The bell keeps you all the same.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.house.line1: We are the Still Bell. We keep our strength until it is needed. Then we spend it exactly.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.house.line2: A guest here is in our keeping. A guest also helps to keep the bell.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.rest.line1: Lie on the ledge. One blanket. Sleep until you are mended, and no longer.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.gift.line1: Two blocks of dried kelp from the stores. It keeps a long time. Eat it slowly.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.custom.line1: Wool, for the walls of the bell. It holds the warmth in. You have helped keep us.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.join.line1: Then you are of the Still Bell. Keep your strength. Spend it when it matters.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.join.early: We take no one before the fifth Degree. Grow into the blood first. The bell will keep.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.join.standing: I do not know your habits yet. Help keep the bell a while. Then ask again.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.join.settled: You have moved between houses once. The custom allows one move. Yours is spent.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.directions.li: Above us, the Veiled Fold in its clefts. Above them, the Woven Current's lines in the twilight.
Below us, the Last Marrow on the whale falls. The Kindling at the vents. Is your air enough for that?
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.item_hint: Show me what you carry. Hold it still.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.shunned.line1: You are scrubbed clean of every partner. In a sealed bell that would reach everyone.
hemomancy.court.bellwarden.shunned.line2: The lower door stays shut to you. No one here will harm you.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_bellwa: You are new to the blood. Go to a Vicar on land first. They teach the beginning. Come back after.
hemomancy.court.sleeper.greet.stranger: [The sleeper hangs sealed in its mantle from a bone hook in the dome. It does not wake.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.greet.referred: [The folded mantle rises once with a slow breath, then is still again.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.greet.known: [Frost has formed along the mantle's lowest fold. Nothing inside it stirs.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.greet.member: [The mantle eases a little, as if the sleeper knows one of its own is near.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.strain.own: [A faint frost-blue pulse passes along the fold nearest you, in time with your Hushbell.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.strain.other: [The sleeper gives no sign of the strain you carry.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.house.line1: [The sleepers of the Still Bell are woken only when the bell needs one of them. It does not need this one yet.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.house.line2: [Through the mantle, barely a word:] Still.
hemomancy.court.sleeper.item_hint: [The sleeper cannot see what you hold.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.shunned.line1: [The mantle draws tighter round the sleeper as you come near.]
hemomancy.court.sleeper.shunned.line2: [It stays sealed. Nothing in the bell moves toward you.]
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_sleepe: [The sleeper does not wake. Whoever keeps this bell would send you to a Vicar on land first.]
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.greet.stra: You've come down to the fall. Mind the ribs, they're sharp where the flesh is gone.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.greet.refe: Someone told you about the fall. Good, there's plenty of it left to share.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.greet.know: You found the fall on your own. Most follow the scavengers down.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.greet.memb: You're Last Marrow now. There's work in the bones, and food after it.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.strain.own: That's Marrowplume on your arms. It'll feed you off whatever's left. Let it.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.strain.oth: You carry another house's strain. That's fine, the fall feeds everyone the same.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.house.line: We're Last Marrow. A whale fall's food and shelter, and it won't last forever.
Nothing goes to waste here. When I'm spent, I'll root in the bones and feed whoever's next.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.food.line1: Eat. It's from the fall, and it was strong once. Now it's yours.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.rest.line1: Lie down under the ribs, out of the cold. I'll keep the scavengers off.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.custom.lin: Remains for the fall? Good. The elders root in bone, and the plumes eat the rest.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.directions: Above us there's the Still Bell in the cold, and the Veiled Fold in its clefts. They'll take you in, carefully.
Below us there's only the Kindling at the vents. They'd give a body to their heads. I'd rather mine fed people.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.item_hint: Show me. If it was alive once, I'll know what it's good for.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.shunned.li: You've been scrubbed of every partner. Down here that'd rot the whole fall.
Stay off the bones. Nobody here's going to hurt you, but you can't come in.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_marrow: New to the blood? Go to a Vicar on land first. They'll teach you the start, and then you'll be some use down here.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.greet.stran: You have come down to the fall, you who follow, and I am glad to be awake for it, though I cannot rise to meet you.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.greet.refer: Someone above sent you down to the bones, you who follow, and my plumes felt the water stir as you came.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.greet.known: You found the fall with no one to lead you, which means you read the scavengers well, as we all once had to.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.greet.membe: You are of Last Marrow now, so one day this bone may be yours, if you choose it when your strength is spent.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.strain.own: Marrowplume is on your arms already, and when your time comes it will root you as it rooted me, if you let it.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.strain.othe: You carry the strain of another house, and the fall will feed you just the same, because nothing here is wasted.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.house.line1: I chose to root in this bone when my strength began to fail, so that what was left of it would feed the young.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.house.line2: Rooting is a choice, and I could still draw my roots out of the bone and go, but I would rather be of use here.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.gift.line1: Take this bone meal, ground from a fall that was eaten long ago, and let it grow something for you wherever you go.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.join.line1: Then you are of Last Marrow, you who follow, and when your strength is spent it will feed the ones after you.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.join.early: The house takes no one before the fifth Degree, so grow into the blood first and come back down to the bones when you have.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.join.standi: I do not know you well enough yet, you who follow, so work beside the tenders on the fall a while and then ask again.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.join.settle: You have moved between houses once already, and the custom allows only that one move, so I cannot take you in.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.item_hint: Hold it out over the bone where I can see it, because I cannot lean any closer to you than this.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.shunned.lin: You are scrubbed clean of every partner, and in the bones that emptiness could spread to all of us who are rooted here.
I am drawing my plumes in, and the tenders will keep you from the fall, but no one here will ever do you harm.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_rooted: You are new to the blood, you who follow, so go to the Vicars on land first, because they teach the beginnings of it.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.greet.st: You are in the Kindling's water, visitor. The heads are fed here. Do not touch the offerings.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.greet.re: You were sent to the Sanctum. Then you were told what we are. Watch, and do not hurry.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.greet.kn: You came down without a guide. Few do. The heads will not mind you. Neither will we.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.greet.me: Kindling. Your share of the feeding waits. We prepare together.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.strain.o: Kinbud grows along your spine. It is the beginning. A lifetime of preparation follows it.
Your strain is not ours. It will not reach the heads. Still, you may watch.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.house.li: We are the Kindling. We cultivate the best self we can grow. At the end we give it to Hydra.
The vents are the heads. We feed them all our lives. To waste a person before they are ready is the worst thing we know.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.custom.l: This goes to the heads. Your offering is received. The heads are fed.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.directio: Above us is the Last Marrow, on the bones. Above them the Still Bell and the Veiled Fold.
The Garden is at the top, where the light is. The houses between will tell you the rest.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.item_hin: Show it. I will say what the Kindling knows of it.
You carry nothing living. Stand back from the offerings.
Nothing of yours goes to the heads. Leave the Sanctum.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_offeri: You have barely begun. The Order's Vicars teach the first steps, on land. Go to them.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.greet.memb: Kindling. Prepare. As this body prepares.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.strain.own: Kinbud. The beginning. This body began so.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.strain.oth: Another house. Not for the heads.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.house.line: This body is nearly ready. Not yet.
A head, or only body. The vent will say.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.gift.line1: Take. From the vent's light. This body keeps none.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.item_hint: Hold it up. To the crown.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_kindle: New. Too new. Land first. The Vicars.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.greet.strang: You stand at the threshold of the Vent Sanctum, petitioner. No one crosses it who is not ready, and no one is asked to. What do you bring?
hemomancy.court.head_tender.greet.referr: You were sent to the Sanctum, and you came all the way down. Then someone above believed you should see the heads. Let us find out whether they were right.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.greet.known: You found the Sanctum with no one to guide you, petitioner. That is a kind of preparation in itself, and the heads have seen it.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.greet.member: Kindling, the threshold knows you. Your preparation continues here, among the heads, for as long as you choose to live.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.strain.own: Kinbud grows on you, petitioner. It is how every one of us began, and how the long preparation for the one body starts.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.strain.other: You carry the strain of a house above us. It will never reach the heads, but you may still witness them. Will you watch in silence?
hemomancy.court.head_tender.house.line1: The Kindling cultivates the greatest self it can, and at the end of life gives that self to Hydra. Surrender is an end, not a duty, and I ask it of no one.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.house.line2: Only the most worthy keep a head. The rest become the body that holds the heads up. Hydra judges which; I only read the judgement aloud.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.gift.line1: Take this light from the vent mouths. Every petitioner who is received at the threshold carries some away, so the dark above remembers the heads.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.join.line1: Then you are Kindling, and the threshold is yours to walk. Prepare well. A lifetime is not long for what we prepare toward.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.join.early: The Sanctum receives no one before the fifth Degree. Go back up, prepare, and return when you have reached it.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.join.standin: The Sanctum does not know you yet, petitioner. Come down again, witness the feeding, and let the heads come to know you first.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.join.settled: You have moved between houses once already. The custom allows a single move, and yours is spent. The threshold cannot take you.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.challenge.li: You ask to take the Champion's title. It is an honour to be asked, and a greater one to be refused by strength.
Fight in the vent water, before the heads. If you fall, you may ask again when a day has passed. Are you ready?
hemomancy.court.head_tender.challenge.re: You are not known to the Court, petitioner. No stranger asks the Sanctum for its Champion's title.
The Sanctum will not set its Champion against one who carries the still water.
What you carry has not reached its Apex. Bring a strain that has, and the title may be asked for.
The Kindling do not yet count you a friend. Earn that first, and then ask again.
You asked and fell not a day ago. Rest until the day has turned, and then ask once more.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.directions.l: The houses rise from here as the heat fades: the Last Marrow on the falls, then the Still Bell and the Veiled Fold in the midnight water.
Above them the Woven Current, the Shared Wake and the Holding Stone, and at the very top the Giving Light, who feed whoever comes to them.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.item_hint: Show me what you carry, petitioner. The Sanctum has seen most of what the sea gives up.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.shunned.line: You are scrubbed clean of every partner, petitioner. That emptiness could spread to the heads, and the Sanctum will not risk it.
The threshold is closed to you. Withdraw from the Sanctum. No one here will raise a hand to you.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.court_head_t: You have not yet begun, petitioner. The Vicars of the Order receive beginners on land. Return to the Sanctum when you are Harbinger.
hemomancy.court.gardener.item_inquiry.mo: That's Sunburst, our own. Keep it in the sun and it'll feed you back. Isn't that lovely?
Feed it here, in the Garden's water, once you've had the Lightkeeper's lesson. It grows faster at home.
hemomancy.court.gardener.item_inquiry.re: A Voyager's chart? It points down to the Seats. Well, you found one of them. Have you eaten?
hemomancy.court.arbor.item_inquiry.morph: It is ours, little one, the lichen and the light together, and it will hold you as it holds us, and you may always let go.
hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.item_inquiry: Sunburst. The Giving Light's own strain, a fungus and an alga living as one. It feeds whoever carries it in the sun.
Fed in the Garden's water after the first lesson, it grows faster. That's partnership, not a trick.
A letter from one of the drowned envoys. Someone meant to reach us and didn't. You finished the journey for them.
Holdfast. Ours. It grips stone, not shell. Feed it here and it grips sooner.
Feed it in the refuge's water once you've had the Lightkeeper's lesson. It grows faster at home.
A Voyager's chart. It points to the Seats. The refuge isn't on it. We're small. That's fine.
hemomancy.court.braced_elder.item_inquir: Holdfast takes the hands first, then the feet. In time it will hold you to stone the way it holds me to this door.
It is a hold, never stone, and I could let go of this door today. That is the only reason holding it means anything.
hemomancy.court.edge_swimmer.item_inquir: Mermaid's Purse. Ours. It banks the hunt. It grows the sail.
Feed it at the nursery. After the Lightkeeper's lesson. It grows faster there.
hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.item_inqu: Mermaid's Purse is ours. It banks blood on the hunt and gives it to whoever in the school is hurt worst.
Feed it here at the nursery once you've had the Lightkeeper's lesson, because it grows faster on home ground.
hemomancy.court.linesman.item_inquiry.mo: Dead Man's Rope. It's ours. It feels the living through its strands, and later it ties you to anyone who chooses to hold on.
If you'll feed it here in the camp after the Lightkeeper's lesson, it'll grow faster. Home water does that.
hemomancy.court.lamp_colony.item_inquiry: Dead Man's Rope is ours, the strain that let me join the network and that still lets me leave it when I choose.
Feed it here in the camp once you have had the Lightkeeper's lesson, because a strain grows faster in its own house's water.
hemomancy.court.host.item_inquiry.morphl: Ink Cap. It's ours. Did you notice hostile things lose sight of you sooner? That's the veil.
Feed it here in the Fold, after the Lightkeeper's lesson. It grows faster in home water. Why not here?
hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.item_inq: Ink Cap. Ours. It veils. Later it hides.
Feed it here, after the Lightkeeper's lesson. It grows faster.
Hushbell. Ours. It slows hunger and the loss of air. Later it seals you when you are badly hurt.
Feed it in the bell, after the Lightkeeper's lesson. It grows faster in home water.
hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.item_inqui: Marrowplume. It's ours. It feeds off what's dead and heals you with it. Later it roots.
Feed it here at the fall after the Lightkeeper's lesson. It'll grow faster in home water.
hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.item_inquir: Marrowplume is ours, the strain that feeds on what the dead leave behind and that rooted me in this bone at the end.
Feed it here on the fall once you have had the Lightkeeper's lesson, because a strain grows faster in its own house's water.
hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.item_inq: Kinbud. The Kindling's strain. It buds along the spine, as Hydra buds.
Carry it a lifetime. Then you will know what it is for.
hemomancy.court.kindled_elder.item_inqui: Kinbud. This body began so. Small. Long ago.
hemomancy.court.head_tender.item_inquiry: Kinbud, petitioner, the polyp that buds as Hydra buds. Every one of us began with it along the spine.
Feed it in the Sanctum's water and it grows toward the one body. Whether it reaches a head is not for you or me to say.
A Voyager's chart, drawn toward the Seats. It brought you to the threshold, and the threshold is where it ends.
